If you're interested in getting a Costco membership, this is the best deal I've seen in quite some time. Head over here to get a Gold Star membership for $65 AND get a $45 Costco shop card. This could definitely come in handy as we head into the holiday season! Check out the details: "Your Groupon shows Redeemed as soon as you buy. That’s normal: your membership starts right away and will expire 12 months from the date you purchased. Step 1 — Purchase Select your Gold Star ($65/year) or Executive ($130/year) membership. You'll receive a confirmation email with your new 12-digit membership number, and after setting up your account, you can shop on Costco.com immediately. Keep this email; you'll need that number to verify your membership. Step 2 — Get Your Physical Membership Card Visit any Costco warehouse with a valid photo ID to get your physical membership card. Your household member can also get their complimentary membership card the same way. A physical card is not required for online shopping or to receive your Digital Costco Shop Card, but you need a physical card or the Costco app to purchase in the warehouses. Step 3 — Create Your Costco.com Account & Verify Membership Go to Costco.com and select Create Account. Enter your email address, send the verification code, and set a password. Use the same email address you used for your Groupon purchase. Then go to Account Details → Costco Wallet, enter your 12-digit membership number, and click Verify Membership. If you're unable to verify your account online, please visit the membership counter at your local Costco warehouse for assistance. Step 4 — Digital Costco Shop Card Delivery Download the Costco app and sign in. Your $45 Digital Costco Shop Card is loaded directly into your Costco Wallet within 2 weeks of successful sign-up. Costco will email you once your funds have been added, and you can check your Costco Wallet anytime in the app. You'll need the app to use your Digital Costco Shop Card in-warehouse; you can also view funds and apply them to online purchases at Costco.com under Account → Costco Wallet.
Important: The $45 Digital Costco Shop Card is available to new members only, or those who haven't held a Costco Membership in the past 18 months. If you already have an active membership, this offer won't apply, and the Digital Costco Shop Card will not be issued. You must create a Costco.com account and verify your membership to receive your Digital Costco Shop Card."

posts.title: Green For Less Green: The Valley Cities Offering Big Cash For Your Grass
posts.excerpt: Alicia’s Deals may receive a small commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here.
posts.text:
Alicia’s Deals may receive a small commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here.
Dreading overseeding this year? If you have a grass lawn and have been considering getting rid of it for desert landscaping or turf, several AZ cities will pay you to do it. Every program requires pre-approval before work begins, so check your local guidelines first! Check out each city's rebate structure and link to application below:
Phoenix
The Deal: $2.00 per square foot.
The Cap: Up to a massive $10,000 maximum payout per project.
The Fine Print: Requires a minimum removal of 250 square feet of live, healthy grass. Projects must be completed within 6 months of your pre-approval date.
Apply Here: City of Phoenix Residential Grass Incentives Portal
Mesa
The Deal: Up to $4,200 per residential property.
The Cap: The standard rebate is normally capped at $2,100, but thanks to temporary matching sponsorships from SRP and Google, the incentive is doubled!
The Fine Print: Homeowners must remove at least 500 square feet of grass and replace it with desert-adapted low-water plants covering at least 50% of the converted area.
Apply Here: City of Mesa Grass-to-Xeriscape Program Application
Gilbert
The Deal: Up to $1 per square foot plus a $1,000 desert plant bonus.
The Cap: Up to $3,000 total ($2,000 base cap for removing 2,000+ sq ft of grass, plus the $1,000 plant incentive).
The Fine Print: Minimum conversion area is 200 square feet. Rebates are applied directly as a credit to your town utility bill.
Apply Here: Town of Gilbert Water Conservation Rebates
Scottsdale
The Deal: $2.00 per square foot.
The Cap: Up to $5,000 for residential properties.
The Fine Print: Scottsdale runs their program in seasonal application cycles. Make sure to get city pre-approval before initiating any part of your removal project.
Apply Here: Scottsdale Water Residential Rebates Page
Chandler
The Deal: $1.50 per square foot for grass to Xeriscape.
The Cap: Up to $2,000 max for single-family residences.
The Fine Print: Requires a minimum removal of 500 square feet of non-synthetic grass. The new layout must achieve 50% living plant coverage at maturity.
Apply Here: City of Chandler Landscape Incentive Guidelines
Glendale
The Deal: $1.00 per square foot for a xeriscape transition, or $0.25 per square foot if installing artificial turf.
The Cap: Up to $3,000 max for existing home desert landscape conversions. (Artificial turf caps out at a lower $250 max).
The Fine Print: Tiered scales determine the exact payout based on the size of the lawn you pull out.
Apply Here: City of Glendale Water Conservation Program
Peoria
The Deal: Scaled flat rates based on the total area removed and plant canopy coverage.
The Cap: Up to $3,000 max.
The Fine Print: Payout tiers start at $1,500 for converting 1,000 to 1,499 sq ft (with 50% plant canopy) and scale up to $3,000 for projects over 2,500 sq ft.
Apply Here: City of Peoria Xeriscape Conversion Rebate
Tempe
The Deal: $0.50 per square foot.
The Cap: Up to $2,000 per home, per fiscal year.
The Fine Print: The newly converted desert area must feature at least 30% living plant coverage.
Apply Here: City of Tempe Grass Removal & Conversion Portal
Let me know if I missed one!

Prime Day is officially right around the corner (October 6-7), but you do not have to wait until next month to score the best perks. The early deals are officially live, and this year, Amazon dropped a massive surprise for book lovers and music fans alike.
Right now, Prime members can head over to this Amazon Page to score four months of Amazon Music Unlimited completely free (non-Prime members can still grab a fantastic three-month free trial!).
My absolute favorite part? Audible is now included directly inside the Amazon Music Unlimited app! That means you get a free best-selling audiobook credit every single month of your trial.
If you grabbed the free Audible deal I posted back in June, this offer actually stacks—giving you an extra four months of free access! Just make sure to cancel your original standalone Audible trial so you don’t duplicate accounts. Amazon Music Unlimited auto-renews at $11.99/month after the trial, but you can easily cancel anytime with a few clicks in your Amazon settings.
🎧 How to Claim This Deal (Don't Miss This Step!)
Because this is a brand-new setup, a few readers have gotten turned down by searching the wrong app. Follow these quick steps to ensure it works flawlessly:
Click this link: Lock in your free months via the Amazon Music Portal.
Download the app: Make sure you download and open the Amazon Music App (not the regular Audible app).
Claim your book: Navigate to your music dashboard, go to the Audible tab, pick your audiobook, and start listening!
What I’ve Listened to So Far:
Listening to books during my daily drive has happily turned my car into a mobile library. I am officially hooked on listening during my morning routines, workouts, road trips, flights, and errands around town. If you are wondering how to spend your first free monthly credits, here are the titles I've tried:
Audiobook | Genre | Listen Time | Perfect For
The Calamity Club | Historical Fiction | 28h 44m | Long road trips & family sagas
Yesteryear | Satirical Thriller | 11h 15m | Pop-culture fans & drama
Biological War | Investigative Non-Fiction | 13h 10m | Thriller & current events fans
Atomic Habits | Self-Improvement | 5h 35m | Quick, life-changing upgrades
The Mini Reviews
The Calamity Club by Kathryn Stockett
The Vibe: From the bestselling author of The Help, this is a captivating novel about family, friendship, resilience, and fierce women.
My Take: The narration is top-notch. At nearly 29 hours long, this single audiobook will cover your carpool commutes for the next month (and you'll never get bored)!
Yesteryear: A GMA Book Club Pick by Caro Clare Burke
The Vibe: A viral "tradwife" social media influencer wakes up trapped in the brutal, unglamorous reality of 1855. Part psychological thriller, part dark comedy satire.
My Take: This is the bingeable Good Morning America Book Club pick everyone is talking about—grab your copy before the upcoming Anne Hathaway movie hits screens. I honestly could not stand the main character, Natalie, but somehow that made the book even better!
Biological War: A Scenario by Annie Jacobson
The Vibe: An instant New York Times bestseller exploring a ticking-clock roadmap following the accidental release or outbreak of a biological agent.
My Take: The depth of research in this book is genuinely frightening. It is the perfect follow-up if you read her smash-hit Nuclear War: A Scenario. It definitely leaves a lasting impression!
Atomic Habits by James Clear
The Vibe: The ultimate guide to breaking bad routines and letting tiny 1% daily changes compound into massive results over time.
My Take: Investing in yourself doesn’t have to cost a dime (especially when you can listen to this book for free). If you haven’t read this yet, you’re missing out on small, actionable life hacks that deliver massive results. It worked for me years ago, and those daily systems are here to stay!
🎯 Next on My List...
I just downloaded the new release, Whistler: A Novel by Ann Patchett, and will report back when I finish it.
What are you listening to in the car lately? Are you team Fiction (give me a great story!) or
team Non-Fiction (make me smarter during my commute)?

Enjoy!

Registration must be completed prior to booking and commencement of travel. Valid on new qualifying flights booked during the Promotion Period for travel during the Travel Period and flown within the Travel Period. Member’s qualifying flights must be booked through Southwest.com®, the Southwest Mobile App, swabiz.com (SWABIZ®), Global Distribution System (GDS), or Southwest Partner Services (SPS) distribution channels with Southwest Airlines® inventory during the Promotion Period for travel that must be completed during the Travel Period. Member's Rapid Rewards account number must be entered at the time of booking Member's qualifying flight to earn a promotional Companion Pass valid for use between August 10, 2026 and October 7, 2026. A qualifying one-way flight for this promotion is a one-way flight on Southwest Airlines from an origin city to a destination city, including any intermediate stops and/or connections on Southwest Airlines. A qualifying round trip flight for this promotion is a round trip flight on Southwest Airlines from an origin city to a destination city and back to the originating airport or carrier-recognized co-terminal. Valid on new reservations booked within the Promotion Period for travel during the Travel Period only. Travel booked or flown prior to registration for this promotion is not eligible for this promotional Companion Pass offer. Travel date is determined by the qualifying flight(s) original scheduled departure time. Qualifying flights must be flown by the same Member. Redemption reservations and Cash + Points bookings qualify for this promotional offer. Basic, Choice, Choice Preferred, and Choice Extra fares are all qualifying flights for this promotion. Cash + Points bookings will earn Rapid Rewards points, tier qualifying points for A-List and A-List Preferred status, and Companion Pass qualifying points on the portion of the base fare that is paid with dollars. Companion Pass, charter flights, group travel, and Getaways by Southwest™ bookings do not qualify as one-way or round trip flights for this promotion. Changes made within the Promotion Period are allowed if the qualifying travel is still completed in the Travel Period. Changes made to any itinerary after the Promotion Period may eliminate qualification for this promotion.

A few months ago, I wrote about how excited I was to receive free tickets to visit The Price Is Right. Kaitlyn and I had a GREAT pre-college mother-daughter trip, and the episode we were on aired yesterday (October 14th)! If you'd like to watch it, head over here to CBS.com (or use their app). Dang I heard so many were watching it they're making people sign up for Paramount+ now. Ugh! You can search for 10/14 Price is Right on Youtube, my sister sent me the links! Email me alicia@dealsinaz.com if you can't find them! It's Season 54, episode 17, in case you find it a different way.
For me personally, it was by far the BEST deal I've posted about! We got free tickets, had a blast, met amazing people, and (spoiler alert) I WON the showcase showdown! It was definitely a bucket list thing that worked out better than I ever could have hoped!
If you would love to “Come on Down” too, head over here to request your free tickets! If you pick Priority tickets, you’re GUARANTEED a seat as long as you’re on time. There are STILL dates available while I’m typing this! You’ll have to get yourself to California for the taping on the date you pick. Once you arrive, you'll wear a number and go in groups to "try out" for the producer, who will choose the contestants. My advice is to bring every bit of energy and enthusiasm you've got into your audition. You may go and not get called (this is probably the most likely outcome), but hopefully you have a great time! No matter what, you'll leave the show a member of the "Price is Right family".
I'm an empty nester (more positively known as a "bird launcher") now, and while I miss the kids A LOT, I'm excited for lots of travels and fun. Trips to Maine, Montreal, and Japan will be GREAT adventures! I think my experience highlights the importance of not going over (I was insanely lucky)!
Update: I have heard from lots of people upset that I did not listen to Kaitlyn and pick the 2, but sadly, I could not see her from where I was standing! I heard after the game was over that she was holding up a 2. Oh well! My mind was not registering having two 2's in the price (probably good to keep in mind if you happen to be chosen for the Any Number game)!
Enjoy if you choose to watch, and good luck if you go! And THANK YOU Drew and all of the amazing people at The Price is Right! What a fun experience!

posts.title: A Full Run-Down of Amazon Prime Membership Costs and Benefits
posts.excerpt: Alicia’s Deals may receive a commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here.
posts.text:
Alicia’s Deals may receive a commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here.
Amazon Prime Day is coming up July 8th-11th, and everyone is talking about Prime. The question is, is the membership worth the money to YOU?
First, let's talk cost. For the average person, the price of Prime is $139/year or $14.99/month (which works out to $179.88/year if you use all 12 months). You can head over here to get a free 30-day trial if you want to try it out. For 18 to 24-year-old young adults and students, Amazon is offering a free 6-month trial of Prime. Head over here to sign up (after the trial is up, you'll pay $7.49/month or $69/year). Young adults/students receive all of the benefits of Prime PLUS 5% cash back on purchases (10% on Prime Day). For EBT/Medicaid cardholders, Amazon offers 50% off a Prime membership ($6.99/month). Head over here for all of the details and qualifications for this program.
Second, let's talk about benefits. There's a whole lot more to Prime than just free shipping. The membership benefits I use all the time are free Prime Delivery (same-day to two-day shipping on almost everything determined on availability), Prime Video (I've found lots of series that I've enjoyed with my husband), Amazon Prime Music (over 100 million free songs and podcasts. NOTE: I DO NOT go for Amazon Music Unlimited for $10.99/month when my Alexa asks), Amazon Fresh (convenient fresh grocery delivery, I love that they often offer promo codes for extra $$ off), Amazon Prime Visa (5% cash back on Amazon purchases, 7% on Prime Days, plus they have a $200 bonus for getting a card this week), Prime Reading (free books I can read on my Kindle app), and Amazon First Reads books of the month (brand new titles that are always fun to read). I've used Prime Prescription Savings in the past, and it saved me a TON of $ off a prescription. For my family, the $11.58/month we spend on Prime (we pay the $139 annual fee in one payment) is well worth it.
If you're already paying for Prime, Amazon has put together a full list of included benefits. I highly recommend you check out this list and take advantage of everything you can:
"Delivery
FREE Two-Day Delivery: Millions of items delivered fast and free.
FREE One-Day Delivery: Available on more than 15 million items with no minimum purchase.
FREE Same-Day Delivery in eligible Zip Codes, on over 3 million items for qualifying orders that meet the minimum threshold of eligible items. For more information, go to Order with Prime FREE Same-Day Delivery.
Ultrafast Grocery Delivery: Get same day delivery on a wide selection of groceries, including meat, seafood, produce, snacks and household essentials. Prime members also have exclusive access to unlimited free delivery for $9.99 a month on orders $35+. Check availability in your area.
Free Grubhub+: Enjoy unlimited $0 food delivery fees, exclusive savings, and more with a free Grubhub+ membership.
Amazon Key: Get your packages conveniently delivered inside your garage. Check your eligibility.
FREE Release-Date Delivery: Be among the first to get new video games, books, music, movies and more. Choose Release-Date Delivery on qualified items and receive your package by 7 p.m. on that date. For more information, go to Release-Date Delivery.
FREE No-Rush Shipping: Don't need your Prime order right away? Select No-Rush Shipping and earn rewards for future purchases.
Amazon Day: Pick a day that works for you, and we'll deliver your weekly orders together on the day that you choose.
Streaming and Digital Benefits
On Prime Video, customers can find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports. Customers can also go behind the scenes of their favorite movies and series with exclusive X-Ray access. For more information, visit amazon.com/primevideo.
Alexa+ is an all-new version of Alexa powered by generative AI. It builds on the core Alexa experience, enhancing the functionality of Alexa features while introducing new Alexa+ specific capabilities. Alexa+ will be a free Prime benefit, at no additional cost, once Alexa+ Early Access ends.
Amazon Music included with Prime at no additional cost: music and top podcasts ad-free. Discover new music and podcasts based on your likes and access the largest catalog of ad-free top podcasts. For more information, go to amazon.com/music
Amazon Music Unlimited: 100 million songs on-demand and the most ad-free top podcasts. Listen offline and in HD audio—starting at $10.99/month with Prime.
Prime Gaming: Free games and a free monthly Twitch subscription included with your Amazon Prime membership.
Amazon Photos: unlimited full-resolution photo storage and 5GB for video storage with Amazon Photos.
Amazon Kids+: All-in-one subscription that gives kids access to thousands of kid-friendly books, movies, educational apps and games on compatible devices. Prime members get up to a 40% discount.
Shopping
At Amazon Fresh, Prime members can save up to 50% on grocery favorites and shop Prime Exclusive deals. At WholeFoods Market, Prime members can save on specific days of the week and get exclusive discounts. Shop in-store, pickup, or enjoy same-day delivery on a wide selection of groceries and household essentials. Eligible Prime members can earn a 5% cash back on groceries with a Prime Visa card.
Prime Day: Exclusive shopping event for Prime members delivering incredible savings and deep discounts on deals across every category.
Prime Exclusive Deals: Enjoy deals every day on thousands of items available only to Prime members.
Prime Visa: Earn 5% back at Amazon.com, Amazon Fresh, Whole Foods Market, and on Chase Travel. Earn at least 1% back on all other purchases. In addition, earn 10% back or more on select products as a limited time offer.
Prime Store Card: Earn 5% back every day on Amazon.com purchases and access exclusive promotional financing offers. In addition, earn 5-15% back on select rotating items throughout the year.
Amazon Prime Secured Card: Build your credit while earning 2% back on Amazon.com, Amazon Fresh and more.
Prime Early Access: Get 30-minute Early Access to Lightning Deals on Amazon.com.
Prime-Exclusive Shipping Benefits on Woot!: Prime members get free Standard Shipping on all Woot orders and free express shipping on Shirt.Woot purchases.
Buy with Prime: Fast, free delivery, and easy returns by shopping directly at participating online stores beyond Amazon.
Reading
Prime Reading: Read as much as you want from a selection of eBooks, magazines, and audiobooks, including single-sitting reads from Amazon Original Stories.
Amazon First Reads: Access an editorially curated selection of new books one month before they officially publish. Every month, Prime members can choose one Kindle book from our editors’ picks for free — $1.99 for non-Prime members. Downloaded titles are yours to keep.
Books with Audible Narration: Available through the free Kindle app and Audible’s free listening app on smartphones, tablets, and Alexa devices.
Medical Care and Prescription benefits
RxPass: Get your eligible medications for just $5 a month, no matter how many prescriptions you have.
One Medical: Get a care team on call for everyday health concerns and more. Only $9/mo for Prime members and $6/mo for each additional family member (up to six total members).
Prescription Delivery and Savings: Enjoy fast, FREE Two-Day Shipping on prescriptions from Amazon Pharmacy, plus exclusive savings when paying without insurance.
Save on Prescriptions: Search, compare and save up to 80% on prescriptions at over 60,000 pharmacies, including Amazon Pharmacy.
Other Benefits
Share Your Prime Benefits: Link your account with one other adult to share shipping, Prime Video, Prime Reading, and more for free. Members of Prime for Young Adults can’t share their Prime benefits.
Amazon Prime Fuel Savings: Save 10¢ a gallon at over 7,500 bp, Amoco, and ampm gas stations across the U.S." NOTE: I could not find a participating station in AZ, sadly. Please let me know if you find one!
If you decide the membership is not worth the money for you and your family, you can head over here to Amazon's Customer Service page to cancel and let them know!
I always shop around for every purchase I make. Amazon is NOT always the best deal (but they are a lot of the time)!
I hope this helps you decide if Prime is right for you!
Enjoy!

posts.title: Check If You Have Unclaimed Property (Usually $$$) at the AZ Dept. of Revenue! I Did and I'm Shocked!
posts.excerpt: If you're in the mood for a quick, free treasure hunt that benefits YOU, this is 100% worth it! Head over here to get to the Arizona Department of Revenue…
posts.text:
If you're in the mood for a quick, free treasure hunt that benefits YOU, this is 100% worth it! Head over here to get to the Arizona Department of Revenue website and search for unclaimed property with your name or business name. It takes seconds and could be a rent deposit, an old account you forgot about, or something else!
In my case, I started thinking about a very small (25+ year old) IRA account I opened before I was married (I did some digging and found out the account was sold to a different bank, and the new bank had a typo in my address). I searched the AZ Department of Revenue site and found it (I was shocked). I filled out the claim form and it was approved...it was an easy process! I can't wait to see what shows up. I'm sharing this story with you because everyone should interact with accounts at least yearly to ensure they don't go dormant (and check out the AZDOR site here). My old account DID go dormant when I left it alone (and since I wasn't getting statements because of the typo in the address, I didn't think about it).
My husband had unclaimed property as well! I talked to my hairdresser about it yesterday, and she found five unclaimed things for people close to her! This prompted me to share it with you!
There are literally BILLIONS of dollars of unclaimed property waiting for rightful owners in AZ. I can't wait to hear that some of it belongs to you (please keep me posted)!
Check out the AZ Department of Revenue's latest press release regarding Unclaimed Property on their website...
"ADOR Returns a Record $88 Million in Unclaimed Property during Fiscal Year 2024 | 07/30/2024
PHOENIX–The Arizona Department of Revenue’s (ADOR) Unclaimed Property program returned a record $88 million to rightful owners in fiscal year 2024 (July 1, 2023 to June 30, 2024), significantly higher than the recent 5-year average of $57 million per year. Amounts given back to owners ranged from $1.0 to $1.5 million.“ADOR’s Unclaimed Property team is dedicated to their mission of reuniting owners with their property and their incredible efforts have resulted in an all-time record amount of property returned this last fiscal year,” said Rebecca Wilder, Communications Director for the Arizona Department of Revenue. “We’d like to ask for the public’s help to return even more. ADOR encourages everyone to search their name at https://azdor.gov/unclaimed-property or MissingMoney.com, and to search every few years in the event any property has been reported.”Unclaimed property generally consists of money due to an individual or business from sources such as old bank accounts, uncashed payroll checks, tax refunds, credit balances, rebates, returned deposits, and dormant safe deposit boxes. Often property becomes unclaimed because the company that holds the funds has an outdated address or the wrong forwarding address for the customer. In some cases, a person passes away with no family members aware of the assets. Most accounts are turned over to the state after years of inactivity. The Arizona Department of Revenue Unclaimed Property Unit collects, safeguards, and aims to reunite unclaimed property with its rightful owner. Each year, the agency sends out thousands of notices to potential property owners, promotes the program through Arizona media, and works with other state agencies in Arizona and across the country to track unclaimed property owners. For more information on the Arizona Department of Revenue’s Unclaimed Property program, customers can go to https://azdor.gov/unclaimed-property."
Happy Friday!
Enjoy!

posts.title: FREE Easter Bunny Photos and Events in AZ!
posts.excerpt: If you have small children, you'd probably love to get their picture taken with the Easter Bunny this month! I found a few options in AZ that won't cost a cent:
posts.text:
If you have small children, you'd probably love to get their picture taken with the Easter Bunny this month! I found a few options in AZ that won't cost a cent:
Desert Ridge Marketplace: Head over here for more information about their Bunny Hop celebration.
"Hop on over for the ultimate spring celebration at Desert Ridge Marketplace on Sunday, April 13 from 12PM to 2PM inside The District!
Snap a free photo with some bunny special and enjoy an egg hop throughout The District, live entertainment, giveaways, crafts and so much more.
*This event is free and open to the public. Activities are available while supplies last.
*Free and open to the public. Photos are available on a first come, first serve basis. You will need to provide your email address and/or phone number to receive a digital download of your image.
In addition to the Bunny Hop celebration, you can snag a free photo with some bunny special on the additional date below.
Friday, April 18 – One Last Chance for Free Bunny Photos
5:30pm – 7pm
Near AMC Theatres inside The District"
The Shops at Norterra:
Head over here for more information about their Easter bunny photo opportunities this year April 11th-13th and 18th-19th from 10 AM until 7 PM.
Hop close to pose with the Easter Bunny! Families & furry friends alike, don your best dressed against a spring-soaked backdrop.
Photos to be taken on your own personal device on a first-come, first-served basis. No reservations allowed.
Downtown Mesa: Head over here for more information about their FREE Easter Eggstravaganza on April 19th from 10 AM until 1 PM.
"Start off by hippity-hoppitying down the Main Street bunny trail to hunt for Easter eggs along each side of Main Street and at over 17 participating downtown businesses.
After the egg hunt, join the rabbit of the hour, the Easter Bunny, for free eggs-clusive photos, Easter crafts at the Arts & Crafts station or play some fun Easter games and more!
Egg Hunt: Hunt for over 11,000 eggs along Main Street & at participating businesses starting at 10am
Activities: At The Plaza located at 56 E. Main Street 10am-1pm"
Bass Pro Shops: Head over here to check out their available times for FREE photos with the Easter bunny! They'll give you a 4x6 print. I just called the Mesa location, and they said if you don't see reservations available, you are welcome to come and stand in line; they can't guarantee how long it will take.
Let me know if you know of others to add to the list!

posts.title: Mark Your Calendar for National Park Service Fee-Free Days in 2025!
posts.excerpt: We are so lucky to have 22 national parks in AZ! It's one of my goals to see as many of the national parks around the country as possible!
posts.text:
We are so lucky to have 22 national parks in AZ! It's one of my goals to see as many of the national parks around the country as possible!
If you plan your trip well, you can avoid paying admission fees!
"The 2025 free entrance days are:
January 20 – Martin Luther King, Jr. Day
April 19 – First Day of National Park Week
June 19 – Juneteenth National Independence Day
August 4 – Great American Outdoors Act Signing Day
September 27 – National Public Lands Day
November 11 – Veterans Day
How to plan a national park trip
Where:
With over 400 national parks, monuments, and historic sites, there’s something for everyone. Visit NPS.gov/findapark to explore the park options nearest you. If you’re visiting a park that normally charges an entrance fee, review your entrance pass options before you arrive.
When:
The National Park Service is waiving the entrance fee for parks on six days in 2025, so consider planning your visit then. Otherwise, pick a date that works for you to visit and keeping in mind seasonal changes, how much daylight you’ll need, and if you need to get to the park early in the day to get parking or take advantage of lower temperatures.
How:
Some national parks require advanced reservations for camping, lodging, or timed entry. Research and book early to secure your spot, especially for popular parks.
Pick the right activity for you:
Review the possible activities, including ranger-led programs, scenic hikes, tours, and more. Planning allows you to maximize your experience while balancing active days with relaxation. Consider your experience and skill level when picking your activity.
Prepare for the unexpected:
Sometimes, our travel plans might change last minute or even during the hike. Do your research to know what else the park has to offer if you don’t end up being able to do what you planned that day. For example, if there’s more rain than you prepared for, visit the park museum or take a scenic drive. Make sure you check the park website or the NPS App for updated conditions, seasonal closures, and alerts.
Bring the right gear:
Plan like a Park Ranger and pack essentials like water, appropriate clothing, and maps. You can download park maps for offline use from the NPS App so you can find your way even if there’s no Wi-Fi. Note that water might be hard to come by in some parks, so make sure you bring your own, especially if you’ll be outside for a while.
Most parks are free to enter all of the time, approximately 100 out of 430+ national parks charge an entrance fee. With at least one national park in every state, no one is too far from an adventure. Take a look at www.nps.gov/findapark to see what adventure awaits and refer to our Trip Planning Guide as you prepare for your next visit. Mark your calendars and get ready for a year of adventure in 2025! "
Check out one of my favorite Christmas gifts from this year here...it's a game that celebrates the national parks (and makes me more curious to see more of them)!
Enjoy!

posts.title: SMART Target Money and Time Saving Hack That Just Saved Me $35! Remember This EVERY TIME You Shop!
posts.excerpt: Alicia’s Deals may receive a commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here.
posts.text:
Alicia’s Deals may receive a commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here.
If you shop at Target regularly you already know it's not always the cheapest store. Sometimes it IS the most convenient. I haven't taken advantage of Target's price match guarantee in quite a while and just had a personal experience with it that's a great reminder for all of us. Head over here to check out the guarantee rules. In a nutshell, they'll match the price of identical, in-stock objects sold by Amazon, Walmart, or Target.com (no third parties). If you're buying something big, you might as well double-check competitor prices on your phone (it will take ten seconds). This could save you big bucks on holiday gifts!
Yesterday, my daughter could not find her TI-84 calculator anywhere. She had calculus homework due and needed one immediately so I went on a shopping mission. Target had the calculator in stock but it was $149.99 (they're so much less expensive at back-to-school time...ugh). The exact same calculator was in stock at Amazon for $114.42. I showed guest services the link and got the price matched (and my daughter didn't have to wait for her calculator to be delivered by Amazon). The Target associate went through the entire price match guarantee with me (another employee came over to learn) and the most interesting part was that she fully admitted prices are often different at Target stores and on Target.com.
If you have a calculator emergency or just want one-stop shopping, this will save you time and sanity (it would have bugged me so much to pay full price)!
Enjoy!

I learned something new today...I had NO IDEA that anyone over 18 is eligible to join AARP. If you join you're supporting their mission to help make life better for older people. Head over here to start your membership now for $12 plus get a free trunk organizer! You'll automatically renew each year unless you cancel.
AARP members get access to GREAT discounts! Think 35% off at Avis, 15% off at Denny's, 10% off at Outback Steakhouse, 10% off the best available rate at LOTS of hotels, 20% off at Papa Johns, and more. Plus you'll get their magazine (my mom really likes it).
Why not join AARP?! I just did and I got a car rental in February for $40 less than I was going to pay through Costco (and I'm getting an intermediate SUV instead of a compact car)!
On their website they say in the FAQs: "While AARP is dedicated to people over 50, there is no minimum age to join. Anyone 18 and older can get an AARP membership for as low as $12 for the first year with automatic renewal." My friend's husband just got his AARP card when he turned 50. That got me wondering what the age to join is. Who knew it's 18?! There are some insurance deals for people over 65, but I couldn't find any deal I'd be interested in that I'm not eligible for (please let me know if you find something good we'll miss out on and I'll share)!
I am always so happy for my 55+ readers who enjoy 10% off groceries the first Wednesday of each month at Albertsons', Bashas', Fry's, and Safeway (if you didn't know about that, it can save you a bunch). While I don't qualify for that yet, I am excited I am fully eligible for most AARP savings!

posts.title: How to Get Into the Arizona State Fair For Free, Get Your Kids Free Rides, and Eat for Less (a Family of Four Can Save Way Over $90)!
posts.excerpt: If you're excited to take your kids to the Arizona State Fair but would rather spend less of your hard-earned money doing it, you'll love these deals!
posts.text:
If you're excited to take your kids to the Arizona State Fair but would rather spend less of your hard-earned money doing it, you'll love these deals!
Every Friday from 12-6 you can get into the fair FOR FREE when you bring 10 cans to donate to Operation Santa Claus and St. Mary's Food Bank. General admission tickets are usually $15 and this is definitely a win/win! Keep in mind:
"The following items will NOT BE ACCEPTED: Bottled water and all soda, all baby food, seasoning packets, ramen noodles and “Cup O’ Noodles,” and any items in glass containers.
This deal is active October 4th, 11th, 18th, and 25th from 12pm – 6pm."
If you have a 5-14 year-old, head over here to check out the Read and Ride program. If they read three books they'll get three free rides! You can download the form here. I heard that each ride is way over $5 this year so this can save a bunch!
If you want to redeem the rides at the same time you enjoy free admission with the canned food, check out the dates that overlap: October 4th, October 11th, October 18th, and October 25th.
Some people love the food at the fair more than anything! Check out the $3 Taste Of The Fair program...
"FAIR IS… FOR THE FOODIES! One of the most prominent aspects of any Fair experience is the food. Step into a world where indulgence meets excitement, where every bite is a new adventure. The Fair isn’t just about rides and games – it’s a journey that caters to every palate. Everything from fry bread, corn dogs, funnel cakes, and more- enjoy $3 Fair food items at every food stand on FRIDAYS from 12pm to 6pm. Foodies, rejoice at this stellar deal!
This deal is active October 4th, 11th, 18th, and 25th from 12 pm – 6 pm).
Click here for Taste of the Fair Map."
If I was going to the fair I would bring canned food and show up after school on the 4th, 11th, 18th, or 25th. If I had 5-14 year-old kids, they would read books and bring their filled-out form for free rides! I would also go for a $3 powdered sugar funnel cake!
If you bring your family of four, have two kids, and each reads three books this deal could literally save you $90+ (keep in mind that you will have to bring 40 cans of food for a good cause and that you will have to pay for parking). Check out the parking options here or consider getting dropped off!
Enjoy!

posts.title: Score Trans-Siberian Orchestra Tickets for 48% Off!
posts.excerpt: Alicia’s Deals may receive a commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here.
posts.text:
Alicia’s Deals may receive a commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here.
If you're getting your holiday plans together today you can head over here to pick up Trans-Siberian Orchestra tickets for just $49.99 (usually $86.84)! The show is happening December 1st either at 3 PM or 7:30 PM. Discount tickets could sell out so if you're interested I highly recommend buying now.
"This year, multi-platinum rock group Trans-Siberian Orchestra (TSO) kicks off a monumental winter tour on November 13th. The tour marks a triple celebration: 20 years of their beloved rock opera "THE LOST CHRISTMAS EVE," reaching their 20 millionth concertgoer, and surpassing a phenomenal $20 million donated to charity.
TSO remains true to the vision of their late founder, Paul O’Neill, by being one of rock's most generous bands. This year, the band will surpass a staggering $20 million donated to charity, a testament to their ongoing commitment to philanthropy. This generosity is fueled by their tradition of donating at least $1 from every ticket sold. That means with their 20 millionth fan attending a show on this tour, TSO will be hitting not just a concert attendance record, but a charitable milestone as well.
TSO's music director and lead guitarist, Al Pitrelli said, “When I was working on Lost Christmas Eve with Paul O'Neill, we talked a lot about time. He said that losing money or things wasn't as bad as losing time. Material losses can be recovered, but you can never get time back. That's why he always thought it was never too late to change. Never too late for forgiveness. People can make things right, forgive each other, and reconnect. The Lost Christmas Eve is about that hope: it's never too late for any of us."
This year's tour marks the grand return of "THE LOST CHRISTMAS EVE" to the stage for the first time since 2013. Expect an all-new, dazzling spectacle packed with pyrotechnics, lasers, and the incredible storytelling synonymous with TSO. The celebration continues with a high-energy second set featuring the group's greatest hits and fan favorites.
"THE LOST CHRISTMAS EVE" is a product of the imagination of and based on TSO’s double-platinum CD of the same name. The plot is one that resonates with people deeply over the holiday season. Alone on Christmas Eve, a bitter old businessman wandered New York City. Once a rising star, he’d traded love, family, and joy for a life of solitude and regret. The tragic loss of his wife hardened his heart, pushing him away from his infant son and into decades of isolation. Then, a chance encounter with a mysterious girl led him to a life-altering phone call. His son, who he abandoned decades ago, was alive, a gentle soul caring for troubled newborns in a maternity ward. After seeking him out, the son gives a silent and forgiving gaze to his long-lost father. As they sit together, comforting innocent infants, a new reunited life together begins."
Enjoy!

posts.title: September 6th Get Free Admission to the Children's Museum of Phoenix, the Phoenix Art Museum, and the Heard Museum in the Evening!
posts.excerpt: Would you like to take your family out for a great night of learning and fun FOR FREE? Check out downtown Phoenix! This Friday, September 6th, three fantastic…
posts.text:
Would you like to take your family out for a great night of learning and fun FOR FREE? Check out downtown Phoenix! This Friday, September 6th, three fantastic museums will offer everyone free admission at various times.
First on the list is the Children’s Museum of Phoenix! This fun and interactive place is perfect for the little ones in your life. Admission is usually $17/each (adults must pay too), but on Friday, September 6th from 5-9 PM it will be free for everyone. Click here to read what the Children’s Museum of Phoenix wrote about Free Friday capacity limits and recommendations.
Next up is the Phoenix Art Museum. For PhxArt Afterhours they're offering free admission to all from 5-9 PM! They promise live music, art-making workshops, entertainment, and more. Tickets are usually $25 for adults and $18 for kids. There is a charge for the special exhibit, head over here for more information.
Last but certainly not least on the list is the Heard Museum. Check out the very important event they have going on this month:
"Join us this September, the Heard Museum invites you to a special First Friday event in recognition of the National Day of Remembrance for U.S. Indian Boarding Schools. For 24 years, our exhibition Away From Home has shed light on a significant period in American history when Indigenous children were separated from their families to attend government-run boarding schools."
I called to confirm that admission is free for all on 9/6 from 4-8 PM. Admission is usually $22.50 for adults and $9 for kids.

posts.title: Make an Appointment to Get a FREE Microchip for Your Owned Dog at the Maricopa County Animal Care and Control West Shelter!
posts.excerpt: If your dog doesn't have a Microchip, MCACC wants to give you one for free! Head over here to make an appointment at their West Shelter. Check out what they…
posts.text:
If your dog doesn't have a Microchip, MCACC wants to give you one for free! Head over here to make an appointment at their West Shelter. Check out what they say about it on their website:
"To help pet owners avoid the heartbreaking nightmare of searching for a missing pet, we are presenting Mission Microchip to offer free microchipping services through the end of the year.
We are offering appointments every day of the week at our West shelter. Registration is required ahead of time, and MCACC hopes all Maricopa County dog owners will take advantage of this free service.
Studies show that more than five million animals enter shelters nationwide each year. Of those shelter animals, forty to sixty percent are lost pets. The unfortunate reality is that one in three pets will go missing at some point, sometimes at no fault of the owner. Even the most well-behaved dogs can get lost or run off unexpectedly. Microchipping dogs not only greatly increases the chances of reuniting these lost dogs with their owners, but it may also help reduce the crowding problem shelters are facing all over the US.
To receive a microchip through the Mission Microchip event, please register for an appointment. Times open up two weeks in advance. Please check back daily if no appointments are available."
Please share this with someone who can benefit! Our pets are so precious!
Enjoy!

posts.title: As Seen on 3TV...Five Tips to Get Ready for the Holidays and SAVE BIG in July!
posts.excerpt: Thank you so much for tuning into my Christmas in July 3TV segment! If you haven’t already, I hope you’ll join the totally FREE Alicia’s Deals e-mail list here…
posts.text:
Thank you so much for tuning into my Christmas in July 3TV segment! If you haven’t already, I hope you’ll join the totally FREE Alicia’s Deals e-mail list here (unsubscribe at any time). Please tell a friend about my site so we can all “live life better for less” together. You can also find out first about the latest and greatest bargains when you follow Alicia’s Deals on Instagram and “like” Alicia’s Deals on Facebook.
5 Things to Do to Get Ready for Christmas in July and Save Money!
1. Make your gift list NOW! Think about who you want to buy for and what you'd enjoy getting them. We tend to spend too much money when we remember gifts we need to buy at the last second. Head over here for a FREE printable that will help get you started!
2. Keep an eye out for sales. Back-to-school deals at Target are out now and include appliances, bedding, electronics, and other things you might want to give in December. Get your shopping done early and knock something off the list.
3. Think about interesting things you can make for gifts. One creative idea I heard of recently from The Pioneer Woman (photo credit) is crafting your own vanilla extract. You have to start now! It's easy…you put vanilla beans in vodka and let it sit in your pantry for several months, shaking every few weeks. Head over here for directions. Your foodie friends will LOVE THIS!
4. If you send holiday cards, take your family photo ASAP and keep your eyes peeled for free and inexpensive card deals. Tiny Prints, Shutterfly, Walgreens, and CVS Photo often offer free card deals (sometimes you can even get free shipping or free pick up in-store, make sure you are signed up for my weekly e-mail list so you don't miss a freebie). If you don't mind ordering a few at a time you can save BIG TIME and get the cards out early this year! I always love this deal from Photo Affections on Groupon.
5. Take inventory of your wrapping paper, bows, ribbons, and bags left over from last year. See what you have and what you think you'll need and shop early when the Christmas decor and supplies come out at the Dollar Store….the good stuff ALWAYS goes fast!!!
Enjoy!

posts.title: First Friday FREE Admission to the Children's Museum of Phoenix, the Heard Museum, and the Phoenix Art Museum the Night of June 7th!
posts.excerpt: Would you like to take your family out for a great night of learning and fun FOR FREE? Check out First Friday in downtown Phoenix! This Friday, June 7th, three…
posts.text:
Would you like to take your family out for a great night of learning and fun FOR FREE? Check out First Friday in downtown Phoenix! This Friday, June 7th, three fantastic museums will offer everyone free admission from 5-9 PM.
First on the list is the Children's Museum of Phoenix! This fun and interactive place is perfect for the little ones in your life. Admission is usually $17/each (adults must pay too). Click here to read what the Children's Museum of Phoenix wrote about Free Friday capacity limits and recommendations.
Next up is the Phoenix Art Museum. Four times a year they offer free admission on Frist Friday from 5-9 and 6/7 is one of the dates (also mark your calendar for 9/6 and 12/6)! They promise live music, art-making workshops, entertainment, and more. Tickets are usually $28 for adults and $18 for kids, but know that even on First Friday you'll have to pay for the Barbie special exhibit (click here to see the details).
Last but certainly not least on the list is the Heard Museum. This is a beautiful place with an incredible collection of American Indian Art and much more. For First Friday they promise quite a dance party (click here for the details) and I called to confirm that admission is free for all on 6/7 from 5-9 PM. Admission is usually $22.50 for adults and $9 for kids.
Enjoy!

posts.title: Check Out Act One Culture Passes at Your Local Library This Spring Break...Visit Many Museums for FREE!
posts.excerpt: Spring break is almost here! If you're staying in town and looking for something to do, you might want to check out your Act One Culture Passes at your local…
posts.text:
Spring break is almost here! If you're staying in town and looking for something to do, you might want to check out your Act One Culture Passes at your local library. Head over here for more information about the program. There are a limited number of passes to many local museums you can "check out" at each library (you must do this in person). At many libraries (like Scottsdale and Tempe) you can look online to find out if the culture pass you're looking for is checked out before you make a special trip (but keep in mind it could be gone by the time you get there). Each pass is good for two free admissions (use within seven days). Check out the list of museums you have to choose from at Central Arizona Libraries:
"Arcosanti
Arizona-Sonora Desert Museum
Besh Ba Gowah Archaeological Park
Boyce Thompson Arboretum
Cave Creek Museum
Desert Botanical Garden
Desert Caballeros Western Museum
Gilbert Historical Museum
The Heard Museum

S'edav Va'aki Museum
Scottsdale Museum of Contemporary Art

University of Arizona Museum of Art
Verde Valley Archaeological Center"
Thanks for the reminder Charlotte and Amy!
Enjoy!

"General Admission Lawn
G-Pass can only be redeemed on mobile app
How G-Pass Works: Within an hour of purchase, your G-Pass will be in your account. Alanis Morissette – The Triple Moon Tour with Joan Jett & The Blackhearts and Morgan Wade
Since 1995, Alanis Morissette has been one of the most influential singer-songwriter-musicians in contemporary music. Her deeply expressive music and performances have earned vast critical praise and seven Grammy awards. Morissette’s 1995 debut, “JAGGED LITTLE PILL,” was followed by nine more eclectic and acclaimed albums. She has contributed musically to theatrical releases and has acted on the big and small screen. Outside of entertainment, she is an avid supporter of female empowerment, as well as spiritual, psychological and physical wellness. In 2001, Alaniswas awarded the Global Tolerance Award by the Friends of the United Nations for her contributions to promoting tolerance through the arts. In 2016, Alanis launched Conversation with Alanis Morissette, a monthly podcast that features conversations with a variety of revered authors, doctors, educators, and therapists, covering a wide range of psychosocial topics extending from spirituality to developmentalism to art. On December 5, 2019, “JAGGED LITTLE PILL” the musical made its Broadway debut at the Broadhurst Theatre in New York City. The show was nominated for fifteen Tony Awards and won 2 Tony Awards at the 2021 ceremony. In July of 2020, Alanis released her ninth studio album, Such Pretty Forks In The Road, to rave reviews. In August of 2021, Alanis kicked off her sold out world tour celebrating 25 years of Jagged Little Pill. The tour became the #1 female-fronted tour from 2021 and also one of the Top Worldwide Tours of 2021 selling over 500,000 tickets. Alanis also stars in Fox’s sitcom, “The Great North,” which will return for season 3 in 2022. For more information visit.
Joan Jett grew up during a time when rock ‘n’ roll was off limits to girls and women, but as a teenager, she promptly blew the door to the boys’ club right off its hinges. After forming her band the Blackhearts in 1979, with whom Jett has become a Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inductee, she has had eight platinum and gold albums and nine Top 40 singles, including the classics “Bad Reputation,” “I Love Rock ‘N’ Roll,” “I Hate Myself For Loving You,” and “Crimson and Clover.” With a career that has spanned music, film, television, Broadway, and humanitarianism, Joan Jett remains a potent force and inspiration to generations of fans worldwide. As a producer, she has overseen seminal albums by Bikini Kill, and the Germs’ LA punk masterpiece ‘GI.’ Jett and Kenny Laguna (her longtime producer and music partner) co-founded Blackheart Records from the trunk of Kenny’s Cadillac after rejections from no less than 23 labels. 40 years later, Blackheart is a thriving entertainment company producing music, film and television, and continues to champion emerging bands. Joan Jett and the Blackhearts continue to tour the world with headlining shows alongside fellow rock legends like The Who, Green Day, Heart, and Foo Fighters. ‘Bad Reputation,’ a documentary about Jett’s life, premiered to critical acclaim at the 2018 Sundance Film Festival. Following up on the bands 2022 release Changeup, their first-ever acoustic album, Joan Jett and the Blackhearts EP Mindsets will be a RSD First vinyl release on 11/24. Mindsets is available to stream now. For more information visit.
One of Nashville’s fastest-rising and most critically acclaimed young stars, Morgan Wade released her much-anticipated sophomore album, Psychopath, Aug. 25 via Sony Music Nashville. Possessed with a raw and unflinching voice anchored by a perfect tinge of twang; the rare ability to pen honest portraits of some of life’s most precious and painful and unpredictable moments; and an onstage vulnerability that so seamlessly breaks down the wall between fan and artist, Wade has quickly made her mark on the country music scene — and the music world at large. Her stunning 2021 debut album, Reckless, was hailed as a critical triumph; it topped Rolling Stone’s Best Country and Americana Albums of 2021, with New York Times noting Wade “sounds like she’s singing from the depths of history.” In 2022, Wade was nominated as the Emerging Act of the Year at the Americana Music Honors & Awards; in 2023, Wade was nominated for New Female Artist of the Year by the Academy of Country Music and performed at major-market festivals including Bonnaroo, Lollapalooza and Austin City Limits.
While Reckless, and particularly its momentous lead single “Wilder Days,” busted down the doors and introduced Wade to a wider listenership, Psychopath is an astounding follow-up statement: the 13-track LP was crafted with the help of some of Nashville’s most extraordinary musical talents, from A-list songwriters (Julia Michaels, Natalie Hemby, Liz Rose, Lori McKenna) to studio musicians as well as Wade’s longtime producer Sadler Vaden. Most excitingly, Psychopath finds Wade peeling back layers of her psyche like never before. “I realized the more authentic you are and the more you pour yourself into your songs, and most importantly if you’re being honest, people will connect to that,” Wade says. “I want every song to get the credit it deserves.”
Enjoy!

posts.title: Veteran's Day Freebies for The Brave Men and Women Who Have Fought for Our Country!
posts.excerpt: Veterans Day is a fantastic time to say THANK YOU to all of the brave men and women who have given so much to defend our freedom. Lots of valley businesses are…
posts.text:
Veterans Day is a fantastic time to say THANK YOU to all of the brave men and women who have given so much to defend our freedom. Lots of valley businesses are offering freebies to Active Duty Military and Veterans with ID on 11/10 or 11/11 (read the details to find out when the offer is good). Here are a few (if you know of others please e-mail them to me at alicia@dealsinaz.com). I'll keep updating as I find them!
Applebees:
"For the 16th consecutive year, we’re offering Veterans and Active Duty Military a special Veterans Day meal on Saturday 11/11, where they can select from 8 delicious entrées at Applebee’s across the country (Dine-in only)."
California Pizza Kitchen:
"California Pizza Kitchen give thanks to Veterans and active U.S. military members for their services with a complimentary meal November 11, 2023...We invite all veterans and active military to have a meal on us from our special menu. Thank you for your courage and sacrifice. Your service deserves ours! Dine with us and receive a complimentary non-alcoholic beverage + choice of one entrée from our prix fixed menu Upsells and additions may not be included in the promo."
Dave and Busters:
"Calling all Veterans & Active Military! This Veteran's Day weekend, grab a FREE entrée up to $20 + $10 Power Card* for a weekend of fun & good vibes at D&B! Swing by with the whole fam for a Veteran's Day you'll never forget!"
"*Promotional. VALID 11/10/23-11/12/23. Get a free entrée up to $20 and a $10 Power Card or recharge. Must present DD214 veteran ID or active-duty ID to redeem. Promotion valid one per veteran or active military person per day. Power Card activation fee may apply. Not valid with any other offers. Other restrictions may apply. See store for details."
Denny’s: Is offering all active duty and retired veterans a FREE Original Grand Slam breakfast from 5 AM until noon 11/10.
Freddy's Frozen Custard and Steakburgers: "Honoring our heroes! Join us this Veterans Day, 11/11/23, as we salute those who have served. All Veterans and current military personnel will receive a complimentary Freddy's Original Double with Cheese combo meal card. Redeemable until November 30, 2023. No purchase is required" Thanks Candia!
Great Clips:
"On Saturday, November 11, 2023, veterans and active service members can go into any U.S. Great Clips salon and get a free haircut or a free haircut card for a future visit. In addition, non-military customers who get a haircut on Veterans Day at Great Clips salons will also have the opportunity to pay it forward. They can receive a free haircut card to give to an active service member or veteran they know as a way of saying thank you. The cards can be redeemed for a free haircut from November 12 through December 1, 2023."
Jackson's Car Wash:
(From email they just sent): " Happy Veterans Day. We want to thank you for your service by giving all active and retired military members a free basic full-service wash." They go on to say it's good November 10-12th!
Macayo’s:
"For Veterans Day, we are proud to offer all Active & Non-Active Military Personnel a free entrée on us! Join us Saturday, November 11th to enjoy a free entrée off our special Veterans Day Menu.
VETERANS DAY
Saturday, November 11th
Valid for all Active & Non-Active Military Personnel
Dine In & Macayo Takeout Only
Special Veterans Day Menu
- Fiesta Salad
- Carnitas Dinner
- Chicken Poblano
- Macayo’s Original Chimichanga
- Sonoran Enchilada Trio
- Baja Burro
- Carne Asada Burro"
Original Breakfast House: Veterans and active-duty military will eat free on Friday, November 10th. There's a big party for everyone! Head over here for more information on their facebook page.
Sport Clips: “Many Sport Clips locations will offer free haircuts to active duty U.S. service members and veterans on Veterans Day, November 11, 2023, with valid proof of service. Thank you for your service!” Head over here to see a list of participating locations.
Enjoy!

The Nutcracker
Based on a novel by 19th-century romantic fabulist E.T.A. Hoffman, The Nutcracker weaves a magical tale of holiday adventure around one of the most recognizable scores in the ballet repertoire. It begins when young Clara receives a nutcracker from her godfather, a wizardly toymaker named Drosselmeyer. Sneaking downstairs to see the toy after everyone else has gone to bed, she suddenly finds herself caught in the middle of a pitched battle between the toys and an army of mice. After saving the nutcracker with a well-thrown shoe to the Mouse King's head, Clara and her now-living prince venture into the Land of Snow and the Flowers to celebrate.
Throughout their adventures, Tchaikovsky's dazzling inventiveness propels the dances of nimble flowers and regal fairy queens. The "Waltz of the Snowflakes" floats weightlessly above the angelic voices, whereas the "Dance of the Sugarplum Fairy" tiptoes to the haunting, music-box chimes of a celesta. A medley of exotic national dances—including a Spanish bolero and Russian Trepak—add to the phantasmagoric celebration before the whole dream ends, as all dreams must.

posts.excerpt: Alicia’s Deals may receive a small commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here
posts.text:
Alicia’s Deals may receive a small commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here
The holidays will be here BEFORE WE KNOW IT! If you want to get some good cheer on the calendar, head over here to pick up discount tickets to see the Trans Siberian Orchestra on Sunday, December 3rd at 3 PM or 7:30. You'll pay $44.99 a ticket instead of $85, a full 47% off!
"Prepare for a musical journey like never before with Trans-Siberian Orchestra - a fusion of rock, classical, and holiday magic
Seating: 200 Level
To make sure group purchases are seated together, you must purchase your group's G-Passes in the same transaction and redeem your vouchers together at the venue.
G-Pass can only be redeemed on mobile app
Click here to view the seating chart
How G-Pass Works: Within an hour of purchase, your G-Pass will be in your account. Pull up the G-Pass on your mobile app. You may redeem your G-Pass via the mobile app and use it to enter the venue directly; you won’t need to redeem at will call. You will not be able to print a paper voucher for this event. Discount reflects the merchant’s current ticket prices - price may differ on day of event.
Trans-Siberian Orchestra - The Ghosts Of Christmas Eve
Trans-Siberian Orchestra (TSO) is a progressive rock band founded as an outlet for the many rock operas late rock industry veteran, producer, composer, and musician Paul O’Neill was writing.
TSO was created to push the boundaries of what was possible for a band to create – both musically and visually. Paul O’Neill dreamed of a different kind of “band” that is not limited by the confines of traditional rock acts and instead established one with multiple singers who could inhabit the various characters he was writing into his rock operas.
Although TSO is best known for their Capra-esque trilogy of holiday records – Christmas Eve & Other Stories, The Christmas Attic, and The Lost Christmas Eve – they have also released several other rock operas. Beethoven’s Last Night (2000) was the first of these non-holiday rock operas and tells a compelling tale of a battle for Beethoven’s soul between good and evil. It features instrumental crossovers between classical composers and contemporary rock, along with original vocal tracks featuring Patti Russo (Meatloaf) as the character Teresa, Beethoven’s love. Later albums take on great themes such as war and redemption, namely Night Castle (2009). Night Castle was TSO’s first Top 5 album debut and included a bonus track featuring Greg Lake (Emerson, Lake & Palmer, King Crimson), who was one of TSO’s greatest influences. Letters From The Labyrinth (2015) was another Top 10 release for TSO. In total, TSO has sold in excess of 12 million albums and DVDs.
Consistently one of the Top 25 touring acts in the country, TSO shows no signs of slowing down. Since its touring debut in 1999, TSO has played over 2,000 Winter Tour shows for more than 18 million fans. So far TSO has also donated over $18 million from these tours to local charities.
At the time of his passing, O’Neill had several TSO projects in various stages of completion at his recording studio in Florida. He also had two finalized rock operas: Romanov: When Kings Must Whisper, about the 1917 Russian Revolution, along with a live concert adaptation of Night Castle. O’Neill also planned to eventually bring the TSO experience to Broadway. Nearly 25 years after the release of their first album, Trans-Siberian Orchestra continues to create and live on."

posts.title: Did Your 5-10-Year-Old Child Miss the MathMagicians Summer Camp? Check Out Three FREE 1-Day Afternoon Programs Happening at the Civic Center Library July 10th, 11th, or 12th!
posts.excerpt: Kaitlyn Markham and Karina Zavari, founders of MathMagicians, had their first 1-week camp for 5-10-year-old kids with ADHD and/or Dyslexia a couple of weeks…
posts.text:
Kaitlyn Markham and Karina Zavari, founders of MathMagicians, had their first 1-week camp for 5-10-year-old kids with ADHD and/or Dyslexia a couple of weeks ago and it was a huge success...there was even a big waitlist! ABC 15 came by and did a story about the camp (you can see it here) and Good Morning Arizona interviewed the girls before the camp (you can see that interview here). The Catholic Sun wrote an article (you can see that here).
Because they were not able to accommodate all of the kids who wanted to participate, they are hosting three 1-day, 3-hour programs at the Civic Center Library (kudos to the Scottsdale Public Library for donating the space). The day camps will be held July 10th, 11th, or 12th from 2-5 PM. You can head over here to sign your child up for the day of your choice (space is limited). MathMagicians has a dedicated mentor, teachers helping them design the FUN curriculum, and a team of volunteers who are ready to share their love of math with the kids. There will be games, prizes, snacks, and lots of fun and learning for everyone in attendance! They are "on a mission to make learning fun and enjoyable for young kids by teaching them math through fun and interactive activities."
I was helping out at the camp checking kids in and out (full disclosure Kaitlyn is my daughter and Karina is her lovely friend) and one mom told me that her daughter did not want to go at first but came away saying it was the "best thing ever". Another mom said her son couldn't wait to get home and call his aunt to demonstrate his new division skills. The feedback was incredibly positive and the kids left saying they liked math more at the end of the week than they had at the beginning of the week.
Head over here to follow MathMagicians on Instagram!
Enjoy!

posts.title: Amazon Prime Members Can Get 2 Free Years of GrubHub+ PLUS 25% Off!
posts.excerpt: Alicia’s Deals may receive a small commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here
posts.text:
Alicia’s Deals may receive a small commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here
If you have Amazon Prime and like to have your food delivered, this is a deal you'll LOVE! Head over here to get TWO free years of GrubHub+. You'll avoid pesky delivery fees with the service. You can also use code 25FORDAD to get 25% off your purchase of $20 or more.
After the two-year promo period is over, your GrubHub+ account will renew for $9.99/month...I am making a note to cancel it.
Check out all of the facts:
"What is the Grubhub+ offer for Amazon Prime members?
Amazon Prime members can enjoy a one year trial of Grubhub+ (normally $9.99/month) with their Prime membership. Members that have received a one-year Grubhub+ Amazon Prime trial extension by email from Grubhub will have an additional 365 days from their previous trial expiration date to enjoy their free trial of Grubhub+ benefits through Amazon. As a special limited-time offer, Prime members who redeem June 5, 2023 through July 5, 2023, can also enjoy a total of 24 months of Grubhub+ for free. Prime members who redeem the offer July 6, 2023, or later will still receive 12 months of Grubhub+ for free.
What is included in the free trial of Grubhub+?
Grubhub+ is a monthly membership offering unlimited $0 delivery fees on orders of $12+ (before tax, tip, and fees) at eligible restaurants, access to exclusive member perks—like free food and order discounts—and donation matching. Only a paid subscription of Grubhub+ includes a monthly meal credit (value $10) for pickup orders. See the full Grubhub+ terms and conditions for more information.
How can I redeem my free trial of Grubhub+ membership?
Go to https://www.amazon.com/prime/offer/grubhub/prime-deal/ and click "Activate your Grubhub+ offer"
Sign in to Grubhub or create an account
Agree to the terms and conditions to connect your Prime and Grubhub accounts
Agree to share your Prime membership status with Grubhub
Start enjoying all the benefits of your Grubhub+ trial
What if I’m not a Prime member?
This offer is only available to current Prime members. To join Prime and redeem your Grubhub+ offer, you can sign up using the steps above, then experience all that Prime has to offer, including exclusive shopping, savings, and entertainment benefits.
What if I already have a Grubhub+ membership?
Existing Grubhub+ members are eligible for this offer. However, please note that the monthly meal credit of $10 for pick up orders for paid subscription members is not included in the trial offer. Follow the above steps to sign in or sign up for Prime, then connect to your Grubhub account to activate this offer. If you are participating in a paid Grubhub+ membership at the time of signup, your paid membership will be canceled and your free Grubhub+ trial will begin on the next calendar day immediately following the end of your then-current billing cycle.
Can I link my Prime account to a different Grubhub account?
You are only able to claim one Grubhub+ trial per email associated with an Amazon Prime account (including Amazon Prime Student accounts). If you already claimed a Grubhub+ trial by linking your Amazon Prime account with a Grubhub account that is associated with the same email address, then your Grubhub+ trial will apply to that Grubhub account only and cannot be transferred to other Grubhub accounts.
What if I cancel my Prime membership?
If you end your Prime membership you will lose your free access to Grubhub+. You can sign up for a standard Grubhub+ membership to continue receiving Grubhub+ benefits. If you choose to restart your Prime membership, you will need to redeem this offer again.
Who do I contact if I have an issue connecting my account?
First, verify that you are logged in to Amazon and that your Prime membership is active, then attempt to redeem the offer by visiting amazon.com/grubhub
For questions about your Prime membership, contact Amazon customer service.
For questions about your Grubhub account or Grubhub+ membership, contact Grubhub customer support.
What if I previously redeemed the Prime Student offer for a free Grubhub+ membership?
Prime Student members who have already redeemed the Grubhub+ Student offer will continue to receive free Grubhub+ until December 31, 2022. After that, you will be eligible to redeem this offer for an additional one year of Grubhub+ for free as long as this offer is available.
Will my Grubhub+ Amazon Prime Trial auto-renew with Grubhub after one year?
After your free trial of Grubhub+ ends, Grubhub will charge the payment method associated with your Grubhub account on a monthly basis at the then-current rate (currently $9.99/month). You can cancel any time by contacting Grubhub customer support or visiting the “Grubhub+ membership” section in your Grubhub account settings.
If you have received a 1-year extension on your Grubhub+ Amazon Prime Trial, you will have an additional 365 days from your previous expiration date before your preferred payment method is charged.
How do I cancel my Grubhub+ trial membership?
You will have free access to Grubhub+ with your Prime membership for one year (or two years if you received a one year extension or signed up between June 5, 2023 and July 5, 2023), but you can cancel at any time by visiting the “Grubhub+ membership” section in your Grubhub account settings. If you cancel your trial, your benefits will end immediately.
How do I unlink my Amazon and Grubhub accounts?
Note: Linked Amazon and Grubhub accounts are required to access your Prime Grubhub+ benefits. If you choose to restart your Grubhub+ membership through Prime, you will need to redeem this offer again.
To disconnect your Amazon account:
Visit Your Account on Amazon
Under Other programs, go to Login with Amazon
Select “Remove” next to Grubhub to disconnect your accounts
Will my personal data be shared between Amazon Prime and Grubhub?
By linking your Amazon and Grubhub accounts, you agree that Amazon will share your Prime membership status information with Grubhub for the purposes of enabling your Grubhub offer and that Grubhub may share offer redemption and/or cancellation information with Amazon.
What if my Amazon or Grubhub account is deleted?
Deletion of your Grubhub or Amazon account will result in the termination of your Grubhub+ trial. Currently, there isn’t a way to restore your Grubhub+ trial once your Grubhub or Amazon account is deleted. If you would like to rejoin Grubhub+, you can create a new Grubhub or Amazon account then redeem this offer again. Subject to Grubhub and Amazon terms of use."
Enjoy!

posts.title: Check Out Where You Can Get FREE Ice Cream Today From 3-5 Around the Valley!
posts.excerpt: TODAY (5/23) Wells Enterprises (the owner of Blue Bunny, Halo Top, Bomb Pop, and Blue Ribbon Classics) is hosting a huge ice cream social at multiple…
posts.text:
TODAY (5/23) Wells Enterprises (the owner of Blue Bunny, Halo Top, Bomb Pop, and Blue Ribbon Classics) is hosting a huge ice cream social at multiple locations! While supplies last starting at 3 PM (ending by 5) you can stop by the following locations for a FREE treat:
· " Desert Botanical Garden, 1201 N. Galvin Parkway, Phoenix
· Phoenix Zoo, 455 N. Galvin Parkway, Phoenix
· Tempe Public Library, 3500 S. Rural Road, Tempe
· OrangeTheory Fitness, 116 E. University Drive, Tempe
· Kiwanis Recreation Center, 611 S. All America Way, Tempe
· St. Luke’s Hospital, 1500 S. Mill Ave., Tempe
· Safeway, 1902 W. Main St., Mesa
· Safeway, 7920 E. Chaparral, Scottsdale
· Walmart, 800 E. Southern Ave., Tempe
· Walmart, 1380 W. Elliot Road, Tempe"
"PHOENIX (May 18, 2023) – Cool down with Wells Enterprises, the largest privately held ice cream manufacturer in the United States, as they hand out thousands of free ice cream treats at 15 ice cream social locations across the Valley from 3-5 p.m. Tues., May 23.
“As we look to ensure our national brands are available to consumers everywhere in the market, these free ice cream socials are a great example of how we strive to give back to the communities that support us. The Valley is certainly full of loyal ice cream enthusiasts who love our brands, and we want to bring our promise to life locally, creating a world where everyone can feel joy every day,” said Santhi Ramesh, Chief Commercial Officer.
Wells, which produces more than 200 million gallons of ice cream per year, will be passing out frozen novelties from its signature national brands, including Blue Bunny®, Halo Top®, the iconic Bomb Pop®, and Blue Ribbon Classics® as part of their pop-up ice cream social events.
The Iowa-based company is in town for a Dessert in the Desert national conference hosted at the Omni in Tempe, and the company is putting their own ice cream aficionados to work at these ice cream socials."
Thanks Charlotte!
Enjoy!

posts.title: FREE 1-Week Math Magicians Summer Camp for Kids 5-10 Years Old With ADHD or Dyslexia!
posts.excerpt: If you know a 5-10 year old with ADHD or Dyslexia, please let them know about an incredibly fun, FREE camp this summer that hopes to instill a lifelong love of…
posts.text:
If you know a 5-10 year old with ADHD or Dyslexia, please let them know about an incredibly fun, FREE camp this summer that hopes to instill a lifelong love of math. The "Math Magicians" camp will be held the week of June 12th-16th from 9-12 at the Franciscan Renewal Center in Paradise Valley. Two math-loving Xavier College Prep students (Karina Zaveri and Kaitlyn Markham) came up with the idea and were the recipients of the Dragon Kim Foundation Fellowship to put the program into action. They have a dedicated mentor, several special needs teachers helping them design the FUN curriculum, and a team of Xavier College Prep volunteers who are ready to share their love of math with the kids. Parents can head over here to sign their children up (there are a limited number of spots so they recommend signing up today)! Head over here to follow Math Magicians on Instagram! There will be games, prizes, snacks, and lots of fun and learning for everyone in attendance!
Full disclosure...Kaitlyn is my daughter and Karina is her lovely friend. They are truly passionate about math and helping children love it as much as they do. If you have any questions about the program, feel free to email them at kaitlynmarkhamdancer@gmail.com or kzaveri367@gmail.com.Quick update: The camp is getting close to capacity! If your child would enjoy this and you're available, I recommend signing up soon!
Enjoy (seriously this is going to be awesome)!

The heart and soul of Great Wolf Lodge Scottsdale is its gigantic indoor water park. Splashy rides such as Alberta Falls—a four-story double-raft water slide—and a zero-depth-entry wave pool with 3-foot swells surround the park's iconic hub: a four-story treehouse with a 1,000-gallon tipping bucket. Younger kids will have a blast with the water slides and gentle spray features of Whooping Hollow and Cub Paw Pool.
The water park, which hovers around 84 degrees all year long, isn't the resort's only family-friendly activity. You'll also find an arcade with more than 100 games and mini bowling at Ten Paw Alley.
