posts.text:
If you're thinking about going to the Phoenix Open, this deal is a NO BRAINER! Head over here to check out the offer at Desert Ridge and head over here to check out the offer at Tempe Marketplace. If you spend $300 in one day at either location you can get two FREE tickets to the Phoenix Open. I just called the Desert Ridge office and confirmed you CAN buy gift cards with the $300 if there's nothing you need this second (Desert Ridge has an Albertsons grocery store, a Target, a Nordstrom Rack, a Kohl's, and lots of other shops and restaurants you probably visit all the time). You could even buy a Visa gift card at Target and use it literally anywhere Visa is accepted. They said they have lots of tickets left (though they could go REALLY fast). I called Tempe Marketplace as well and they are getting lots of calls. They confirmed you can buy gift cards and recommend getting your tickets soon.
Head over here to check out the prices of General Admission tickets this year. If you bought at the Phoenix Open gate on Friday or Saturday you would have to shell out $200 for two tickets ($150 if you bought ahead of time).
Note: I would call ahead to make sure tickets are still available before you make a special trip.
Desert Ridge Marketplace directions: "Same day receipts totaling $300 or more can be redeemed at the Desert Ridge Marketplace Management Office located on the North side of The District between Dave & Buster’s and LensCrafters, Monday – Friday from 8am-5pm." The phone number for Desert Ridge Marketplace guest services is
(480) 513-7586. Must be 18 or older.
Tempe Marketplace directions: "Receipts can be redeemed at the Management Office, located near Harkins Theatres just north of Yogis Grill, Monday through Friday from 8am-5pm. Must be 18 or older. Other restrictions may apply. Call (480) 966-9338 for questions."

posts.title: LOVE THIS! Amazon Will Give Your Driver a $5 Bonus if You Say "Alexa, Thank My Driver" to Your Echo Device! No Cost to You!
posts.excerpt: If your Amazon driver has become your most frequent visitor, there's a way to say thank you at no cost to you. Say "Alexa, thank my driver" to your Echo device…
posts.text:
If your Amazon driver has become your most frequent visitor, there's a way to say thank you at no cost to you. Say "Alexa, thank my driver" to your Echo device and they'll receive a $5 bonus (plus they'll be notified that you thanked them).
Customers can say “Alexa, thank my driver,” and the driver of their most recent delivery will be notified of their gratitude.
Check out the details:
"Update: In response to the incredible impact of the celebratory promotion, in which we reached 1 million "thank yous" within 36 hours of launch, we are spreading even more joy, starting December 21. Eligible drivers will be offered $5 per "thank you" for another 1 million "thank yous.”
Since Amazon opened its digital doors in 1994, not only has selection grown, but so has the ability to deliver quickly and conveniently. So much so, that we hit a major package milestone—15 billion Amazon packages delivered in the U.S. But for drivers, it’s more than just the packages that they deliver—they form relationships with customers, provide support to the community in tough moments, and sometimes play the role of the unexpected hero.
We’ve heard many examples through social media, emails, phone calls, and when talking with friends and family. You can even read some of them for yourself. Now, we’ll provide customers with the opportunity to say thanks each and every day—with the help of Alexa. We developed an Alexa feature that allows customers to directly thank their drivers for making their deliveries. This new feature is available to U.S. customers with an Alexa-enabled device (Echo, Echo Show) or the Alexa or Amazon Shopping mobile apps, making it easy to thank drivers in the U.S. anywhere.
Starting December 7, any time a customer says “Alexa, thank my driver,” the driver who delivered their most recent package will be notified of the customer’s appreciation. And, in celebration of this new feature, with each thank-you received from customers, drivers will also receive an additional $5, at no cost to the customer. We’ll be doing this for the first 1 million thank-you’s received. And, the five drivers who receive the most customer “thank-you’s” during the promotional period, will also be rewarded with $10,000 and an additional $10,000 to their charity of choice.
We love hearing the countless stories from customers about the many ways delivery drivers make their lives better. We are excited for this new opportunity to thank these everyday heroes and giving our customers the ability to help us do it.
Amazon has a long-standing commitment to empowering and investing in delivery drivers. While this thank-you is another moment for us to express our gratitude, it certainly will not be the last, and we look forward to finding additional opportunities to celebrate the drivers who deliver smiles for customers.
Thank you, delivery drivers, for helping us deliver for customers this holiday season and every day."
I just thanked my driver!
LOVE THIS!

The Nutcracker
Based on a novel by 19th-century romantic fabulist E.T.A. Hoffman, The Nutcracker weaves a magical tale of holiday adventure around one of the most recognizable scores in the ballet repertoire. It begins when young Clara receives a nutcracker from her godfather, a wizardly toymaker named Drosselmeyer. Sneaking downstairs to see the toy after everyone else has gone to bed, she suddenly finds herself caught in the middle of a pitched battle between the toys and an army of mice. After saving the nutcracker with a well-thrown shoe to the Mouse King's head, Clara and her now-living prince venture into the Land of Snow and the Flowers to celebrate.
Throughout their adventures, Tchaikovsky's dazzling inventiveness propels the dances of nimble flowers and regal fairy queens. The "Waltz of the Snowflakes" floats weightlessly above the angelic voices, whereas the "Dance of the Sugarplum Fairy" tiptoes to the haunting, music-box chimes of a celesta. A medley of exotic national dances—including a Spanish bolero and Russian Trepak—add to the phantasmagoric celebration before the whole dream ends, as all dreams must."

posts.excerpt: I'm all about helping other people "live life better for less" and one thing that definitely makes my life better is AJ's iced tea. They're offering $1 teas…
posts.text:
I'm all about helping other people "live life better for less" and one thing that definitely makes my life better is AJ's iced tea. They're offering $1 teas for the rest of the summer (through 8/30)! Head over here for more information on their facebook page (and please follow Alicia's Deals on facebook while you're at it).
My personal favorite is the Coconut Pineapple Green Tea with a lemon slice. It's unsweetened and has a slightly tropical flavor. I used to drink Diet Coke all day, every day, and when I switched to AJs tea over a decade ago it's amazing how much better I felt! My children know me well and got me a refillable AJs Yeti Mug for my birthday...best gift ever!
I always call it "iced tea" and learned something new today on Mirriam-Webster.com: "Iced tea and iced coffee may eventually go the way of iced cream, which would mean some kicking and screaming (in the style of usage commentators, which is admittedly pretty tame). We have only to note how things changed between Richard Grant White's 1871 Words and Their Uses, Past and Present and Frank Vizetelly's 1906 A Desk-book of Errors in English. While White bemoaned how both ice-water and ice-cream had "[b]y mere carelessness in enunciation … come to be used for iced-water and iced cream," Vizetelly identified both as "so firmly established that it is doubtful if they will ever be changed." A few decades from now we may all be fully expecting ice tea at our lemonade stands."
Do you call it ice tea or iced tea? According to AJ's post the hashtag is "nationaliceteaday". All I know is however you spell it, it's absolutely wonderful (and full of antioxidants)!
Thanks so much for sending this over Alison!
Enjoy and I hope I'll see you at AJ's!

posts.title: Free Fishing Day is This Saturday, June 4th in Arizona!
posts.excerpt: If you've ever had any desire to fish, Saturday, June 4th is the perfect day to give it a try. It's free fishing day in AZ (you won't need a license)!
posts.text:
If you've ever had any desire to fish, Saturday, June 4th is the perfect day to give it a try. It's free fishing day in AZ (you won't need a license)!
Check out more information on their website:
"PHOENIX — The Arizona Game and Fish Department (AZGFD) invites anglers to fish Arizona waters for free Saturday, June 4. It’s an ideal time to take the family out for some fun and relaxing outdoor recreation.
Fishing is already a bargain. Arizona fishing licenses start at just $37 for residents 18 and older. A combination hunt and fish license for youths (10-17) are only $5. Arizona’s Free Fishing Day is celebrated as part of National Fishing and Boating Week. As an incentive, a fishing license is not required Saturday for persons fishing any public waters in Arizona.
“Whether you’re a seasoned angler who wants to introduce a newcomer to the sport, or someone who’s always been interested but never took that next step, this is the perfect time to get outdoors and experience what fishing in Arizona is all about,” said Julie Carter, aquatic wildlife branch chief.
While a fishing license is not needed Saturday, bag limits and other fishing regulations still apply and must be observed on Free Fishing Day. Children under 10 can fish for free all year long in Arizona, so this special fishing license exemption means that older kids and parents get a free pass for the day, as well.
Not sure how to fish and want to learn? Check out AZGFD’s learn to fish video series. Then, once you’re hooked, remember to purchase a fishing license.
The purchase of a fishing license directly contributes to state conservation programs, including fisheries management, habitat protection and fishing education. A portion of all fishing and boating supplies, as well as license and registration sales, fund the conservation and preservation of our nation’s waterways through a program called the Sport Fish Restoration Program. This means every time an angler purchases a fishing license, fishing tackle, boat supplies, or registers a boat, that person is helping to improve the natural places that he or she cherishes.
Anglers can also share their fishing success stories and photos to the AZGFD FishAZ Facebook group, as well as connect with other anglers around the state. "
Enjoy!

posts.title: Are You Even Thinking About Joining Amazon Prime? The Price Goes Up February 17th! Save Now and See ALL of the Benefits Included...Make Sure You're Getting the Most for your Membership Buck!
posts.excerpt: Alicia’s Deals may receive a small commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here.
posts.text:
Alicia’s Deals may receive a small commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here.
If you're even thinking about joining Amazon Prime, head over here to get a 12-month membership for $119. On February 17th the price goes up to $139. If your renewal is coming up, your renewal price goes up on March 25th.
Keep in mind that you can also head over here to find out how to save half off Prime if you receive government benefits or are on EBT!
If you're trying to figure out if a Prime membership is worth it to your family, check out the benefits:
"Delivery benefits
FREE Two-Day Delivery: Millions of items delivered fast and free.
FREE One-Day Delivery: Available on more than 10 million items with no minimum purchase.
FREE Same-Day Delivery: Available, in select areas, on over 3 million items for qualifying orders over $35. Order in the morning, typically before noon, and get your items by 9 p.m.
FREE Ultrafast Grocery Delivery: Get free two-hour delivery on a wide selection of groceries, including meat, seafood, produce, snacks and household essentials. Check availability in your area.
Prescription Delivery and Savings: Enjoy fast, FREE Two-Day Delivery on prescriptions from Amazon Pharmacy, plus exclusive savings when paying without insurance.
FREE Release-Date Delivery: Be among the first to get new video games, books, music, movies and more. Choose Release-Date Delivery on qualified items and receive your package by 7 p.m. on that date.
FREE No-Rush Shipping: Don't need your Prime order right away? Select No-Rush Shipping and earn rewards for future purchases. Learn how it works.
Amazon Day: Simply pick a day that works for you, shop with Amazon Day throughout the week, and we'll deliver orders together on the day you choose.
Amazon Key: Get your packages conveniently delivered for free inside your garage. Check your eligibility.
Streaming and digital benefits
Prime Video: Watch exclusive Amazon Originals and thousands of popular movies and TV shows — all at no extra cost. Watch at home or on the go with practically any device.
Prime Video Channels: Watch your favorite shows and movies from HBO, SHOWTIME and STARZ channels — no cable required, cancel anytime and no additional apps to download. $4.99–$14.99/month for Prime members.
Amazon Music Prime: Access 2 million songs, ad-free, plus millions of podcast episodes — included with your Prime membership. Listen on any Echo device and take your music and podcasts anywhere with offline listening.
Amazon Music Unlimited: Get unlimited access to over 70 million songs and millions of podcast episodes. Listen to any song, anywhere, ad-free. Save 20% now with your Prime membership.
Prime Gaming: Get free games to keep, in-game content for your favorite games across all available devices, and a Twitch channel subscription — all free each month.
Amazon Photos: Back up and share your photos with unlimited, full-resolution photo storage. Add your photos in the free apps and view them on all your devices.
Amazon Kids+: All-in-one subscription that gives kids access to thousands of kid-friendly books, movies, educational apps and games on compatible devices. Prime members get up to a 40% discount.
Want more? Here is a guide to connecting your devices to Prime entertainment.
Shopping benefits
Prime Member Deals at Whole Foods Market: Exclusive discounts and offers on qualifying item(s) for Prime members in-store and online.
Prime Day: Annual two-day shopping event exclusive for Prime members delivering incredible savings and deep discounts on over one million deals across every category.
Prime Exclusive Deals: Enjoy deals every day on thousands of items available only to Prime members.
Amazon Prime Rewards Visa Signature Card: Earn 5% back at Amazon.com and Whole Foods Market, and at least 1% back on all other purchases.
Amazon Prime Store Card: Earn 5% back every day on Amazon.com purchases and access exclusive promotional financing offers.
Amazon Prime Secured Card: Build your credit while earning 2% back on Amazon.com, Amazon Fresh and more.
Prime Early Access: Get 30-minute early access to Lightning Deals on Amazon.com.
Prime Try Before You Buy: Try on clothes, shoes, jewelry and accessories from the comfort of your home with no upfront charge, and pay only for what you keep.
Personal Shopper by Prime Try Before You Buy: Styling service for men’s and women’s fashion exclusively for Prime members — just $4.99 per styling.
Amazon 4-star and Amazon Books Stores: Prime members pay Amazon.com prices on all products in-store.
Prime-Exclusive Shipping Benefits on Woot!: Prime members get free standard shipping on all Woot! orders and free express shipping on Shirt.Woot purchases.
Reading benefits
Prime Reading: Get unlimited access on any device to more than a thousand eBooks, popular magazines, comics, and more. Learn more about Prime Reading.
Amazon First Reads: Read next month's new releases today. Each month, Prime members can download one editors' pick for free — before the official publication date. Downloaded titles are yours to keep.
Discounted Print Magazine Subscriptions: Get select 4-month magazine subscriptions for only $0.99 each.
Other benefits
Share Your Prime Benefits: Link your account with one other adult to share shipping, streaming access to movies and TV shows, Prime Reading and more for free.
Free Shipping at shopbop: Enjoy free two-day shipping and next day shipping at shopbop.com.
Free Titles at Audible: Prime members are invited to start an Audible Premium Plus trial with 2 credits that can be used on any titles.
Free Upgraded Shipping at Zappos: Get free expedited shipping on all Zappos orders."
For our family, the free shipping, free books (by the way you can get TWO this month in Amazon First), and Amazon Prime Video (we really loved Reacher if you haven't seen it) make the service worth it. I'm really interested in finding out more about sharing my Prime benefits and what's involved with that.
My friend Juli at Bargain Believer had a good idea if your membership renews AFTER March 25th...buy YOURSELF a gift membership for $119 before the price goes up. I'm thinking you'd probably have to cancel first then buy a new membership with the "gift" but it is worth a shot. If it doesn't work for whatever reason (I can't find a place that says this is against the rules), you can always exchange the membership for a $119 Amazon gift card.
"You can buy a one-year Prime gift membership for $119 or a three-month Prime gift membership for $39 (excluding tax).
To buy a Prime gift membership:
Go to Give the gift of Prime.
Choose a membership type and select Add Prime to Cart.
In your cart, select proceed to checkout.
Enter the recipient's email address, the desired delivery date, and your personalized gift message.
Select Save gift option.
Follow the on-screen instructions.
Your recipient receives a gift notification email on the scheduled delivery date. This includes instructions on how to redeem the gift.
Note:
Your recipient can only redeem the Prime membership on Amazon.com. They can't transfer the Prime membership to another Amazon website.
If your recipient is already an Amazon Prime or Amazon Student member or doesn't want to use the Prime membership, they can exchange their gift for an Amazon.com Gift Card. The Amazon.com Gift Card will have a value equal to the original cost of the Prime membership gift (including sales tax). See Exchange a Prime Gift Membership.
You can't currently give monthly or Prime Video memberships as a gift."
Please let me know if you'll renew your Amazon Prime membership this year!
Enjoy!

posts.excerpt: Alicia’s Deals may receive a small commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here.
posts.text:
Alicia’s Deals may receive a small commission via affiliate links in this post. Please see my full disclosure here.
If you've ever wanted to go on a hot air balloon ride, you might as well try the best out there. Head over here to save over 50% off a trip with Arizona Balloon Safaris. You'll pay $165 today for one or $329 for two with Groupon. Champagne brunch is included and there are dates open starting in March. This would be a great bucket list check-off gift idea!
"What’s included: hot air balloon ride with champagne breakfast including orange juice, bottled water, croissant, sausage, vegetable quiche and seasonal fresh fruit. Served upon landing.
Departure location: 29834 N Cave Creek Rd, Cave Creek AZ
Age restriction: must be age 6 and over to participate
What to bring: closed-toe shoes, dress for the day’s weather
Fine Print
Promotional value expires 90 days after purchase. Amount paid never expires. Must be 6 or older. 48-hour cancellation notice required. Online reservation required. Not valid for pregnant women. Rides are shared with other passengers. May purchase multiple. May be repurchased every 30 days. Limit 1 per visit. Valid only for option purchased. Merchant is solely responsible to purchasers for the care and quality of the advertised goods and services. Offer is not eligible for our promo codes or other discounts.
About Arizona Balloon Safaris
When Randy Long and his family recently went on spring break, they didn't laze around on a beach staring at the sea. Instead, they trekked around the world to China. The choice of destination isn't surprising given Randy's extraordinarily adventurous spirit—the former travel agent has trotted the globe a few times, dog sledding in Alaska and scuba diving in Bermuda along the way.
Despite his eagerness to explore, Randy probably surprised even himself when he was caught by an unexpected wave of inspiration during a 1986 Rotary Club meeting in Illinois. When hot air balloonist Harold Lovelace spoke to the club, Randy was so transfixed that he immediately offered to buy one of Harold's balloons. By the end of the year, Randy had his pilot's license, was flying in the world's largest hot air balloon event, and became a pro at photo-bombing the portraits of landscape artists. Within five years, he sold his travel agency and set up shop in Arizona as a full-time balloon pilot.
Since founding Arizona Balloon Safaris, Randy has maintained a perfect flight record, successfully piloting more than 2,000 flights for more than 20,000 passengers (including Shakira and J.W. Marriott). His colorful balloons ride the Sonoran Desert's breezes, gently carrying passengers as far as seven miles while maintaining a feeling of near motionlessness. From any corner of the balloons' sturdy wicker baskets, people can scan all 360 degrees of the desert panorama without a single visual interruption. Whether skimming the tops of cacti or reaching the flight's 5,000-foot apex, groups will likely spot—and sometimes hear—deer, coyote, and jackrabbits during the 45-minute ride. Passengers can bring a camera to take pictures of these sights along the way. Upon landing, the chase crew welcomes groups back to Earth with celebratory glasses of champagne."
Enjoy!

posts.excerpt: Our country has a huge shortage of blood right now and Krispy Kreme wants to help make it more delicious to donate! Give blood 1/24-1/31 and bring your proof…
posts.text:
Our country has a huge shortage of blood right now and Krispy Kreme wants to help make it more delicious to donate! Give blood 1/24-1/31 and bring your proof of donation to the participating Krispy Kreme closest to you to get a FREE dozen original glazed doughnuts. Head over here for more information or see below:
"With the nation facing its worst blood shortage in over a decade, Krispy Kreme wanted to find a way to show our support for those willing to roll up a sleeve and give blood during January, National Blood Donor Month. For one week, 1/24 – 1/31, anyone who donates blood or platelets will receive a free Original Glazed® dozen. It’s our way of helping the American Red Cross increase awareness of this urgent need and saying “thanks” to those who step up to help their community.
Here’s how it works: Give blood any time between 1/24 – 1/31, then stop by your local Krispy Kreme for your free Original Glazed® dozen. Just show your proof of donation and date via your donor band or sticker, or flash your donor app.
Click Here to learn more about the American Red Cross and to find your closest donation site.DONATE NOW
FAQS
WHERE CAN I GIVE BLOOD?
Click Here to find your closest American Red Cross donation site and book your appointment online!
WHO CAN GIVE BLOOD?
Click Here to access the American Red Cross site to see if you are able to give blood.
WHAT IF I CAN'T BOOK AN APPOINTMENT BETWEEN 1/24 – 1/31?
Appointment availability is updated regularly; continue to check the site for openings by Clicking Here. We can only give a free dozen to those who give blood between 1/24 – 1/31, but we encourage you to donate when you can to help combat the national blood shortage.
DO BLOOD DONATIONS TO ORGANIZATIONS OTHER THAN THE AMERICAN RED CROSS QUALIFY FOR A FREE DOZEN?
Yes! Just show your proof of donation and date via your donor band or sticker, or flash your donor app.
WHEN CAN I REDEEM MY FREE DOZEN?
The free Original Glazed® dozen with proof of blood donation must be redeemed between 1/24 – 1/31. Qualifying blood donation must also be completed between 1/24 – 1/31.
WHAT IS THE LIMIT FOR THE BLOOD DONATION OFFER?
Each individual guest who qualifies is limited to one (1) Original Glazed® dozen per blood donation, no purchased required.
WHERE CAN I REDEEM THIS OFFER?
This offer can be redeemed while in a Krispy Kreme shop or drive-thru. This offer is not available through online ordering or at grocery or convenience stores.
IS THIS OFFERED AT ALL LOCATIONS?
Offer is valid at participating US locations only."
Please donate if you can and enjoy the doughnuts!

posts.title: FREE 10-Minute Test That Might Help You Understand Yourself and Important People Around You Better!
posts.excerpt: I truly believe that when we understand where people close to us are coming from, we'll get along better and live happier lives. This week my daughter…
posts.text:
I truly believe that when we understand where people close to us are coming from, we'll get along better and live happier lives. This week my daughter volunteered to be a part of an AP research project for a teammate. Each volunteer took a free 10-minute personality test (in case you're curious, the purpose of the project is to measure if one personality type is best at learning choreography quickly).
After she took the test, I decided to take it too (you can check it out here). I remember taking the same test several years ago and re-taking it was very helpful. My personality type is ESFJ (there are 16 unique types). My daughter's type is different from mine and the descriptions of why we do things the way we do were spot on. We already get along very well, but it's so helpful as a parent to remember that people look at the world through different lenses. I have to get the rest of my family to take it now!
This is not a diagnosis by any means and I’m not affiliated with their site, I just really appreciated the information and think it can help me be a better parent, wife, sister, friend, etc.! I hope this free test helps you understand yourself and the people most important to you too! I'm all about self-improvement in 2022!
Enjoy!

Based on a novel by 19th-century romantic fabulist E.T.A. Hoffman, The Nutcracker weaves a magical tale of holiday adventure around one of the most recognizable scores in the ballet repertoire. It begins when young Clara receives a nutcracker from her godfather, a wizardly toymaker named Drosselmeyer. Sneaking downstairs to see the toy after everyone else has gone to bed, she suddenly finds herself caught in the middle of a pitched battle between the toys and an army of mice. After saving the nutcracker with a well-thrown shoe to the Mouse King’s head, Clara and her now-living prince venture into the Land of Snow and the Land of Sweets to celebrate.
Throughout their adventures, Tchaikovsky’s dazzling inventiveness propels the dances of nimble flowers and regal fairy queens. The “Waltz of the Snowflakes” floats weightlessly above the angelic voices of a youth choir, whereas the “Dance of the Sugarplum Fairy” tiptoes to the haunting, music-box chimes of a celesta. BJ’s Restaurants: Current and former military who dine in-restaurant on November 11th will enjoy a complimentary meal from the select menu (see here) and a Dr. Pepper beverage.
California Pizza Kitchen: "This Thursday, November 11th, all veterans and active-duty service members will receive a complimentary beverage + choice of one entrée. As a special Thank You, dine-in and receive an exclusive offer for you to use on your next visit from November 12th-20th, 2021."

Dunkin’ Donuts: All active duty military and veterans can enjoy a free donut on 11/11!
Great Clips: "While not all of us have served in the military ourselves, most of us know a service member who we would like to thank. With Great Clips’ annual promotion, we give everyone a way to thank an active or veteran military service member on Veterans Day. And we give members of the military more than a one-day event to redeem their free haircut card.
This year on Veterans Day – Thursday, November 11 – veterans and active military members can visit a U.S. Great Clips salon and receive either a free haircut that day or a free haircut card. They will receive a free haircut card they can give to an active service member or veteran as a way of saying thank you. The cards can be redeemed for a free haircut from November 12 through December 10, 2021."
Logan’s Roadhouse: "This Veterans Day, we’re inviting all veterans, active duty and retired U.S. military personnel to enjoy a free meal* between 3-6 p.m. from our American Roadhouse menu at participating locations."

About This Deal

Must redeem together to sit together.

The Nutcracker
Based on a novel by 19th-century romantic fabulist E.T.A. Hoffman, The Nutcracker weaves a magical tale of holiday adventure around one of the most recognizable scores in the ballet repertoire. It begins when young Clara receives a nutcracker from her godfather, a wizardly toymaker named Drosselmeyer. Sneaking downstairs to see the toy after everyone else has gone to bed, she suddenly finds herself caught in the middle of a pitched battle between the toys and an army of mice. After saving the nutcracker with a well-thrown shoe to the Mouse King’s head, Clara and her now-living prince venture into the Land of Snow and the Flowers to celebrate.
Throughout their adventures, Tchaikovsky’s dazzling inventiveness propels the dances of nimble flowers and regal fairy queens. The “Waltz of the Snowflakes” floats weightlessly above the angelic voices, whereas the “Dance of the Sugarplum Fairy” tiptoes to the haunting, music-box chimes of a celesta. A medley of exotic national dances—including a Spanish bolero and Russian Trepak—add to the phantasmagoric celebration before the whole dream ends, as all dreams must."
Enjoy the show!

posts.text:
If you missed the Arizona State Fair last year you'll be happy to know you can enjoy it again this year! They are open Wednesday-Sunday through October 30th at the Arizona State Fairgrounds (1826 West McDowell Road). They aren't having big concerts this year, but there will be plenty of fried everything. If you want to enjoy the fun and avoid paying a ton, check out these deals:
We Care Wednesday is happening October 6th, 13th, 20th, and 27th. You can enjoy free admission (usually $10 for adults) when you bring in 10 donation items. Head over here for more information.
Everyone 55 and better can enjoy up to two free tickets on October 13th. Head over here for more information, you must head over here to request your tickets with the special password 21FAIRFUN.
If you have kids 5-14, make sure you head over here to print out the Read and Ride report form. If they read 3 books, they'll get 3 free rides. You'll bring the completed form to the Guest Services booth, I've done this with my daughter the last several years and it has been great!
Let me know if you hear of other ways to save!
Enjoy!

Thanks so much for tuning into my 3TV Your Life Arizona segment featuring the top three money-saving apps I love!
If you haven’t already, I hope you’ll join the totally FREE Alicia’s Deals e-mail list here (unsubscribe at any time). Please tell a friend about my site too so we can all “live life better for less” together. You can also find out first about the latest and greatest bargains when you follow Alicia’s Deals on Instagram and “like” Alicia’s Deals on Facebook.
One of my favorite things about my iPhone is how much money it has saved me! Today I'm sharing my top three favorite apps that can help you save too!
Get Upside: Get Upside is an app I was kind of leery about but it actually works really well! Head over here and use my promo code (G72P6) to get an EXTRA $.25/gallon in cashback the first time you check into the app before you buy gas at select gas stations close to you. That's in addition to the $.15/gallon cash back you'll get every day! Most Shell and Circle K stations near me participate. They pay the Get Upside App for getting you to go to their station, and Get Upside shares most of that money back with you. If you start saving $3 every time you get gas (possibly $8 the first time you fill up), that can really add up! They also offer cashback at restaurants like Popeye's and more. It's easy to cash out on Paypal or with gift cards, and the savings are excellent.
Sprouts: I've always loved shopping at Sprouts for their produce, now I love it for their freebies too! Head over here to get signed up for their exclusive sampling program. You'll get up to five full-size items FOR FREE every month just for clipping coupons on the app and showing your barcode at the register. They also regularly offer special coupons that can make a big difference to the price you pay. Make sure you have the app on your phone too, head over here to get it.
Ibotta: I mention this grocery-saving app every week on my favorite deals at the grocery stores post I write each Wednesday. I truly think it makes grocery shopping more fun. Head over here to get the app and start saving at Safeway, Fry's, Albertsons, Walmart, Target, Costco, and tons of other stores you go to all the time. They offer cash back on select items, you buy them, scan the barcodes and take a picture of your receipt, and they give you cashback. It's really simple once you get the hang of it and you'll get a $10 bonus the first time you use it! This is one of the only apps I've found that often gives money back on produce, meat, and dairy, not just name brands! The average user saves $150 a year, that's some significant savings on things probably already in your cart. This money back is in addition to coupons, sales, and other stores apps. I just got $5 back for buying probiotics at Costco that I was already getting!

posts.excerpt: Saturday, September 25th is National Public Lands Day and it's one of the free entrance days for national parks! If you can't make it this weekend, mark your…
posts.text:

Check out the press release they sent over:
"Creamistry, the liquid nitrogen sweet shop that creates custom frozen desserts before guests’ eyes, is celebrating the grand opening of its latest location with a free small ice cream for each guest from noon to 2:00 p.m. on Saturday, September 18. Located at 1235 North 98th Avenue in Park West, Peoria’s premier dining and entertainment center located, this is Creamistry’s first West Valley store.
Former Arizona Cardinal player Andre Wadsworth and real estate professional Ryan Zeleznak, who co-own and operate Arizona’s Creamistry locations, selected Park West for their latest location as they feel it meets a need for fresh, custom ice cream creations in the West Valley.
“With each new Creamistry we open, we look for a dynamic, highly populated and energetic location, which we’ve found in Park West,” says Wadsworth. “We look forward to becoming a part of the West Valley community’s celebrations and everyday occasions for years to come.”
Creamistry uses high-quality premium ingredients with more than 20 flavors and a wide variety of topping options including natural and organic selections such as non-dairy water-based sorbet and gluten-free, egg-free vegan coconut and cashew. Flavor choices include Cap’N Crunch, Fruity Pebbles, Birthday Cake, Cookie Butter, Matcha Green Tea, Reese’s Peanut Butter, Ruby Cacao, Taro and Nutella as well as classics such as Caramel, Chocolate, Madagascar Vanilla Bean, Mint, Sea Salt Caramel and Strawberry.
Toppings and upgrades include mini gummy bears, mini marshmallows, Heath bar, Reese’s Peanut Butter Cups, freshly baked brownie bites, cookie dough bites, cheesecake bites, “unicorn dust,” fresh fruits and nuts, sauces such as caramel, chocolate fudge and strawberry sundae and savory items like candied bacon, chamoy and Tajin. Signature creations, premium ice cream cakes and grab-and-go items round out the selections at Creamistry.
Strategically located in front of the open-air shopping center’s splash pad, the new Creamistry store offers families, shoppers and ice cream lovers of all ages the same fresh and innovative made-to-order liquid-nitrogen ice cream creations as the other Creamistry locations in the Valley of the Sun — including one in North Scottsdale and one in Gilbert.
Creamistry Park West is open daily from noon to 9:00 p.m. For more, visit www.creamistry.com."
Thanks Charlotte and Susie!

posts.title: FREE Slice for Past and Present Military Members for 13 Days at NYPD Pizza!
posts.excerpt: The images coming out of the last weeks in Afghanistan have been difficult for my family to watch as I'm sure they've been for all Americans. I can only…
posts.text:
The images coming out of the last weeks in Afghanistan have been difficult for my family to watch as I'm sure they've been for all Americans. I can only imagine how the brave men and women who have given so much to defend our country are feeling. NYPD Pizza is doing something to honor past and present military men and women. Check out what they just posted on their facebook page:
"In honor of the 13 service members who lost their lives in the Kabul airport terrorist attack, we are keeping a table reserved in their honor at our Avondale location. And because it’s our honor to serve so many that have risked it all for our country and our families, the NYPD family wants to treat any military member - past or present - to their first slice. For the next 13 days with ID because we will never forget and we are always grateful. #Foodislove Nikki West, CEO"
Nikki is in a group called Vistage with my husband and she has become a friend of mine. She is truly one of the most deeply caring individuals you will meet.
Here's the story behind the deal that she said I could share:
"FREE PIZZA and a surprise for military at NY for next 13 days..here is why: Yesterday it happened. I was in line at a chick fil a and he walked in ahead of me. His wife struggling with two young kids, a dog, and a mother-in-law. I saw how his hair was cut, the tats, and recognized the stance. I saw how the hustle and bustle affected him and how he instinctively moved so his back was against a wall and he could watch the door. So I quietly asked - Marines? He smiled knowingly at me and said “no ma’am Navy but just left a bunch of Marines”. I instantly thanked him for his service and waited for the normal response of “thank you for your support”. Instead I saw tears and emptiness at once and he did thank me but added “it’s just really hard right now. Just happy to be home for now”. Gut check friends. So I sneakily bought their lunch, hugged the wife who cried quietly when I said I was praying for them, and told the kids their daddy was a hero. And I went and told my team what had happened and this is what we decided to do. So if you’re inclined - please spread the word. Never forgotten and always grateful. Thank you."
Please share with any military men and women you know!

posts.text:
Thanks so much for tuning into my 3TV Your Life Arizona segment featuring my top four happy hour deals around town! If you haven’t already, I hope you’ll join the totally FREE Alicia’s Deals e-mail list here (unsubscribe at any time). Please tell a friend about my site too so we can all “live life better for less” together. You can also find out first about the latest and greatest bargains when you follow Alicia’s Deals on Instagram and “like” Alicia’s Deals on Facebook.
If you keep tabs on what day and time you're going out on the town, you can save a TON of money! Check out my top four happy hours for serious savings (and fun)!
Pita Jungle- If you're ever anywhere near a Pita Jungle from 3-6 any day of the week, I definitely recommend stopping in. The whole family can enjoy amazing tapas for as low as $2 at select locations (I would call before you make a special trip, thanks to Alicia's Deals reader Jenny who let me know the Queen Creek location does not participate in tapas deals), the food is excellent and healthy! Happy hour is good throughout the restaurant and there are great drink specials too for everyone 21 and up.
Postino- The time of day makes a HUGE difference to the price you'll pay at Postino. Glasses of wine and pitchers of beer are just $5 until 5 PM. Also, mark your calendar for Monday and Tuesday nights. After 8 PM you can get a full bottle of house wine and a board of bruschetta for just $25 total.
Roaring Fork - I've always enjoyed the Happy Hour at The Roaring Fork in Scottsdale! From 4-6 PM you can enjoy $6 glasses of wine, $7 cocktails, and discounts on their delicious food. The Roaring Fork "Big Ass" Burger is huge and delicious!
Buck and Rider- I saved my favorite Happy Hour spot for last. Every day from 3-7 in the patio bar, Abby's Oyster bar, and alcove you can enjoy delicious food and drink specials. They fly in their seafood each day so it's incredibly fresh, and at happy hour you can enjoy oysters for $2.25 each and Wild Mexican Shrimp for $2.50 each.
Enjoy and cheers!

posts.title: Big Sunscreen Recall...Check Yours Now!
posts.excerpt: In case you haven't checked the news today, Johnson & Johnson issued a recall on five popular sunscreens. Head over here to see their full press release.
posts.text:
In case you haven't checked the news today, Johnson & Johnson issued a recall on five popular sunscreens. Head over here to see their full press release.
They identified benzene in some samples, a human carcinogen. The affected products are:
"NEUTROGENA® Beach Defense® aerosol sunscreen,
NEUTROGENA® Cool Dry Sport aerosol sunscreen,
NEUTROGENA® Invisible Daily™ defense aerosol sunscreen,
NEUTROGENA® Ultra Sheer® aerosol sunscreen, and
AVEENO® Protect + Refresh aerosol sunscreen."
"Consumers should stop using these specific products and appropriately discard them. Consumers may contact the JJCI Consumer Care Center 24/7 with questions or to request a refund by calling 1-800-458-1673. Consumers should contact their physician or healthcare provider if they have any questions, concerns or have experienced any problems related to using these aerosol sunscreen products. JJCI is also notifying its distributors and retailers by letter and is arranging for returns of all recalled products."
Sunscreen is so critical in AZ, you'll definitely want to make sure yours is not on the list.
Ugh!

About Your Great Wolf Lodge Getaway

See additional details regarding room occupancy, water park passes, and more in the Other Details section below. See FAQs here.
Property at a Glance: Great Wolf Lodge Scottsdale
The heart and soul of Great Wolf Lodge Scottsdale is its gigantic indoor water park. Splashy rides such as Alberta Falls—a four-story double-raft water slide—and a zero-depth-entry wave pool with 3-foot swells surround the park’s iconic hub: a four-story treehouse with a 1,000-gallon tipping bucket. Younger kids will have a blast with the water slides and gentle spray features of Whooping Hollow and Cub Paw Pool.
The water park, which hovers around 84 degrees all year long, isn’t the resort’s only family-friendly activity. You’ll also find an arcade with more than 100 games and mini bowling at Ten Paw Alley.
Extended water park access: You can enter the water park at 1 p.m. on the day you check in and stay until close on the day you check out (essentially 2 days’ water park admission).
Family-friendly fun: There are plenty of games and activities for kids of all ages. Explore all activities by age group here.
Hands-on crafts and activities such as face painting and balloon twisting during the Lunch Time Lineup can entertain young children when they want a break from the water park action.
Roomy suites comfortably sleep up to eight people. The Wolf Den suite provides extra privacy with enclosed bunk beds.
Where to eat: There are nine restaurants and snack bars.
Add a Paw Pass or Pup Pass to your stay to enjoy kid-friendly activities and sweets at Creation Station, MagiQuest, and more at a discounted rate. See everything that’s included—as well as other available packages—here (additional fees apply).
Safety first: Complimentary life jackets in multiple sizes and trained lifeguards help keep families safe and secure."

posts.title: SMOKING HOT Staycation Deal in Mesa...Stay Two Nights and Get $100 to Spend on Activities or Services and $50 to Spend at a Restaurant of Your Choice!
posts.excerpt: Disclosure: This is a post sponsored by Visit Mesa. It is a FANTASTIC deal for all of us in AZ and I was so excited they asked me to share it with you!
posts.text:
Disclosure: This is a post sponsored by Visit Mesa. It is a FANTASTIC deal for all of us in AZ and I was so excited they asked me to share it with you!
If you're excited for a little getaway close to home, Visit Mesa has a phenomenal deal going on right now for Arizona residents. For stays now through December 30th you can enjoy a $100 gift card to spend on the Mesa activity of your choice and a $50 gift card to spend at the Mesa restaurant of your choice when you stay in any participating hotel for two nights. Whether you're looking for a relaxing escape, a family fun weekend, or an adventure, this deal is incredible! You'll book your hotel on your own for at least two nights (there are 53 hotels available to fit any budget, I saw one option for as low as $53/night) then head over here to sign up for the escape you're looking for (click "book now" under the escape you want). With this form, you can request your $100 gift card for the activity of your choice and your $50 gift card for the restaurant of your choice. You'll pick up your gift cards at the Mesa Visitors Center (they're open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM by appointment). You must bring proof of Arizona residency and they will confirm your booking. This could be the perfect little vacation you need right now. There are so many options, there is something for everyone. This is definitely a win/win, a way for us to enjoy a much needed SAFE getaway while supporting local business!
I put together the places to stay, things to do, and spots to eat in Mesa that I'm most excited about.
Places to stay in Mesa:
Saguaro Lake Guest Ranch: "At Saguaro Lake Ranch, an Arizona guest ranch located by Saguaro Lake, on the banks of the Salt River, in the shadow of the majestic Bulldog Cliffs - life is simple. Sun-filled days, exciting adventures, idyllic star-lit nights and good company combine to create a vacation, destination wedding, or corporate event that will live long in the memory. Our 20 rustic cabins with panoramic views of a wilderness made famous by the writings of Zane Grey, and outdoor activities to suit everyone, make our property a true oasis in Arizona's Sonoran Desert." Head over here to check out some pretty incredible reviews on Trip Advisor. This is DEFINITELY on my list of places I'd love to visit.
Delta Hotels by Marriott: This is a Mesa hotel I've stayed at for a dance convention. My daughter and I had a great time. The beds are comfy, it's close to restaurants, it has a nice pool and spa, and the people are friendly.
Also worth noting: "A multi-million dollar, full-scale renovation has just been completed on the Marriott Phoenix Mesa, located in the heart of Downtown Mesa, Arizona. The property officially rebranded and became Delta Hotels by Marriott Phoenix Mesa on October 3, 2018. The renovation included all 274 guestrooms and suites, flexible meeting space, lobby and common areas, as well as the property’s two dining venues Café Azul and AZ Brew.
Newly, refreshed interiors throughout all 274 guest rooms, corridors, lobby and common areas feature a color palette and textiles embracing the desert, its flora, fauna, skies, minerals, sunrises and sunsets. Guest rooms have been equipped with a new television entertainment package and high-speed internet upgrade." Head over here to check out reviews on Trip Advisor.
Sheraton Mesa Hotel at Wrigleyville West: This hotel is close to shopping, restaurants, and lots of fun activities. "The hotel’s 180 elegantly-appointed guest rooms, including 51 Junior Suites and 8 VIP suites each featuring plush furnishings, modern amenities, and thoughtful touches for both leisure and business travelers. Enjoy La Plancha Grill for dinner or Stats Sports Grill for breakfast, lunch or dinner. The hotel’s one-acre resort-style pool area has two swimming pools, two plunge pools, a hot tub, poolside services and modern fire and water features throughout. Make time for a workout in the state-of-the-art Sheraton Fit­ness center or to be pampered in the full-service salon." Head over here to check out Trip Advisor reviews.
Things to do in Mesa:
Desert Belle Cruises: "Sit back and relax on this 90-minute narrated cruise where you'll see towering canyon walls, dramatic desert vistas, and exotic Arizona wildlife. Listen as the captain describes the unique history of Saguaro Lake and the surrounding area. Don't forget your camera and binoculars." I went on this several years ago and had a great time!
The Arizona Commemorative Air Force Museum: "Commemorative Air Force Airbase Arizona is dedicated to preserving the history of those who served in military aviation. Worthwhile exhibits and presentations are more than hardware or weapons — they are about the people who went in harm’s way or who rose to countless challenges behind the front lines or from the home front." This is the #1 rated thing to do in Mesa on Trip Advisor, head over here to check out reviews from people who have been.
Cosmos Salon and Med Spa: If a day at the spa sounds fantastic, you may want to request your $100 gift card to Cosmos in Mesa. They offer hair and nail services, facials, peels, lash services, even Botox! It's a beautiful salon located in a beautiful part of Mesa very close to Las Sendas.
Places to eat in Mesa:
Organ Stop Pizza: If you live in AZ and you've never been here, you're missing out! The food is delicious and the music is truly incredible. "A rare find that is entertaining for all generations, Organ Stop is a must see, (and hear) experience. Featuring the largest Wurlitzer Theater Pipe Organ in the world, the master musicians play everything from Bach to rock while customers dine on delicious pizza, pasta, salad, soft drinks, beer, wine and delicious ice cream!"
The Original Blue Adobe Grill: They say this is "the place you hope to find in your travels." Lucky for us it's close by! "New Mexico cuisine with fresh ingredients, specialties include the Land of Enchantment combo with marinated tenderloin, pecan grilled chipotle shrimp, chicken enchilada and green chili potato, chicken verde, and shrimp rotelle." Delicious!
Board & Batten: "Board & Batten prides itself on using the best ingredients possible when preparing our cuisine. Executive Chef Tony Snyder utlilizes fresh, locally grown produce and ingredients. " The menu looks amazing, I can't wait to try it out!
There are so many other great hotels, activities, and restaurants in Mesa that you can also choose.
"RULES & RESTRICTIONS
Escape to Mesa Vacation Packages are available to any Arizona resident that has a confirmed booking for a two-night or more stay in Mesa from September 1, 2020 to December 30, 2020 or while supplies last which may occur before this date. Hotel bookings must be for Mesa, Arizona hotels only; does not apply to vacation rentals or RV stays (ex: VRBO, AirBNB).
This offer is not valid for hotel stays that have previously been booked and/or reserved prior to Sept. 1. Incentive applies to new hotel bookings in Mesa only, reserved on or after September 1, 2020 and will only be available while supplies last. (Check-in must be verified by Visit Mesa staff)
HOW TO OBTAIN GIFT CARDS AFTER BOOKING HOTEL:
• Register your upcoming stay in Mesa online and make your gift card selection by clicking on one of the themed packages: Weekend Warrior, Family Fun and Relaxation Retreat.
• Visit Mesa Concierge staff will contact you up to 5 days prior to your arrival to confirm selections and estimated check-in time.
• If your arrival day is M-F, we recommend you check into your host hotel THEN proceed to the Mesa Visitors Center to claim your incentive gift card. Our visitors center is open M-F, 8 AM - 5 PM by appointment only. Please alert us when you plan to arrive to our office by calling 480-682-3666. Visit Mesa Concierge staff are required to confirm your hotel booking prior to releasing any gift cards.
• If your arrival day is outside of regular business hours, Visit Mesa Concierge staff will arrange to leave your gift cards/vouchers at your host hotel. The host hotel will only release gift cards AFTER you have checked in for you stay. Please work with Visit Mesa Concierge staff on additional details/arrangements.
• Check in at the Mesa Visitors Center (120 N. Center St, Mesa AZ 85201) during regular business hours (M-F, 8am-5pm)
~ Show Arizona Driver’s License or other form of Arizona ID (water bill, energy bill, etc.)
~ Show booking receipt or digital email confirmation
If the experience/restaurant you are seeking is not listed on VisitMesa.com, please inform Visit Mesa with your selection on your submission form. Gift cards/vouchers must be for Mesa, Arizona-based establishments only.
Gift cards cannot be for cash equivalent (ex: VISA, MC, AMEX). Offer is not transferable. Contact name listed on hotel reservation booking receipt must be the same contact on the Visit Mesa registration form; must show valid I.D. matching booking reservation to collect gift cards/vouchers applicable to the Escape to Mesa Vacation Packages campaign."
Enjoy!

If you're thinking about taking the family out this weekend, keep in mind that the Wildlife World Zoo and Aquarium is now open! Head over here to save big on tickets, Groupon has adult tickets on sale for $30.99 (usually $39.99) and child tickets on sale for $16.99 (usually $19.99). Use code SAVE to get 20% off (it will say the code is expired but should give you an extra discount anyway)! The extra 20% off brings kids tickets down to $13.59 and adult tickets down to $24.79. Check out their Covid safety information:
"With the Grand Reopening, there will be several safety measures and operational changes at the Zoo, including required masks for staff and visitors, informative signage throughout the zoo encouraging safety/social distancing, social distance ride seating, along with complete ride sanitation after every rider and dozens of sanitizing stations installed throughout the 100-acres. “We are grateful for the continued support from the public, even while our gates have been closed. It brings me much joy, that the time has come that we can responsibly reopen and provide our guests with a safe environment to bring their loved ones”, says Director Mickey Ollson. The Sky Ride, African Tram, Safari Train, all Indoor Exhibits, the Petting Zoo, the Giraffe Feeding Station & Stingray Touch Tank will be open. Wildlife World’s standards are subject to change based on recommendations from the state and municipal public health officials."
"What You'll Get
What’s included: admission, access to public feedings, and Wildlife Encounter Shows
Child admission is valid for ages 3–12.
Free admission for children aged 2 and under.
Younger than 18 must be accompanied by a guardian.
Onsite cafeteria: yes, there are several cafes located in various areas.
Amenities: gift shops, stroller rental, wheelchair rental
Transportation: free parking available
The Fine Print
Promotional value expires Jan 18, 2021. Amount paid never expires. Not valid until June 5th, 2020. Younger than 18 must be accompanied by guardian. Child ticket is only valid for ages 3-12. Age 2 and under are free. Limit 5 per person, may buy 10 additional as gift(s). Valid only for option purchased. Merchant is solely responsible to purchasers for the care and quality of the advertised goods and services.
About Wildlife World Zoo, Aquarium & Safari Park
The giraffe smells a food pellet. He pokes his head just over the railing and starts sniffing for the guest holding his treat. Not far off, some brightly plumed parrots land on another visitor’s arm, spying the tasty apple slices in her hand. Though you can’t get this close to every animal at Wildlife World Zoo & Aquarium—such as the lions and the wild Larry Fitzgeralds—the keepers do facilitate animal-human exchanges as often as possible with the zoo’s more than 600 species. They also give visitors novel views of some exhibits by welcoming them aboard the Skyride, the Australian boat ride, and the African train safari. The adjacent aquarium adds to the zoo’s impressive animal collection, housing more than 75 exhibits and enough water to start a new earth colony.
Further attractions include a children’s petting zoo, daily shows, and a baby-animal nursery. At the 15-acre Safari Park, guests stroll or ride the tram through animal habitats, where they can spy on species that live on the other side of the equator. Wildlife World also features two restaurants where guests can feed themselves and their own helpless progeny."
Enjoy!

"Where are these multivitamins coming from?
The Arizona Department of Health Services has approved these multivitamins and mails them out free of charge to help keep Arizona women healthy.
Are the multivitamins really free?
Yes! The multivitamins come from the Arizona Department of Health Services, which created PowerMeA2Z to improve women’s health. To reach as many women as possible, we have made the multivitamins free and easy to order. These multivitamins are completely free of charge with no hidden costs.
When will I get my multivitamins in the mail?
Your multivitamins will arrive in 5-6 weeks – they typically arrive even sooner than that. Please use the contact page to check the status of your shipment if your package does not arrive in 6 weeks.
Why do I need to take a multivitamin with folic acid?
You know vitamins do great things for your body that you can’t see. But did you know that they also help with everyday things you CAN see and feel? A daily multivitamin needs to have folic acid in it because it does lots of important things for women’s health! Start feeling the difference with free vitamins.
Looking for strong, shiny hair and nails? Vitamins with folic acid help.
Want beautiful, clear skin? Vitamins with folic acid help prevent acne and give your skin a smooth texture that glows.
Reduce or eliminate PMS symptoms.
Have the energy you need to succeed.
Prevent sickness and disease now and for years to come. Taking a daily multivitamin can significantly reduce your risk of heart disease, colon cancer, memory loss, and more. They also prevent certain birth defects when you’re ready for children."

posts.title: The Maricopa County Summer Reading Program is BACK!
posts.excerpt: I have always been a huge fan of the Maricopa County summer reading program and I'm happy to report it is not a casualty of Covid-19! Pre-readers, kids, teens,…
posts.text:
I have always been a huge fan of the Maricopa County summer reading program and I'm happy to report it is not a casualty of Covid-19! Pre-readers, kids, teens, and adults can head over here to join and start logging reading minutes.
You'll be able to pick up prizes in August at your local libraries!
"Maricopa County Reads is the award-winning summer reading program provided by the Maricopa County Library District to all public, tribal and military base libraries within Maricopa County. The primary goal of the program is to interrupt the summer slide, the common term given to the learning loss experienced by children while transitioning between school years. The secondary aim of the program is to promote early literacy among pre-readers and their families during the summer months.
Several approaches are employed to accomplish these goals:
Interrupt the Summer Slide
Keep kids reading every day so they will not lose the reading comprehension skills that they learned during the school year.
Read for 20 minutes a day! Reading 20 minutes a day will help build a lifelong habit of reading.
Kids and adults can both count the minutes when adults read to children or kids read to adults!
Advance Early Literacy Skills
Conduct early literacy education programs for children and their caregivers.
Encourage teens and adults to read with children and model independent reading behaviors.
Encourage caregivers to engage in early literacy activities with children.
Build Home Libraries
Read for 20 minutes a day, every day over the summer and earn a free book!
Free books are available for all ages, from babies to adults.
You can donate your book to a child if you do not want to keep it.
Emphasize the Fun of Reading
Attend fun, literacy-based events at the library to earn digital badges and gain points towards your goal of unlocking a free book!
Have fun interacting with the online program by completing challenges and earning digital badges.
Connect Readers with Community Experiences
Visit a community partner to learn something new and earn secret codes to unlock badges and earn more points.
Try a community experience to connect your kids with books in a more meaningful way by bringing things to life that they have only read about.
The Maricopa County Reads online summer reading program began in the summer of 2013. It has continued to grow, and now hosts all 67 public, tribal and military base libraries within Maricopa County. More than 80,000 children, teens, and adults participate in the program annually."
Enjoy!

posts.title: Don't Miss the Luke Airforce Base 15-Aircraft Flyover Friday Starting at 3:10 to Honor Covid-19 Responders! Check Out the Map!
posts.excerpt: This is AWESOME and definitely something we won't want to miss! Head over here to check out the flight path of the 15-aircraft flyover happening Friday, May…
posts.text:
This is AWESOME and definitely something we won't want to miss! Head over here to check out the flight path of the 15-aircraft flyover happening Friday, May 1st starting at 3:10 PM and lasting 50 minutes.
Check out the details:
"Luke Air Force Base, to include the 56th Fighter Wing and the 944th Fighter Wing, along with the Arizona National Guard 161st Air Refueling Wing will honor Arizona's front line COVID-19 responders with a community flyover May 1, 2020."We are honored to extend our heartfelt gratitude to all the healthcare workers, first responders, military members and other essential personnel who are working on the front lines to combat the coronavirus," said Brig. Gen. Todd Canterbury, 56th Fighter Wing commander. "We want everyone to be able to look up from their homes and enjoy the display of American airpower, resolve and pride while keeping frontline defenders in their hearts." A formation of 15 aircraft, including seven F-35A Lightning IIs and seven F-16 Fighting Falcons flying out of Luke Air Force Base and one KC-135 from the 161st ARW will begin the flyover at approximately 3:10 p.m. local and will last 50 minutes. The flight path will bring them through Buckeye, Luke Air Force Base, Litchfield Park, Surprise, Waddell, Goodyear, Tolleson, Phoenix Metro, Tempe, Chandler, Gilbert, Mesa, Scottsdale, Deer Valley, Glendale, Peoria, Sun City West, and El Mirage. Residents along the flight path can expect a few seconds of jet noise as the aircraft pass overhead. posts.title: McDonalds is Giving Healthcare Workers and First Responders a Free Meal Each Day Through May 5th With ID!
posts.excerpt: McDonalds is recognizing the first responders and healthcare workers that are keeping us as healthy as possible during this crazy time. Through May 5th they…
posts.text:
McDonalds is recognizing the first responders and healthcare workers that are keeping us as healthy as possible during this crazy time. Through May 5th they can stop in for a free breakfast, lunch, or dinner (one meal per day). Head over here for all of the details.
"Thank You meal Frequently Asked Questions
What’s included in a McDonald’s Thank You meal?
During breakfast hours, first responders and healthcare workers can choose from an Egg McMuffin®, Chicken McGriddles® or a Bacon, Egg and Cheese Biscuit. All of these options also come with any size soft drink, tea or hot coffee and Hash Browns.
In the afternoon and evening, first responders and healthcare workers will have the choice of a Double Cheeseburger, 6 Piece McNuggets® or a Filet-O-Fish®. All of these options also come with any size soft drink, tea or hot coffee and small World Famous Fries®. Choices may vary by restaurant.
Who qualifies to receive a McDonald’s Thank You meal?
First responders and healthcare workers can receive their free Thank You meal via carry out and drive thru at participating McDonald’s restaurants by simply showing a work badge.
How can qualified individuals get a McDonald’s Thank You meal? Is it available nationally?
First responders and healthcare workers can get a Thank You meal by showing their work badge in the drive thru or through carry out at participating restaurants.
Is the McDonald’s Thank You meal available on McDelivery® through Uber Eats or DoorDash?
The Thank You meal is not available through McDelivery®. First responders and healthcare workers can receive their free Thank You meal via carry out and drive thru at participating McDonald’s restaurants by simply showing a work badge.
Is the McDonald’s Thank You meal be available for Mobile Order and Pay?
McDonald’s Thank You meal is not available through Mobile Order and Pay on the McDonald’s Global Mobile App. First responders and healthcare workers can visit a participating McDonald’s restaurant to redeem their free Thank You meal by presenting their work badge at the drive thru window or during carry out.
How long will McDonald’s be distributing Thank You meals?
Participating McDonald’s in the US are distributing Thank You meals to first responders and healthcare workers with a work badge beginning Wednesday, April 22 through Tuesday, May 5.
How much does a McDonald’s Thank You meal cost?
McDonald’s Thank You meals are free of charge for first responders and healthcare workers. Qualified individuals can redeem their free Thank You meal by showing their work badge via carry out or drive thru at participating McDonald’s restaurants nationwide.
How many Thank you meals can be given to each customer?
First responders and healthcare workers can enjoy one (1) Thank You meal per qualified customer per day. Qualified recipients include those first responders and healthcare workers and who show their work badge at carry out and drive thru at participating locations nationwide.
Are qualified recipients allowed to customize their McDonald’s Thank You meal?
Thank You meal choices cannot be substituted or customized at this time. First responders and healthcare workers will be able to choose from several meal options.
Thank You meal breakfast options include an Egg McMuffin® meal, Chicken McGriddles® meal or a Bacon, Egg and Cheese Biscuit meal. All of these options also come with any size soft drink, tea or hot coffee and Hash Browns.
McDonald's is also offering three Thank You meal lunch/dinner options – Double Cheeseburger meal, 6 Piece McNuggets® meal or a Filet-O-Fish® meal. All of these options also come with any size soft drink, tea or hot coffee and small World Famous Fries®.
How often can qualified recipients receive a Thank You meal?
Qualified recipients may redeem one (1) free Thank You meal per person, per day, upon showing their badge when ordering McDonald’s for carry out or in the drive thru.
Is there a toy included in the Thank You meal?
Rather than including a toy, each Thank You meal box will include a dedicated thank you note to first responders and healthcare workers, as a way to show our appreciation for everything they are doing to keep our communities safe during the COVID-19 pandemic.
Are Thank You meals available all day?
Beginning Wednesday, April 22 through Tuesday, May 5, first responders and healthcare workers who show a work badge will be able to receive their free Thank You meal at participating McDonald’s restaurants during their current normal business hours."
Enjoy!

posts.title: WOW! Tide Is Offering FREE Laundry Services for Front Line Responders (There are Many Phoenix Area Locations Participating)!
posts.excerpt: This has to be one of the BEST freebies I've seen for front line responders. Tide is offering FREE laundry services through their Loads of Hope program. Head…
posts.text:
This has to be one of the BEST freebies I've seen for front line responders. Tide is offering FREE laundry services through their Loads of Hope program. Head over here for all of the details.
"How it Works
How to bring in clothing - We request that all Front Line Responders and Family members separate dry cleaning from laundry before you come to Tide Cleaners – keeping dry cleaning and laundry separate will significantly help our ability to fulfill cleaning quickly. Please bring your garments in a bag, a standard trash bag is acceptable. Limit of four (13 gallon) bags per household per week. Feel free to put name, phone number, and email in bag.
Turnaround Time for Clothes – Turnaround time for laundry and dry cleaning is 2 days. Depending on demand, we can and will assess whether we need to modify turnaround time to earlier or later. Tide Cleaners is working to assist as many in need as possible, which could impact turnaround time and capacity. Once we reach capacity, we will let guests know that we are unable to accept any further loads for that day, but they can return the following day to see if they can have their laundry done.
Exclusions – The following items are not accepted and / or included in offer: COVID-19 exposed clothing (e.g. worn while directly treating patients), leathers, wedding dresses, alterations, and select household items.
Limits – At this time we are only able to accept a limit of four (13 gallon) bags per household per week. Once we reach capacity for the site, we will let guests know that we are unable to accept any further loads that day. However, they can return the following day to have their laundry cleaned.
*We are not able to accept garments or linens that are used in the field for hospitals or fire stations. Please refrain from bringing these garments to the store.
Free Laundry (jeans, shorts, t-shirts, socks, etc.) and Dry Cleaning for Front Line Responders and their immediate family, to help lighten the load
Participating Locations - Guests drop off and pick up clothes at any participating Tide Cleaners store locations. Please see the section below for different Service Solutions for these markets."

If you have questions about COVID-19 or if you're eligible to be tested, Governor Ducey's office has launched a new 2-1-1 line (available in English or Spanish). "The hotline is a result of a partnership between 2-1-1 Arizona, the Crisis Response Network, the Governor’s Office, the Arizona Department of Economic Security and the Arizona Department of Health Services. The line will respond to calls in English and Spanish and will provide important information, including:
How to prepare for and prevent COVID-19 spread,
Testing information for COVID-19,
What populations are at higher risk from the COVID-19,
What to do if an individual gets sick,
COVID-19 and animals,
And a list of websites with accurate, reliable and up-to-date information.
The line will operate from 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. each day of the week and can be reached by dialing 2-1-1 while an individual is located in Arizona." Thanks Trisha! Be well!

posts.title: Amazing $12 Family Meal Deals for 6 from NYPD Pizza (Less Than Their Cost) and Free Kids Meals All Day Every Day With Adult Entree Purchase!
posts.excerpt: Nikki West, the CEO of NYPD Pizza is one of the kindest human beings I know. Check out how she's helping our community (you can read her full facebook post…
posts.text:
Nikki West, the CEO of NYPD Pizza is one of the kindest human beings I know. Check out how she's helping our community (you can read her full facebook post here):
"To our Valued Guests,
We know this is a stressful and trying time for all of us. We purposefully didn’t send out an email prior out of respect for your inbox. We have a longstanding excellent record with our health department and our commitment to cleanliness and food safety has never been stronger. Yes-we have absolutely added extra measures to ensure the well being of our team members and our guests and will continue to do so. A detailed list is on our website should anyone need to review it.
Right now, our primary focus along with the health and safety of our guests and team is how to best serve our community that we are so privileged to serve. Accordingly, I wanted you to know that beginning immediately, we are offering curbside pick up along with our delivery service. We have reduced capacity in our dining rooms and will continue to monitor that unless mandated otherwise. But most importantly, we are a locally owned company run by local families. We understand that kids out of school means more meals to prepare and, in some cases, more expenses that were not expected.
From today forward, our Kids Eat Free offer is valid every day and all day. It is now valid for dine in or pick up and we ask that should any family have children that relied on school meals and find themselves needing a meal, please come see us.
Additionally, we know what our grocery aisles look like. So, starting Wednesday, March 18, we will be offering our Family Pasta and Marinara as well as Family Baked Ziti for $12.00 each. It feeds up to 6 people and we are selling them at or below what our cost is.
We hope that you will allow us the honor of feeding and serving you and your families. For over 20 years we have prided ourselves on our kitchen being yours and thank you for your continued support. We have the best guests and we know that together we will get through this time.
Nikki West, CEO and the entire NYPD Pizza family. #Foodislove"
Thank you so much Nikki!
Enjoy!

posts.title: Celebrate National Crepe Day With FREE Nutella or Parisian Crepes Sunday Morning from 10-12 at The Crepe Club Fashion Square!
posts.excerpt: National Crepe Day is this Sunday, February 2nd! Check out the deal they just sent me for all of us to enjoy:
posts.text:
National Crepe Day is this Sunday, February 2nd! Check out the deal they just sent me for all of us to enjoy:
"In the French tradition of La Chandeleur (Jour de Crepe), guests will be able to get a FREE Nutella or Parisian (butter and sugar) crepe or half-off breakfast crepes at The Crepe Club in Scottsdale Fashion Square Mall from 10am-12pm. The offer is limited to one per person and not available through third party deliveries.
National Crepe Day originated from the Catholic holiday of Candlemas, when the Virgin Mary presented the baby Jesus. Over the years it became known in France as “jour de crepes” – or Crepe Day – perhaps because the Pope at the time was known for feeding crepes to the pilgrims who visited the church.
Tradition says that those who can successfully flip a crepe in a pan while holding a coin in one hand will be prosperous for the rest of the year. Thankfully, guests will not need luck – or a coin – to enjoy a crepe on February 2."

posts.title: Military and First Responders Get Into the Phoenix Open FOR FREE...Plus Free Tickets With Purchase at Safeway for All, and More!
posts.excerpt: The Phoenix Open officially starts today! Everyone gets in FREE today and tomorrow (1/28) for Ford Free Days. Keep in mind that kids under 17 get in free with…
posts.text:
The Phoenix Open officially starts today! Everyone gets in FREE today and tomorrow (1/28) for Ford Free Days. Keep in mind that kids under 17 get in free with an adult.
If you know someone who has served in the military or as a first responder (EMT, firefighter, or police officer), let them know that they can head over here to get a FREE voucher for themselves and a guest.
"FREE TOURNAMENT ADMISSION FOR FIRST RESPONDERS AND U.S. MILITARY
The Waste Management Phoenix Open tournament hosts, The Thunderbirds, invite all First Responders, as well as all Active, Reserve, Veterans and Retired U.S. Military personnel, plus one accompanying individual, to be their guests (free of charge) at the 2020 Waste Management Phoenix Open. This marks the 19th year The Thunderbirds have extended this small gesture of thanks to the heroes who’ve given so much for our country.
TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THE FREE ADMISSION OFFER:
You must verify your status through Sheer ID.
Eligible personnel must present their official ID or badge along with ticket voucher at the main tournament entrance.
Business cards and pay stubs will not be accepted as forms of ID.
Tickets are limited to two per day, per each official ID.
Standard tournament spectator policies will be in enforced, including no firearms allowed."
"As a further compliment to Military personnel, the Birdies for the Brave Patriots Outpost hospitality tent will be available Wednesday through Sunday of tournament week. Located on the 18th hole near the tee box, all Active, Reserve, Veterans and Retired U.S. Military can invite one guest to enjoy complimentary food and beverages while watching PGA TOUR golf in a relaxed and comfortable setting.
To ensure that all our military heroes can experience the Birdies for the Brave Patriots Outpost, official military ID’s must be presented at the Outpost entrance and the one guest maximum will be strictly enforced."
If you stop by Safeway you can get a free ticket with purchase of $50 of participating alcohol and other products (look for signs).
Head over here for more information about how to get two free general admission passes from Desert Ridge Marketplace or here for information about how to get the freebies from Tempe Marketplace when you spend $300 in one day. I love to buy gift cards at Target or other stores I shop at with this promotion. You could even buy yourself a Visa gift card! It’s definitely a deal, Friday and Saturday Phoenix Open passes are $60 EACH (you’ll save $120)!
NOTE: They are running very low on tickets so I would definitely call ahead before you make a special trip.
I am most excited about the freebies for the brave men and women who have sacrificed serving our country!
Enjoy!

Zoppé, An Italian Family Circus
With authentic roots in the Old-World Italian tradition since 1842, this one-ring circus features astounding acrobatics, equestrian showmanship and of course, Nino The Clown. Lauded by the New York Times for evoking the circuses of picture books, the ballasting Zoppé family of acrobats and daredevils engages audiences in a storytelling show, warming eyes and dazzling hearts with sweetness and stunts. Accordions, clarinets, and enthused clapping score the show as Nino the Clown performs pratfalls and trapeze artists scare off bats during the high-flying act. Held in the spectacular 500-seat tent on the grounds of the Chandler Center for the Arts, the Zoppé Circus invites modern families into a Felliniesque experience free of bothersome subtitles. Bring friends and family for this delightfully fun circus extravaganza."
