"Looking for something fun to do this summer? Keep that spark of curiosity burning brightly at Arizona Science Center, where -- during the summer only -- kids can learn the science behind "Grossology: The (Impolite) Science of the Human Body." While exploring interactive challenges, visitors will come face-to-face with the science behind various bodily functions and medical conditions.
• $40 ($100 value) for a Summer Family Pass for 4 people (valid May 25 to Sept. 7)
• Includes 2 tickets to "Grossology: The (Impolite) Science of the Human Body"exhibition
• Check the schedule for exciting live demos, which change daily
On a Mission to Inspire, Educate & Engage!
This Washington Street exploration station is open daily and packs four levels of interactive exhibits with more than 300 hands-on activities. You and your family will learn about the solar system, compare different brains, and experience a high-wire physics lesson -- and that's just scratching the surface. Located in the Sybil B. Harrington Galleries, "Grossology: The (Impolite) Science of the Human Body," runs through Monday, September 7. The exhibition lets kids get their hands dirty while discovering all the biological reasons behind things like runny noses, body odor, and more unappealing bodily functions. They'll be totally grossed out as they explore hands-on, interactive elements -- like becoming a dust particle to learn about sneezing, pumping soda into a cartoon character to understand burps, and sliding through the digestive system to see what it all looks like from the inside out."

You can head over here to get Pogo Passes for just $39.98 each with code ALICIA (usually $99.95). They are the best value around and are good for a FULL YEAR! “This was one of the best purchases we’ve made! So much fun stuff to do with family for a great price!! I even bought 2 for my college aged daughter and her boyfriend to have dates–They are struggling students. thank you SO much Alicia for this deal. We have great family memories. Here’s what’s included:
Each pass holder will enjoy one general admission ticket to Sunsplash during the year. Opening Day is May 16th! General admission tickets are usually $29.99. Head over here for hours and days they’ll be open and for more information about the park!
Castles and Coasters: Each Pogo Pass holder recieves one (1) visit to Castles~n~Coasters for a *Silver Pass (worth $29.99). This includes unlimited rides and mini golf.We went and had SUCH a wonderful day! We even got to enjoy the ropes course! The kids have been talking about the place non stop.

Arizona Diamondbacks: One (1) ticket per game per pass holder for two (2) home games at Chase Field for the MLB Regular Season.

posts.excerpt: If you're looking for some fun, educational experiences this summer, head over here to save big on Biosphere 2 tickets. Use code EPIC3 to get an extra 20% off…
posts.text:
If you're looking for some fun, educational experiences this summer, head over here to save big on Biosphere 2 tickets. Use code EPIC3 to get an extra 20% off (through Tuesday)! Two people will pay $20.80 instead of $51 with the code!
"In 1984, Space Biospheres Ventures purchased a few unassuming acres north of Tucson in the shadow the Santa Catalina Mountains. There, the company expanded its sci-fi-sounding activities—the development of space-colonization technology—and built what would evolve into Biosphere 2, recently seen on The Today Show.
Designed to re-create Earth's ecosystems, the gigantic glass enclosure (some 7.2 million cubic feet and 91 feet tall in some parts) is famous for housing biospherians in the 1990s. The researchers lived completely sealed inside for extended periods, giving scientists groundbreaking data on human survivability and interaction with particular bionetworks.
The University of Arizona had the 40-acre Biosphere 2 campus donated in 2011, maintaining it as a hub of serious research while expanding its mission to encompass interactive educational outreach. Each year, thousands pass through the on-site labs and classrooms as well as stroll the Biosphere 2 interior to view films, experience multimedia exhibits, or embark on guided tours. Tours venture into the actual ecosystems, allowing earthlings to note biodiversity, smell fresh precipitation in the rain forest, and savor the softness of savannah grassland underfoot until the resident grumpy old man yells at you to get the heck off his lawn. Before their dramatic conclusion at a million-gallon ocean tank, tours delve into the basement to explore the technosphere, where visitors can witness the deep inhales and exhales of the sphere’s respiratory system."
Enjoy!

posts.title: Chipotle Shared Their Guacamole Recipe...For Free!
posts.excerpt: Love Chipotle guacamole? You're in luck! I was so excited to see that they SHARED their recipe on their facebook page!
posts.text:
Love Chipotle guacamole? You're in luck! I was so excited to see that they SHARED their recipe on their facebook page!
"Ingredients:
2 ripe Hass avocados
2 tsp lime juice
2 tbsp cilantro (chopped)
1/4 cup red onion (finely chopped)
1/2 jalapeño, including seeds (finely chopped)
1/4 tsp kosher salt
1. Choose the right avocado: squishy yet firm with a nice dark green color on the inside.
2. Cut the avocado in half and remove the pit.
3. Scoop the avocados and place in a medium-sized bowl.
4. Toss and coat with lime juice.
5. Add the salt and using a fork or potato masher, mash until a smooth consistency.
6. Fold in the remaining ingredients and mix well.
7. Taste the guacamole; adjust seasoning if necessary."
Another Chipotle tip: I always get a single taco (it's way less expensive and won't completely kill your diet). Bonus: It's only $.75 to add guacamole to a single taco (if they look at you like you're nuts tell them there IS a single taco guacamole add button on the register)!
:-)

"Upcoming Tipsy Tow Service Periods:
Cinco de Mayo
6 p.m. Tuesday, May 5 through 6 a.m. Wednesday, May 6
Memorial Day
6 p.m. Sunday, May 24 through 6 a.m. Monday, March 25
What is Tipsy Tow?
Tipsy Tow is a free one-way ride tow home, up to 10 miles, for drivers, and one of their passengers, who have been drinking.
Who can participate?
Tipsy Tow is a public service that serves everyone – not just members!
Anyone can call for a “tipsy tow” – drivers, passengers, bartenders, party-hosts, or even restaurant managers.
When is Tipsy Tow offered?
Tipsy Tow is offered when Arizona experiences the highest volume of DUI arrest and alcohol-related crashes – during holidays and special events, such as Memorial Day, Fourth of July and even Super Bowl Sunday.
The service is typically offered from 6 p.m. to 6 a.m. on the service day.
Where is Tipsy Tow available?
Tipsy Tow is available throughout the state of Arizona.
How can I take advantage of the Tipsy Tow service?
To get a “tipsy tow” for yourself or someone you know who has too much to drink, call 1-800-AAA-HELP (1-800-222-4357) on a service day and state you need a “tipsy tow.”
Provide the driver’s name, home address, phone number and vehicle/driver location.
How much does a Tipsy Tow cost?
Tipsy Tow is free, up to 10 miles. For trips longer than 10 miles, motorists can expect to be charged the towing company’s standard rate.
What else do I need to know about Tipsy Tow?
Tipsy Tow is available as capacity dictates. Be aware that higher call volumes could result in longer wait times.
Tipsy Tow service will not be provided to motorists requesting a tow to another drinking establishment or to a destination other than their home. A tow to a hotel may be allowed if the motorists is, or plans to become, a guest.
The service does not offer light service duties, such as vehicle starts, flat tire change, battery replacement, gas delivery and/or taxi service."
It's important to have a safe ride home, but it's nice to know this service is available in case you know someone who needs it!

posts.title: Free Drug Test Kits from Not My Kid in Honor of 4/20!
posts.excerpt: This could be one of the most important deals I've talked about in a very long time. It's 4/20 and if you don't already know that means it's National Weed Day.…
posts.text:
This could be one of the most important deals I've talked about in a very long time. It's 4/20 and if you don't already know that means it's National Weed Day. This is the day that many young people will try marijuana for the first time.
Drug abuse has affected a family member close to me and I know how destructive it can be (and how common it is for young people to move from weed to heroin, an epidemic problem in our state).
Many parents don't think their children are interested in drugs but the peer pressure out there is huge.
Not My Kid is a wonderful organization that focuses on helping families with all of the challenges kids face. In honor of 4/20 they are handing out free drug test kits (a $40 value) at their main office in Scottsdale until 5 PM. The address is 5230 E Shea Blvd # 100, Scottsdale, AZ 85254. Head over here for more information on their facebook page. If you can't get over there today, call them. I did and they said they offer the free kits on a regular basis.
If you test your teenagers (and let them know that you're going to every now and then) it gives them a good excuse NOT to get high at the party this weekend. They can blame their "dumb parents" or even "that stupid blogger who told their parents about free test kits". I honestly believe that kids want their parents to help them stay on a good path.
My family member is extremely lucky. He is back in school, has a steady job, and has been off drugs for awhile. Some of his friends are dead. It's so scary to think about how easily drugs can wreck your life.
Hope you share this with someone you know who can use the information!

posts.title: Unlimited FREE Classes Until April 29th at Power Train Yoga in Scottsdale!
posts.excerpt: If you've been wanting to get moving, here's your chance FOR FREE! Head to the new Power Train Yoga for FREE unlimited classes through April 29th.
posts.text:
If you've been wanting to get moving, here's your chance FOR FREE! Head to the new Power Train Yoga for FREE unlimited classes through April 29th.
Check out the press release they sent me:
"SCOTTSDALE, (March 30, 2015) – PowerTrainYoga is opening its first Arizona location in Scottsdale Monday, March 30. The modern 10,000 square foot studio will open its doors to the public with a free month of unlimited access to more than 130 group fitness classes offered each week from March 30 until April 29.
PowerTrain features a mix of workouts including heated and unheated Yoga, Hot Pilates, TRX suspension training, Kettlebells, Barre, Battleropes, Bootcamp, High Intensity Interval Training (HIIT) and more. In an effort to make group fitness more affordable and accessible to people, they will offer unlimited memberships at a competitive rate.
The wide variety of class offerings are geared toward all ages and fitness levels. Aspects of yoga including flexibility and balance are incorporated into every class to promote good health and reduce the risk of injury. This gives members a well-rounded, safe workout with ultimate results.
The facility features a sophisticated environmental control system which monitors the heat, humidity and carbon dioxide levels in each training room. To give members the optimal workout environment, fresh air is pumped into training rooms when needed to increase comfort while reducing fatigue.
“Our goal is to bring group fitness to the community at an affordable price,” said Steve Gregory, PowerTrainYoga CEO. “We want everyone to experience our wide variety of classes, try something new and most importantly, see results.”
With so many classes being offered daily, busy schedules won’t compete with getting in or staying in shape. Members have access to many different class types, giving them a total fitness experience in one location.
PowerTrainYoga is located just north of Thunderbird Rd. on the west side of Scottsdale Road at 14202 N Scottsdale Road #114 Scottsdale, AZ 85254.
For more information, class schedules and details, visit www.powertrainyoga.com or call 805.440.8761. "

posts.text:
Click here to get $30 to spend at Alice Cooperstown for $15 with code MARCH25 (good through Tuesday).
This is a delicious restaurant right next to Chase field. They have the biggest hot dog around (the Big Unit...see more details below), and great food. I called to confirm that you can use your Groupon before a Dbacks game.
"Named after former Arizona Diamondbacks ace Randy Johnson, the Big Unit hotdog at Alice Cooperstown measures 22" in length and weighs a full pound—and that's not even the restaurant's largest hot dog. That honor goes to the Bases Loaded Big Unit, which Man v. Food host Adam Richman once likened to a skateboard. Held together by an entire French baguette, this three-pound behemoth features cheese, sauerkraut, jalapenos, and the restaurant's renowned chili.
Such eye-popping dishes should come as no surprise at a place owned by Alice Cooper, whose brand of shock rock has led to countless incurable cases of pumping-fist syndrome over the past four decades. When you look past the giant hot dogs, you'll also find a menu brimming with flavor and variety, including fresh-ground burgers, wine and microbrews on draft, and barbecue and gumbo that have taken home ribbons at several area cook-offs."
Enjoy!

posts.title: Pogo Passes are PERFECT for the Easter Basket! Still Just $39.98! Dbacks Game Days Have Been Added!
posts.excerpt: The POGO Pass are perfect additions to the Easter basket! You can still head over here and get one for just $39.98 with code ALICIA (everyone in the family…
posts.text:
The POGO Pass are perfect additions to the Easter basket! You can still head over here and get one for just $39.98 with code ALICIA (everyone in the family using a pass needs their own). We STILL haven't had our spring break (it's the week after Easter) and I'm looking forward to using our passes!
To make the deal even more exciting, if you buy or renew a pass in March (remember to use code ALICIA) you’ll be automatically entered to win 4 tickets to Wicked at Gammage!
I love that the Dbacks game days have been added! Check out what your pass includes:
Arizona Diamondbacks: One (1) ticket per game per pass holder for two (2) home games at Chase Field for the MLB Regular Season.
Available Hours
Pass holders can choose two (2) of the available Games for the 2015 MLB Regular Season.
Sun, 4/26 vs. PIT 1:10 PM
Tue, 5/12 vs. WAS 6:40 PM
Wed, 6/17 vs. LAA 6:40 PM
Fri, 7/24 vs. MIL 6:40 PM
Tue, 8/11 vs. PHI 6:40 PM
Fri, 10/2 vs. HOU 6:40 PM
Registration button appears on this page (2) weeks prior to game day. Must register your Pogo Pass to reserve tickets at will call. Login to your account for a list of your available passes.
Your pass will get you into Makutu’s Island in Chandler twice with your year-long pass (Monday-Friday). Tickets are usually $10 each.
Castles and Coasters: Each Pogo Pass holder recieves one (1) visit to Castles~n~Coasters for a *Silver Pass (worth $29.99). This includes unlimited rides and mini golf.
Each Pogo Pass holder receives general admission to the Phoenix Zoo two (2) times. To gain admission to the Zoo, simply present your Pogo Pass at the admission window. Some experiences require an additional fee. Admission to ZooLights and select special events is not included. An adult general admission is usually $20, so this is a $40 value for adults. There is a new baby orangutan that I can’t wait to visit! Head over here to see more adorable pics (or better yet grab your Pogo Pass and visit in person).
Sunsplash: Each pass holder can attend Golfland Sunsplash one (1) time. Your pass is good for one (1) SunSplash General admission ticket. Simply present your Pogo pass at Sunsplash Guest Service window to be scanned to obtain waterpark wristband. Sunsplash is closed for the season but since your pass is good for a FULL YEAR, you can use this next summer. A general admission ticket for adults is usually $29.99.
IDEA museum (used to be Arizona Museum for Youth): Each pass holder can attend i.d.e.a Museum Two (2) times during normal business hours (closed on Monday). Children 1 yrs of age and up are $8 admission if they do not have a valid Pogo Pass. Children are required to wear socks in play area. ** Excludes opening weekend (Fri, Sat, Sun) of opening exhibitions, 3 weekends a year. Simply present your Pogo Pass at admissions desk for entrance. Since admission is usually $8, this adds $16 of value to your POGO pass.
Enchanted Island: Your Pogo Pass is good for a Day Pass four (4) times at Enchanted Island Park Friday and Sundays during regular business hours. Not valid during Enchanted Island special events (I would call ahead before you go). Limited capacity, first come first serve. Some rides may require additional charge. A day pass is usually $17 for anyone under 54 inches, $10 for anyone over.
Sun Devil Athletics: Pogo Pass is a accepted for general admission tickets to ALL of the following ASU athletic home games: Women’s Basketball, Soccer, Wrestling, Volleyball, Gymnastics, Track and Field. **No need to pre-register for tickets to attend. Simply present your Pogo pass at will call or the front gate to gain admissions.
National Comedy Theater: Each pass holder can attend 2 shows. Please call for a reservation. Seating is limited. First come first serve. Note: Please honor your reservations. Reservations will be cancelled for those who are not in their seats 5 minutes prior to show. Tickets are usually $14 each.
Skateland: Each pass holder can attend Skateland two (2) times per month. Skateland has three (3) different locations available to pass holders. Simply present your Pogo Pass card at the front counter to gain admission to Skateland. Skate Rental not included. There are 3 locations (one in Mesa, one in Glendale, and one in Chandler).
Phoenix Rock Gym: Pogo Pass holders can attend Phoenix Rock Gym two (2) times. Simply present your Pogo Pass at the front counter to gain admission to Phoenix Rock Gym. Waiver required for 18 and younger. Limited capacity, first come first serve. *Climbing gear available upon request for $5.
Jump Street: Each Pass holder can attend Phoenix Jump Street two (2) times. Pass is good for a one (1) hour jump session each attendance. NOTE: This one is only available during normal business hours Mondays and Wednesdays.
Stratum Laser Tag: Pass holders can attend stratum two (2) times. Each pass holder receives one (1) complimentary game of laser tag each time they attend. Pass is valid for 12 months. NOTE: Pogo Passes may be used on Mondays and Wednesdays 4:30-close. Pogo Passes may not be used during school holiday breaks or Stratum’s designated holiday hours. No exceptions.
Tempe Paintball: Pogo Pass holders can attend Tempe Paintball one (1) time per month for 12 months that include gun rental, air, and 100 paintballs. Check for seasonal hours and scheduled groups or events before scheduling your visit. Keep in mind that all participants must be 10 years or older, and must sign a waiver before prior to entering the arena. Note: This is not good on Saturdays.
Arizona Rattlers: (1) One ticket per game per pass holder for three (3) Arizona Rattlers home games at the US Airways Center for the AFL regular season. There will be select games posted before the next regular season.
Fat Cats is coming to Gilbert soon and will be part of the POGO Pass (including bowling)!
Enjoy your passes and please note that venues are subject to change!

"Seed packet with native milkweed or a flowering nectar plant
Monarchs drink nectar from flowers and their caterpillars eat only milkweed
A list of milkweed and nectar plants native to your region
Ask your garden center for the best plants on our list to add to your garden
Ranger Rick Nature Notebook

Butterfly Heroes Sticker and Poster

For example, be sure to plant your seed packet in a sunny spot with some protection from the wind. Use your Ranger Rick notebook to make notes on the wildlife in your garden and the types of caterpillars your garden attracts. Your butterfly garden seeds will sprout in the spring, grow in summer and fall, and then come back next year! Share a photo of your garden on our Facebook and Twitter pages."

posts.excerpt: Spring Break is next week for many Arizona kids and just in time Pogo Pass secured a new fantastic venue! You can still head over here to get a pass for just…
posts.text:
Spring Break is next week for many Arizona kids and just in time Pogo Pass secured a new fantastic venue! You can still head over here to get a pass for just $39.98 with code ALICIA (usually around $100).
To make the deal even more exciting, if you buy or renew a pass in March (remember to use code ALICIA) you'll be automatically entered to win 4 tickets to Wicked at Gammage!
Starting March 6th, your pass will get you into Makutu's Island in Chandler twice with your year-long pass (Monday-Friday). Tickets are usually $10 each and here's a description of the place:
"Makutu’s (Ma-coo-two’s) Island, one of America’s largest indoor play places, is a trip into fantasy and adventure for children of all ages and a perfect way to beat the Arizona heat. Designed with a tropical theme, Makutu’s is a lush, exciting indoor “island” with towering trees, climbs, bungee, zip tracker, arcade, café, theater, toddler zone and mysterious caves.
The centerpiece of Makutu’s Island is its magnificent indoor tree. Filled with tunnels, tubes, mole-holes, fire-poles and slides, the magnificent tree offers hours of fun and adventure. Around the tree’s perimeter, guests will find animals carved within its extensive roots and a comical three-animal totem pole. Within the majestic tree, the “banana” slide is a sure thrill as it starts on the forth level in the air and winds more than 35 feet around the outside of the tree to its base.
After exploring the tree, many of Makutu’s guests find themselves in one of the three adjoining play structures including the Blue Fantasy Tree, Pirates Cove and Palm Slide. Less rigorous than the old oak tree, these areas are perfect for the less-experienced island traveler and include tunnels, caves and a zip-line.
In addition to Makutu’s main four play areas, the island also offers its smaller guests a special toddlers area. Oscar’s Lagoon is a slower placed environment of Makutu’s smallest “castaways.” In the Lagoon, toddlers will enjoy three small slides and soft foam blocks."
The POGO Pass will help your family have the ultimate spring break "staycation". Check out what else your pass includes:
Castles and Coasters: Each Pogo Pass holder recieves one (1) visit to Castles~n~Coasters for a *Silver Pass (worth $29.99). This includes unlimited rides and mini golf.
Each Pogo Pass holder receives general admission to the Phoenix Zoo two (2) times. To gain admission to the Zoo, simply present your Pogo Pass at the admission window. Some experiences require an additional fee. Admission to ZooLights and select special events is not included. An adult general admission is usually $20, so this is a $40 value for adults. There is a new baby orangutan that I can’t wait to visit! Head over here to see more adorable pics (or better yet grab your Pogo Pass and visit in person).
Sunsplash: Each pass holder can attend Golfland Sunsplash one (1) time. Your pass is good for one (1) SunSplash General admission ticket. Simply present your Pogo pass at Sunsplash Guest Service window to be scanned to obtain waterpark wristband. Sunsplash is closed for the season but since your pass is good for a FULL YEAR, you can use this next summer. A general admission ticket for adults is usually $29.99.
IDEA museum (used to be Arizona Museum for Youth): Each pass holder can attend i.d.e.a Museum Two (2) times during normal business hours (closed on Monday). Children 1 yrs of age and up are $8 admission if they do not have a valid Pogo Pass. Children are required to wear socks in play area. ** Excludes opening weekend (Fri, Sat, Sun) of opening exhibitions, 3 weekends a year. Simply present your Pogo Pass at admissions desk for entrance. Since admission is usually $8, this adds $16 of value to your POGO pass.
Enchanted Island: Your Pogo Pass is good for a Day Pass four (4) times at Enchanted Island Park Friday and Sundays during regular business hours. Not valid during Enchanted Island special events (I would call ahead before you go). Limited capacity, first come first serve. Some rides may require additional charge. A day pass is usually $17 for anyone under 54 inches, $10 for anyone over.
Sun Devil Athletics: Pogo Pass is a accepted for general admission tickets to ALL of the following ASU athletic home games: Women’s Basketball, Soccer, Wrestling, Volleyball, Gymnastics, Track and Field. **No need to pre-register for tickets to attend. Simply present your Pogo pass at will call or the front gate to gain admissions.
Arizona Diamondbacks: One (1) ticket per game per pass holder for two (2) home games at Chase Field for the MLB Regular Season. Game options for this season will come out soon.
National Comedy Theater: Each pass holder can attend 2 shows. Please call for a reservation. Seating is limited. First come first serve. Note: Please honor your reservations. Reservations will be cancelled for those who are not in their seats 5 minutes prior to show. Tickets are usually $14 each.
Skateland: Each pass holder can attend Skateland two (2) times per month. Skateland has three (3) different locations available to pass holders. Simply present your Pogo Pass card at the front counter to gain admission to Skateland. Skate Rental not included. There are 3 locations (one in Mesa, one in Glendale, and one in Chandler).
Phoenix Rock Gym: Pogo Pass holders can attend Phoenix Rock Gym two (2) times. Simply present your Pogo Pass at the front counter to gain admission to Phoenix Rock Gym. Waiver required for 18 and younger. Limited capacity, first come first serve. *Climbing gear available upon request for $5.
Jump Street: Each Pass holder can attend Phoenix Jump Street two (2) times. Pass is good for a one (1) hour jump session each attendance. NOTE: This one is only available during normal business hours Mondays and Wednesdays.
Stratum Laser Tag: Pass holders can attend stratum two (2) times. Each pass holder receives one (1) complimentary game of laser tag each time they attend. Pass is valid for 12 months. NOTE: Pogo Passes may be used on Mondays and Wednesdays 4:30-close. Pogo Passes may not be used during school holiday breaks or Stratum’s designated holiday hours. No exceptions.
Tempe Paintball: Pogo Pass holders can attend Tempe Paintball one (1) time per month for 12 months that include gun rental, air, and 100 paintballs. Check for seasonal hours and scheduled groups or events before scheduling your visit. Keep in mind that all participants must be 10 years or older, and must sign a waiver before prior to entering the arena. Note: This is not good on Saturdays.
Arizona Rattlers: (1) One ticket per game per pass holder for three (3) Arizona Rattlers home games at the US Airways Center for the AFL regular season. There will be select games posted before the next regular season.
Fat Cats is coming to Gilbert soon and will be part of the POGO Pass (including bowling)!
Enjoy your passes and please note that venues are subject to change!

"Set against the backdrop of the beautiful Mingus Mountains of Camp Verde, Out of Africa Wildlife Park is nestled on over 100 acres of rolling hills and valleys. This setting is home to hundreds of exotic mammals, birds, and reptiles from all over the world. It’s the perfect place to raise the awareness of our exotic neighbors while promoting understanding through in-person contact. It truly is an awe-inspiring adventure blending family bonds with the power and cunning of the wild.
Our park strives to educate and entertain, to provide an exciting and engaging opportunity to love and respect creation and Creator. It is a place where family and friends gather to experience oneness with animals and each other during safaris, tours, walks, observations, and shows of wild-by-nature animals in their own natural splendor. In this way, we hope to achieve a kind of oneness with them, which will cause us to consider them to be so valuable that we cannot allow them to be lost forever. posts.excerpt: Head over here to save huge on tickets to the Scottsdale Arabian Horse Show. It's going on through Sunday at WestWorld.

Head over here to save huge on tickets to the Scottsdale Arabian Horse Show. It's going on through Sunday at WestWorld.
You'll pay $12 for two general admission tickets (a $20 value) or $21 for four (a $40 value).
"In 1955, 50 horses and their handlers gathered on the grounds of the Arizona Biltmore Hotel for the first Scottsdale Arabian Horse Show. Over the next 58 years, the event moved twice—first to Paradise Park, then to WestWorld—and grew to nearly 2,500 participants. Today, the 450 members of the Arabian Horse Association of Arizona, which was incorporated the same year as the horse show, help to oversee the annual flagship event. Many of the members also serve as competition judges, work to foster youth participation in the equestrian arts, and raise awareness about which tiny hats look best on thoroughbreds.
The annual Scottsdale Arabian Horse Show draws competitors from local Arizona farms and across the country. The showcase gathers thousands of horse enthusiasts for seminars, competitions, galas, international cuisine, and more than 300 vendors. Though the Arabian Horse Association of Arizona holds the show as its main event, it also oversees the Arabian Breeder Finals, a halter and breeding showcase; the annual qualifying America Cup Championship; and yearly endurance rides and stallion auctions."
Have fun!

posts.title: Happy First Friday! FREE Admission to the Children's Museum of Phoenix (Plus Free Dental Screenings), and Free Admission to the Heard Museum, and the Phoenix Art Museum!
posts.excerpt: Hooray! Today (2/6) is First Friday! If you don’t have plans, you may want to head to Downtown Phoenix to enjoy the gorgeous weather, some beautiful art, an…
posts.text:
Hooray! Today (2/6) is First Friday! If you don’t have plans, you may want to head to Downtown Phoenix to enjoy the gorgeous weather, some beautiful art, an Ollie the Trolley ride, and some FREE museums! Anyone that says Phoenix has no culture has obviously never been to First Friday!
Head to the Children’s Museum of Phoenix where everyone will get in free from 5-9 PM. Tickets are usually $11 each, so this is quite an opportunity to play for less!
Also at the Children's Museum of Phoenix, from 2-6 PM the Colgate Bright Smiles Bright Futures van will be there offering kids free dental screenings and free dental supplies! Head over here for more information. I would plan it so you can enjoy free admission after your screening!
Visit the Heard Museum for their First Friday Native + You program. Everyone will get into the museum FOR FREE from 6-10 (tickets are usually $18 for adults, $7.50 for kids). This month the theme is “Hoop it Up," and they'll have a hoop dance world championship contest going on! Sounds like fun!
Still have energy? Go to the Phoenix Art Museum for their First Friday event. Everyone will get in for free from 6-10 PM (tickets are usually $15 for adults, $6 for kids). Head over here for more information and to see exhibits on display.
The Arizona Science Center isn't participating in Adults Night Out this month, but they'll be back in March!
Enjoy!

posts.title: Save Up to 34% off Tickets to See Varekai by Cirque du Soleil!
posts.excerpt: Head over here to save up to 34% off tickets to see Varekai by Cirque du Soleil. I can't wait to see the show with my daughter, it looks spectacular!
posts.text:
Head over here to save up to 34% off tickets to see Varekai by Cirque du Soleil. I can't wait to see the show with my daughter, it looks spectacular!
"Varekai—the Romany word for “wherever”—embodies and celebrates the nomadic spirit of the circus itself. A winged hero, wounded from a rub-up against the sun, plummets from the sky into a magical forest populated by surreal creatures. Here at the edge of time, all things seem possible—including a wondrous rebirth.
The forest’s inhabitants include aerialists, dancers, contortionists, jugglers, clowns, and acrobats. They dazzle the eye with incredible feats of strength and agility, as well as more than 130 vibrant costumes by Academy Award-winning designer Eiko Eshioka, who drew inspiration from the textures and shapes of the natural world."
The dancers are spectacular, check out when they came to check out Mill Avenue!
Enjoy!

posts.excerpt: This would be a great family experience! Head over here to save 38% off tickets to Biosphere 2 near Tucson.
posts.text:
This would be a great family experience! Head over here to save 38% off tickets to Biosphere 2 near Tucson.
"In 1984, Space Biospheres Ventures purchased a few unassuming acres north of Tucson in the shadow the Santa Catalina Mountains. There, the company expanded its sci-fi-sounding activities—the development of space-colonization technology—and built what would evolve into Biosphere 2.
Designed to re-create Earth's ecosystems, the gigantic glass enclosure (some 7.2 million cubic feet and 91 feet tall in some parts) is famous for housing biospherians in the 1990s. The researchers lived completely sealed inside for extended periods, giving scientists groundbreaking data on human survivability and interaction with particular bionetworks.
The University of Arizona had the 40-acre Biosphere 2 campus donated in 2011, maintaining it as a hub of serious research while expanding its mission to encompass interactive educational outreach. Each year, thousands pass through the on-site labs and classrooms as well as stroll the Biosphere 2 interior to view films, experience multimedia exhibits, or embark on guided tours. Tours venture into the actual ecosystems, allowing earthlings to note biodiversity, smell fresh precipitation in the rain forest, and savor the softness of savannah grassland underfoot until the resident grumpy old man yells at you to get the heck off his lawn. Before their dramatic conclusion at a million-gallon ocean tank, tours delve into the basement to explore the technosphere, where visitors can witness the deep inhales and exhales of the sphere’s respiratory system."
Enjoy!

posts.title: Get a FREE Ticket to the Phoenix Open ($30 value) When You Spend $30 on Participating Products at Fry's! I Have the FULL LIST Right Here!

posts.text:

General Admission tickets are $30 each but I sincerely hope that no Alicia's Deals reader will actually pay for them! If you're new to Alicia's Deals, welcome! I try my best to help you "live life better for less" every single day. If you haven’t already, I hope you’ll “like” Alicia’s Deals on Facebook, follow me on Twitter and join the Alicia’s Deals e-mail list. You can now download my FREE app “The Deals Diva” on iTunes here on on Google Play here!
Head over here to find out how to get 2 free tickets with purchase at Desert Ridge Marketplace and Tempe Marketplace.
Fry's has a promotion going too. While supplies last when you buy $30 worth of participating products, you'll get a free ticket printed at the bottom of your receipt. Buy $60 worth of products, you'll get two tickets. I managed to get a list of all of the participating products and I decided to put it right on the site (see below)! posts.title: Give One Dollar, Get FREE Frostys at Wendys All Year Long!
posts.excerpt: What a fun give and get deal. Head to your closest participating Wendy's and pay just a dollar for a key tag that will get you a FREE Frosty treat with any…
posts.text:
What a fun give and get deal. Head to your closest participating Wendy's and pay just a dollar for a key tag that will get you a FREE Frosty treat with any purchase for the entire year! I love that 90% of that dollar goes to help find families for children in foster care!
Check out the information they sent me:
"What a sweet way to start the New Year! Today Wendy’s® announced the launch of its second annual National Frosty® Key Tag Program. For $1, Wendy’s customers can buy a Frosty Key Tag that gets them a free Jr. Frosty with every purchase during 2015, while supplies last. Ninety cents from every dollar will go to help find families for children in foster care through the Dave Thomas Foundation for Adoption®.
Last year’s Frosty Key Tag Program raised more than $2.9 million and kicked off a four-part national cause marketing effort for the Dave Thomas Foundation for Adoption (DTFA). Started by Wendy’s Founder Dave Thomas, who was adopted himself, the DTFA works in communities across the U.S. and Canada to help dramatically increase the number of adoptions for children in foster care.
“At Wendy’s, we believe that every child deserves a family and have worked tirelessly to help children find loving homes,” said Liz Geraghty, Wendy’s vice president of marketing. “Right now, there are more than 100,000 children in foster care in the United States waiting to be adopted. The Frosty Key Tag Program gives our customers a chance to impact the lives of these children in their own communities, while enjoying Frosty treats all year long.”
The DTFA believes that every child should feel safe, cared for and loved. Community support through programs like the Frosty Key Tag Program has enabled Wendy’s and the DTFA to help more than 4,570 children in foster care find homes. Doing good never tasted so good."
Thanks Steven!

posts.excerpt: I have known so many people who have done this (and actually had a blast). This is NOT for the faint of heart (and definitely not for me), but if you're…
posts.text:
I have known so many people who have done this (and actually had a blast). This is NOT for the faint of heart (and definitely not for me), but if you're thinking about trying it, you might as well save 21% off!
Head over here to get admission to the 2015 Tough Mudder run for $156, usually $197.01.
"Climbing walls, ice baths, pools of mud, electric shocks—a Tough Mudder isn't your average footrace. Each 10- to 12-mile course contains 20 adrenaline-pumping obstacles designed to test participants' strength and endurance, just like most local DMV lines. Runners clamber on top of each other to scale the slick, sloping wall of Pyramid Scheme or squeal with shock as they plunge into the Arctic Enema, a plastic-lined dumpster filled with thousands of pounds of ice. They even endure shocks from a forest of live wires known as Electroshock Therapy.
But it's all worth it for the glass of beer at the end, plus the sense of camaraderie that develops among teammates. Many of those teammates go on to join the Mudder Legion, an organization for those who have completed the race two or more times. Tough Mudder also raises funds for the Wounded Warrior Project, which helps injured veterans transition to civilian life."
Check out what's included:
"$156 for one admission to Tough Mudder (up to $197.01 value)
When: Saturday, March 14
Additional date available Sunday, March 15
Where: 11349 S Ellsworth Rd; Eastmark, AZ
Includes: Headband, one beer, and access to Mudder Village
Full offer value includes ticketing fees"
Enjoy and good luck!

Now is the time of year that many of us think of buying gift cards for our family and friends. Many businesses want you to buy their gift cards so that they guarantee your holiday shopping dollar goes to them. If you think about buying gift cards for yourself for places you're already shopping (and treating them like cash), you'll be able to maximize the gift card bonuses for yourself!
If Chili's is your favorite place to eat, head over here to get a FREE $10 bonus card when you purchase $50 in gift cards (and enjoy free shipping). The bonus card will be good January 1st-February 10th.

posts.title: Happy First Friday! FREE Admission to The Children's Museum of Phoenix, The Heard Museum, and the Phoenix Art Museum!
posts.excerpt: Hooray! Today (12/5) is First Friday! If you don’t have plans, you may want to head to Downtown Phoenix to enjoy the gorgeous weather, some beautiful art, an…
posts.text:
Hooray! Today (12/5) is First Friday! If you don’t have plans, you may want to head to Downtown Phoenix to enjoy the gorgeous weather, some beautiful art, an Ollie the Trolley ride, and some FREE museums! Anyone that says Phoenix has no culture has obviously never been to First Friday!
Head to the Children’s Museum of Phoenix where everyone will get in free from 5-9 PM. Tickets are usually $11 each, so this is quite an opportunity to play for less!
Visit the Heard Museum for their First Friday Native + You program. Everyone will get into the museum FOR FREE from 6-10 (tickets are usually $18 for adults, $7.50 for kids). This month the theme is "literary treasures".
Still have energy? Go to the Phoenix Art Museum for their First Friday event. Everyone will get in for free from 6-10 PM (tickets are usually $15 for adults, $6 for kids).
Enjoy a cool Phoenix night at the museum with drinks from ArTenders and live music by Elvis Before Noon! Music starts at 7:00 p.m.
Exhibitions on view:
The West Select: A Western Art Invitational Sale and Exhibition - $5 for adults, $3 for youth after 6 p.m.
Vanitas: Contemporary Reflections on Love and Death from the Collection of Stéphane Janssen - Free after 6 p.m.
All That Glitters is Not Gold: Platinum Photography from the Center for Creative Photography - Free after 6 p.m.
Don Coen: The Migrant Series - Free after 6 p.m.
Fashioned In America - Free after 6 p.m.
Sacred Stories and Images of the Buddha: The Vessantara Jataka Scroll - Free after 6 p.m.
Paulo Bruscky: Art is Our Last Hope - Free after 6 p.m.
Phoenix Art Museum is one of four Artlink Phoenix First Friday Trolley hubs! Park and enjoy the museum then take the trolley tour and explore all the downtown Phoenix arts and culture destinations. The museum is conveniently located by the Central and McDowell Valley Metro Lightrail station.
First Friday is closed this week but will be back in January!
Just to recap, if you take your family of four (two adults, two kids) to the Children’s Museum of Phoenix, the Heard Museum, and the Phoenix Art Museum, you’ll save a whopping $137 on admission (more if you have more kids).
Enjoy!

I thought I’d type out a full list of when and where your Pogo Pass is good. I am constantly hearing from readers that the Pogo Pass is their favorite Alicia’s Deal of all time. Venues can change but this is the best value around. I like this so much more than buying a membership to one place, you can enjoy places all over town!
Castles and Coasters: Each Pogo Pass holder recieves one (1) visit to Castles~n~Coasters for a *Silver Pass (worth $29.99). This includes unlimited rides and mini golf.
Each Pogo Pass holder receives general admission to the Phoenix Zoo two (2) times. To gain admission to the Zoo, simply present your Pogo Pass at the admission window. Some experiences require an additional fee. Admission to ZooLights and select special events is not included. An adult general admission is usually $20, so this is a $40 value for adults. There is a new baby orangutan that I can’t wait to visit! Head over here to see more adorable pics (or better yet grab your Pogo Pass and visit in person).
Sunsplash: Each pass holder can attend Golfland Sunsplash one (1) time. Your pass is good for one (1) SunSplash General admission ticket. Simply present your Pogo pass at Sunsplash Guest Service window to be scanned to obtain waterpark wristband. Sunsplash is closed for the season but since your pass is good for a FULL YEAR, you can use this next summer. A general admission ticket for adults is usually $29.99.
IDEA museum (used to be Arizona Museum for Youth): Each pass holder can attend i.d.e.a Museum Two (2) times during normal business hours. Children 1 yrs of age and up are $8 admission if they do not have a valid Pogo Pass. Children are required to wear socks in play area. ** Excludes opening weekend (Fri, Sat, Sun) of opening exhibitions, 3 weekends a year. Simply present your Pogo Pass at admissions desk for entrance. Since admission is usually $8, this adds $16 of value to your POGO pass.

posts.title: Make a Gorgeous Cheese Board This Holiday Season and WIN!
posts.excerpt: Do you love cheese? This has to be one of the most fun posts I've done. Albertsons asked me to put together a cheese board with some of their beautiful…
posts.text:
Do you love cheese? This has to be one of the most fun posts I've done. Albertsons asked me to put together a cheese board with some of their beautiful ingredients (it took me literally less than half a second to say yes). To make the project even sweeter, they gave me a cheese basket to give away to one lucky reader (see details below, retail value around $100)!
Lucky for us, ALL specialty cheeses at Albertsons will be going on sale soon!
Here's what I picked up for our board (I like sweet/savory and crunchy/creamy contrast):
Hoffman's Natural Vermont Cheddar Cheese
Monet Mini Original water crackers
Dietz and Watson Mini Salame
Roasted almonds
Dried apricots
Primizie Handmade snack crisps
Kalamata olives (from the olive bar)
Dietz and Watson Salame Panino (hot salame rolled in mozzarella cheese..pretty and so good)
La Bonne Vie Triple Creme Brie
Savannah Bee Co. Honey for Cheese
Raspberries
To make the baked brie I preheated the oven to 350 degrees. I put the brie on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper and drizzled it with the Savannah Bee Co. honey for cheese (I remember when Ina Garten put brie with honey and have loved it ever since). I would definitely recommend this honey, it really added a nice flavor to the baked brie. I baked for around 7-8 minutes and plated it with raspberries on top (SO EASY even I could do it). It was absolutely DELICIOUS with the Primizie handmade crisp breads.
The board with the cheddar, mozzarella, apricots, olives, water crackers, and salame was really easy to put together too. It made for a wonderful Friday night dinner with a glass of wine.
A nice cheese board is one of the easiest things to make (there is no cooking ability required), and can make a huge impression on your guests.
Here's how you can enter to win a cheese basket worth around $100 from Albertsons (cheese lovers will DEFINITELY want to apply):
1. Build your perfect cheese board
2. Take a picture and post it on the Alicia's Deals facebook page or on Twitter (please tag #aliciasdeals).
I'll pick a winner on November 26th.
Enjoy and I can't wait to see what you can do with cheese!
We are all going to have beautiful starters this holiday season. :-)
Note: This is a sponsored post by Albertsons.

One note: I would try to go when there's snow on the ground. If there isn't enough, they'll change to a wagon ride (which is still fun, but not technically a "sleigh")..
Check out a review from last year:
"MUST DO
We were in Flagstaff for vacation this past weekend and bought tickets to go on a sleigh ride with Hitchin Post and it was one of our favorite things. My kids 3 and 5 had such a great time and everyone was more than nice. We will definitely be doing this again on our next trip."

posts.title: FREE Tipsy Tow from AAA Halloween Night
posts.excerpt: Head over here to check out how to get a FREE Tipsy Tow from AAA 6 PM Halloween night-6 AM November 1st. If you see someone at a party who might have had too…
posts.text:
Head over here to check out how to get a FREE Tipsy Tow from AAA 6 PM Halloween night-6 AM November 1st. If you see someone at a party who might have had too much to drink (or if you have more than you plan on), please keep this program in mind!
More information:
"AAA Arizona has been a champion for the safety and security of the motoring public since the club’s inception. As such, the auto club recognizes and has taken action to reduce a dangerous problem that threatens everyone on the road today: driving under the influence. According to the Arizona Department of Transportation Motor Vehicle Division there were nearly 40,000 alcohol related crashes and nearly 1,800 fatalities between 2004 and 2009.
In addition, Arizona Department of Public Safety reported that there were nearly 230,000 DUI arrests within those five years. To combat this issue and reduce the number of alcohol related crashes and fatalities on Arizona roads, AAA Arizona launched its Tipsy Tow service in May 2009, and has been offering the complimentary service during holidays and special events ever since.
AAA Arizona urges all motorists to always include a safe ride home in their celebratory plans. If these plans fall through, Tipsy Tow will be available as a last resort during specific service periods.
Upcoming Tipsy Tow Service Periods:
Halloween
6.p.m. Friday, October 31, through 6 a.m. Saturday, November 1.
What is Tipsy Tow?
Tipsy Tow is a free one-way ride tow home, up to 10 miles, for drivers, and one of their passengers, who have been drinking.
Who can participate?
Tipsy Tow is a public service that serves everyone – not just members!
Anyone can call for a “tipsy tow” – drivers, passengers, bartenders, party-hosts, or even restaurant managers.
When is Tipsy Tow offered?
Tipsy Tow is offered when Arizona experiences the highest volume of DUI arrest and alcohol-related crashes – during holidays and special events, such as Memorial Day, Fourth of July and even Super Bowl Sunday.
The service is typically offered from 6 p.m. to 6 a.m. on the service day.
Where is Tipsy Tow available?
Tipsy Tow is available throughout the state of Arizona.
How can I take advantage of the Tipsy Tow service?
To get a “tipsy tow” for yourself or someone you know who has too much to drink, call 1-800-AAA-HELP (1-800-222-4357) on a service day and state you need a “tipsy tow.”
Provide the driver’s name, home address, phone number and vehicle/driver location.
How much does a Tipsy Tow cost?
Tipsy Tow is free, up to 10 miles. For trips longer than 10 miles, motorists can expect to be charged the towing company’s standard rate.
What else do I need to know about Tipsy Tow?
Tipsy Tow is available as capacity dictates. Be aware that higher call volumes could result in longer wait times.
Tipsy Tow service will not be provided to motorists requesting a tow to another drinking establishment or to a destination other than their home. A tow to a hotel may be allowed if the motorists is, or plans to become, a guest.

Thanks for tuning into Your Life A to Z on 3TV and checking out my KTAR.com video. I hope you’ll “like” Alicia’s Deals on facebook, follow me on Twitter, and join the Alicia’s Deals e-mail list where I'll help you "live life better for less" every single day (and don't forget I put together a list of my favorite deals at valley grocery stores each Wednesday.
Items you won't want to miss:
Ibotta: Click here to sign up for this great app. You'll save on all kinds of things at valley grocery stores in addition to any sales or coupons you have. Money will go directly into your Ibotta account which you can transfer to your Paypal account (I've gotten over $800 back) or choose to get a gift card. Yesterday I got money back on the Halloween candy, cereal, and milk I bought. It is really easy once you get the hang of it. You can use Ibotta at Albertsons, Sprouts, Fry's, Safeway, Whole Foods, Safeway, Target, CVS Pharmacy, WinCo Foods, Walgreens, Costco, Sam's Club, 7-Eleven. It's not just good on groceries, you can also use it at Aeropostale, Loft, Soma, Sports Authority, Quiznos, Home Depot, Lowe's, Petco, Petsmart, Babies R Us, Toys R Us, and AMC Movie Theaters.
Sam's Club: Head over here to snag a Sams Club Plus Membership for just $45. It includes a $20 gift card, coupons for a rotisserie chicken, Artisan Fresh spinach artichoke dip, Daily Chef cookies, and a French baguette, and a complimentary spouse or other household member (all in all a $142.18 value). You get money back for buying with your plus membership and your membership must have lagged 6 or more months (this is the first item I've seen that doesn't require you to be 100% new)!
Onto the tips:
Albertsons: Wear your Cardinals jersey on Sunday or Cardinals game day to save 10% off your ENTIRE grocery purchase during the regular season. If you spend $100 a week on groceries, that's $10 a week!
Bashas': They will double your coupons up to $.50!
Fry's : They offer facebook coupons each Wednesday, usually for $2 off your $40 purchase or $3 off your $50 purchase. You download the coupons directly to your VIP card. They also offer a Fry's Friday freebie many Fridays. Head back here this Friday to get a FREE Greek yogurt (must download the coupon on Friday, you'll have 2 weeks to use it).
Safeway: Safeway will make all coupons worth at least $1. If you see a coupon you like worth $.10 off online or in the paper, it's still worth a buck at Safeway.
Use their Just4U app to save 20-30% off things you already buy. If you shop Safeway, you absolutely should be using this app (or you can use your computer).
Sprouts: The day you shop matters big time at Sprouts. Wednesdays are double ad days. You'll enjoy all of the savings from two weeks of ads.
Walmart: They still match ads and now they have a new Savings Catcher program. Click here to check it out. Scan your receipt (or type in your receipt number) and they'll check all of the ads in town to make sure you're getting the lowest prices on everything you buy. If you spent more on something than you would have somewhere else, you'll get a Walmart gift card for the difference.
Enjoy the savings!

Everyone in your family will need their own pass. You can buy these as gifts and the year won’t start until the recipient redeems their pass! Experiences make much better gifts than “stuff”!
Here's how to enter:
1. “Like” Alicia’s Deals on facebook and “like” Pogo Pass on facebook and let me know you do with a comment or “like.” You must do this to win as Pogo Pass wants to let you know about their awesome October giveaways. They are having a different prize every day of the month! Worth one entry.
2. Join the Alicia’s Deals e-mail list here. You’ll get one e-mail a day with all of the very best deals in town that will help you “live life better for less”. You can unsubscribe at any time and I promise to never share your e-mail. Worth one entry.
3. Tell a friend or two (or five hundred) about Alicia’s Deals this week and let me know you did (you can e-mail me at alicia@dealsinaz.com). That’s the very best way for my site to get bigger (and the bigger my site gets, the more awesome deals we’ll find out about). You’ll get five entries for everyone who “likes” the page, signs up for the e-mail list, or better yet does both! Maybe we’ll get up to 25,000 “likes” and all “live life better for less” together, especially with the holidays coming up! I am SO GLAD you’re here! Thank you so much!
I’ll pick a winner on Tuesday.
I thought I’d type out a full list of when and where your Pogo Pass is good. I am constantly hearing from readers that the Pogo Pass is their favorite Alicia’s Deal of all time. Venues can change but this is the best value around. I like this so much more than buying a membership to one place, you can enjoy places all over town!
Castles and Coasters: Each Pogo Pass holder recieves one (1) visit to Castles~n~Coasters for a *Silver Pass (worth $29.99). This includes unlimited rides and mini golf.
Each Pogo Pass holder receives general admission to the Phoenix Zoo two (2) times. To gain admission to the Zoo, simply present your Pogo Pass at the admission window. Some experiences require an additional fee. Admission to ZooLights and select special events is not included. An adult general admission is usually $20, so this is a $40 value for adults. There is a new baby orangutan that I can't wait to visit! Head over here to see more adorable pics (or better yet grab your Pogo Pass and visit in person).
Sunsplash: Each pass holder can attend Golfland Sunsplash one (1) time. Your pass is good for one (1) SunSplash General admission ticket. Simply present your Pogo pass at Sunsplash Guest Service window to be scanned to obtain waterpark wristband. Sunsplash is closed for the season but since your pass is good for a FULL YEAR, you can use this next summer. A general admission ticket for adults is usually $29.99.
IDEA museum (used to be Arizona Museum for Youth): Each pass holder can attend i.d.e.a Museum Two (2) times during normal business hours. Children 1 yrs of age and up are $8 admission if they do not have a valid Pogo Pass. Children are required to wear socks in play area. ** Excludes opening weekend (Fri, Sat, Sun) of opening exhibitions, 3 weekends a year. Simply present your Pogo Pass at admissions desk for entrance. Since admission is usually $8, this adds $16 of value to your POGO pass.
Enchanted Island: Your Pogo Pass is good for a Day Pass four (4) times at Enchanted Island Park Friday and Sundays during regular business hours. Not valid during Enchanted Island special events (I would call ahead before you go). Limited capacity, first come first serve. Some rides may require additional charge. A day pass is usually $17 for anyone under 54 inches, $10 for anyone over.
Sun Devil Athletics: Pogo Pass is a accepted for general admission tickets to ALL of the following ASU athletic home games: Women’s Basketball, Soccer, Wrestling, Volleyball, Gymnastics, Track and Field. **No need to pre-register for tickets to attend. Simply present your Pogo pass at will call or the front gate to gain admissions.
Brunswick Bowling: A YEAR OF FREE BOWLING! - 2 Free games per week for 52 weeks! *Shoe Rental not included. Saturdays/Some Holidays/Special events are excluded & reservations are not accepted. For groups of 10+, please call ahead to check lane availability.
Arizona Diamondbacks: One (1) ticket per game per pass holder for two (2) home games at Chase Field for the MLB Regular Season. Game options will come out before the next regular season (that has to be better than this one was).
National Comedy Theater: Each pass holder can attend Three (3) shows. Please call for a reservation. Seating is limited. First come first serve. Note: Please honor your reservations. Reservations will be cancelled for those who are not in their seats 5 minutes prior to show. Tickets are usually $14 each.
Skateland: Each pass holder can attend Skateland two (2) times per month. Skateland has three (3) different locations available to pass holders. Simply present your Pogo Pass card at the front counter to gain admission to Skateland. Skate Rental not included. There are 3 locations (one in Mesa, one in Glendale, and one in Chandler).
Phoenix Rock Gym: Pogo Pass holders can attend Phoenix Rock Gym two (2) times. Simply present your Pogo Pass at the front counter to gain admission to Phoenix Rock Gym. Waiver required for 18 and younger. Limited capacity, first come first serve. *Climbing gear available upon request for $5.
Jump Street: Each Pass holder can attend Phoenix Jump Street two (2) times. Pass is good for a one (1) hour jump session each attendance. NOTE: This one is only available during normal business hours Mondays and Wednesdays.
Stratum Laser Tag: Pass holders can attend stratum two (2) times. Each pass holder receives one (1) complimentary game of laser tag each time they attend. Pass is valid for 12 months. NOTE: Pogo Passes may be used on Mondays and Wednesdays 4:30-close. Pogo Passes may not be used during school holiday breaks or Stratum’s designated holiday hours. No exceptions.
Tempe Paintball: Pogo Pass holders can attend Tempe Paintball one (1) time per month for 12 months that include gun rental, air, and 100 paintballs. Check for seasonal hours and scheduled groups or events before scheduling your visit. Keep in mind that all participants must be 10 years or older, and must sign a waiver before prior to entering the arena. Note: This is not good on Saturdays.
Arizona Rattlers: (1) One ticket per game per pass holder for three (3) Arizona Rattlers home games at the US Airways Center for the AFL regular season. There will be select games posted before the next regular season.

It's a great time to buy a new car. The lots need to make room for the new models and may have excellent deals now.
My tips to getting the best deals:
Competition almost always helps you. Get multiple quotes from multiple dealers. They all want to beat each other and you can get quotes online without leaving your home. I always ask for an out the door price (including tax and all fees).
Keep in mind that there might be secret incentives on the car you want. Secret incentives can be $1000-$6000 in addition to known rebates. Invoice is usually not the price the dealer actually paid for your car.
Remember the power of walking out. If a negotiation isn't going the way you want, leave!
Head over here to check out edmunds.com. They'll have dealerships competing for your business (and the whole process can be a lot easier). Remember, I always ask for the out the door price! If you can pay cash (or get a loan somewhere else if there aren't great financing options) you'll know exactly what you're paying. Try to negotiate the trade in separately from the car price.
It's a great time to go on vacation (between the busy summer and holiday travel times) and score deals! San Diego has over 100 KIDS FREE deals. Kids will eat free, stay free, even play free.
Check out some of my favorite deals:
Examples:
Kids 3-11 get in free to the San Diego Zoo (limit 10 kids per paid adult per their public relations...great for single parents or if one parent is working during the day)
http://www.sandiegozoo.org/kidsfree/

posts.excerpt: I'm so glad so many are sharing this awesome deal that 99.9% of us will qualify for! Who hasn't had a Red Bull in the last 12 years?! If you’d like to “live…
posts.text:
I'm so glad so many are sharing this awesome deal that 99.9% of us will qualify for! Who hasn't had a Red Bull in the last 12 years?! If you’d like to “live life better for less” every single day, please “like” Alicia’s Deals on facebook, follow me on Twitter, and join the Alicia’s Deals e-mail list (I send one e-mail a day with the best deals around and you can unsubscribe at any time).
Here's a class action lawsuit most of us will probably qualify to be part of. Head over here to file a claim if you bought at least one Red Bull from January 1st, 2002 to October 3rd, 2014. You can choose to have a check for $10 mailed to you or approximately $15 of free Red Bull products.
Here's the legal language: "A settlement, set forth in a Stipulation of Settlement ("Stipulation"), has been reached in two class action lawsuits alleging that Red Bull North America, Inc., Red Bull Distribution Company, Inc., and Red Bull GmbH (collectively, "Red Bull"), misrepresented the functional benefits and safety of energy beverages marketed and distributed under the brand name Red Bull ®, including any variations, formats or line extensions thereof. Red Bull denies any wrongdoing or liability and while Red Bull believes that its marketing and labeling have always been entirely truthful and accurate, it confirms that all future claims about the functional benefits of its products will be medically and/or scientifically supported. The settlement will provide Class Members (as defined below) who timely submit a valid Claim Form (as defined in the Stipulation) with the option of receiving a cash payment or free Red Bull products."
So basically they made claims in their advertising that were not medically or scientifically supported.
You can see more about the claim here.

posts.title: It's First Friday! FREE Admission to the Children's Museum of Phoenix, The Heard Museum, The Phoenix Art Museum, and More!
posts.excerpt: Hooray! Today (10/3) is First Friday! If you don't have plans, you may want to head to Downtown Phoenix to enjoy the gorgeous weather, some beautiful art, an…
posts.text:
Hooray! Today (10/3) is First Friday! If you don't have plans, you may want to head to Downtown Phoenix to enjoy the gorgeous weather, some beautiful art, an Ollie the Trolley ride, and some FREE museums! Anyone that says Phoenix has no culture has obviously never been to First Friday!
Head to the Children's Museum of Phoenix where everyone will get in free from 5-9 PM. Tickets are usually $11 each, so this is quite an opportunity to play for less!
Visit the Heard Museum for their First Friday Native + You program. Everyone will get into the museum FOR FREE from 6-10 (tickets are usually $18 for adults, $7.50 for kids), and there will be music, breakdancing, lowriders, and more!
Still have energy? Go to the Phoenix Art Museum for their First Friday event. Everyone will get in for free from 6-10 PM (tickets are usually $15 for adults, $6 for kids).
If it's date night and you're leaving the kids at home, head to Adults Night Out at the Arizona Science Center. Adults will get in free from 5:30-9 (tickets are usually $16.95) AND they'll have an open bar and lots of fun!
Just to recap, if you take your family of four (two adults, two kids) to the Children's Museum of Phoenix, the Heard Museum, and the Phoenix Art Museum, you'll save a whopping $137 on admission (more if you have more kids).
If it's date night, I'm assuming you won't head to the Children's Museum, but you and your date will save $99.90 on tickets to the Arizona Science Center, the Heard, and the Phoenix Art Museum. AND you're sure to have a great time! The weather couldn't be any more beautiful!
Enjoy!

I’ve been looking for this one every day! Head over here to get up to 40% off admission to the Macdonald Ranch pumpkin patch. This is so much fun, we have gone for years!
“Choose from Five Options
$6 for weekday entry for one ($10 value) Code PLAY15 makes it $5.10
$13 for weekday entry for two ($20 value) Code PLAY15 makes it $11.05
$26 for weekday entry for four ($40 value) Code PLAY15 makes it $22.10

There’s something timeless about MacDonald’s Ranch. Maybe it’s that visitors can take a guided horseback ride through the desert, pose for an old-time photo, or ride a stagecoach—which in certain cases, might be held up by actors dressed as outlaws. But whatever the reason guests dock their zeppelin at MacDonald’s Ranch, the staff hopes to treat them to a fun ranch experience. They surround them with music, cowboy shows, and seasonal attractions such as the annual pumpkin festival.
MacDonald’s Ranch covers 1,300 acres of the scenic Sonoran Desert. Whether on horseback or ahayride, guests can explore the area and view its desert flora, hawks, petrified spurs, and coyotes.”

UPDATE: Starting Friday through Saturday (9/26-9/27) use promo code PLAY15 to get an EXTRA 15% off!
I've been looking for this one every day! Head over here to get up to 40% off admission to the Macdonald Ranch pumpkin patch. This is so much fun, we have gone for years!
"Choose from Five Options
$6 for weekday entry for one ($10 value) Code PLAY15 makes it $5.10
$13 for weekday entry for two ($20 value) Code PLAY15 makes it $11.05
$26 for weekday entry for four ($40 value) Code PLAY15 makes it $22.10
$22 for weekend entry for two ($30 value) Code PLAY15 makes it $18.70
$44 for weekend entry for four ($60 value) Code PLAY15 makes it $37.40
The fall attractions are open October 1–31 except on Tuesdays. Fall attractions include: * Horse- or mule-drawn hayride to the pumpkin patch * Petting zoo * Pony rides (extra $3 per rider) * Hay maze * Western-themed games, such as panning for gold or sack races
There's something timeless about MacDonald's Ranch. Maybe it's that visitors can take a guided horseback ride through the desert, pose for an old-time photo, or ride a stagecoach—which in certain cases, might be held up by actors dressed as outlaws. But whatever the reason guests dock their zeppelin at MacDonald's Ranch, the staff hopes to treat them to a fun ranch experience. They surround them with music, cowboy shows, and seasonal attractions such as the annual pumpkin festival.
MacDonald's Ranch covers 1,300 acres of the scenic Sonoran Desert. Whether on horseback or ahayride, guests can explore the area and view its desert flora, hawks, petrified spurs, and coyotes."
I would definitely try to go on a weekday (such a better deal). They are open until 6 PM on Friday nights, maybe a fun after-school activity!
Enjoy!

posts.title: Reminder that Today be Talk Like a Pirate Day! You Still Have Lots o' Time t' Get Free Donuts!
posts.excerpt: It's here it's here! TODAY (September 19th) is talk like a pirate day at Krispy Kreme! Head into your closest participating location to get a FREE original…
posts.text:
It's here it's here! TODAY (September 19th) is talk like a pirate day at Krispy Kreme! Head into your closest participating location to get a FREE original glazed donut when you talk like a pirate. If you dress like a pirate, you’ll get a full dozen free original glazed donuts!
Here’s a little bit more information from their facebook page:
“Ahoy There Mateys! Friday, September 19, any buccaneer to enter a participating Krispy Kreme and talk like a pirate gets one FREE Original Glazed® doughnut. To the landlubber who dares to wear full pirate attire goes a bounty of one FREE dozen Original Glazed doughnuts. Offer good on International Talk Like a Pirate Day, September 19th, only.
To claim yer bounty on September 19, ye must:
• Come in to a participating Krispy Kreme shop and Talk like a pirate for one FREE Original Glazed doughnut.
• Come in to a participating Krispy Kreme location in full pirate costume for one FREE dozen Original Glazed doughnuts. Qualifying pirate costumes must include three or more of the following items:
• Eye Patch
• Pirate Hat
• Bandana
• Peg Leg
• Parrot on Shoulder
• Pirate Shirt / Loose white shirt
• Knickers
• Leather Belt
• Silver and gold necklaces and earrings
• Pirate Hook
• Pointy black boots or ragged brown sandals
Offer good for one free doughnut per customer who talks like a pirate to a Krispy Kreme team member at a participating shop. One free dozen Original Glazed doughnuts per customer who wears a full pirate costume into a participating Krispy Kreme location. Redeemable on September 19, 2014 only at participating Krispy Kreme US locations. Non-participating locations include: All CT shops, Anderson, SC and Spartanburg, SC.”
If you really get into it, you can check out the English to Pirate translator here or you can always change your facebook language setting to English (Pirate).
Enjoy!

Head over here to get HALF OFF tickets to Youth American Ballet Company's Nutcracker! The shows will be Friday, December 19th through Sunday, December 21st at Desert Ridge high school in Mesa (note not in Desert Ridge!). You can see a beautiful video about the production here too.
"$12 for house right seating (up to $25 value)
$12 for house left seating (up to $25 value)
$15 for center house seating (up to $30 value)
Based on a novel by 19th-century romantic fabulist E.T.A. Hoffman, The Nutcracker weaves a magical tale of holiday adventure around one of the most recognizable scores in the ballet repertoire. It begins when young Clara receives a nutcracker from her godfather, a wizardly toymaker named Drosselmeyer. Sneaking downstairs to see the toy after everyone else has gone to bed, she suddenly finds herself caught in the middle of a pitched battle between the toys and an army of mice. After saving the nutcracker with a well-thrown shoe to the Mouse King's head, Clara and her now-living prince venture into the Land of Snow and the Land of Sweets to celebrate.
Throughout their adventures, Tchaikovsky's dazzling inventiveness propels the dances of nimble flowers and regal fairy queens. The "Waltz of the Snowflakes" floats weightlessly above the angelic voices of a youth choir, whereas the "Dance of the Sugarplum Fairy" tiptoes to the haunting, music-box chimes of a celesta. A medley of exotic national dances—including a Spanish bolero and Russian Trepak—add to the phantasmagoric celebration before the whole dream ends, as all dreams must."
It's always a wonderful time to take the family to see the Nutcracker during the holiday season! These seats are a bargain!
Enjoy!

posts.excerpt: I have to admit I've been looking forward to this! September 19th is talk like a pirate day at Krispy Kreme! Head into your closest participating location to…
posts.text:
I have to admit I've been looking forward to this! September 19th is talk like a pirate day at Krispy Kreme! Head into your closest participating location to get a FREE original glazed donut when you talk like a pirate. If you dress like a pirate, you'll get a full dozen free original glazed donuts!
Here's a little bit more information from their facebook page:
"Ahoy There Mateys! Friday, September 19, any buccaneer to enter a participating Krispy Kreme and talk like a pirate gets one FREE Original Glazed® doughnut. To the landlubber who dares to wear full pirate attire goes a bounty of one FREE dozen Original Glazed doughnuts. Offer good on International Talk Like a Pirate Day, September 19th, only.
To claim yer bounty on September 19, ye must:
• Come in to a participating Krispy Kreme shop and Talk like a pirate for one FREE Original Glazed doughnut.
• Come in to a participating Krispy Kreme location in full pirate costume for one FREE dozen Original Glazed doughnuts. Qualifying pirate costumes must include three or more of the following items:
• Eye Patch
• Pirate Hat
• Bandana
• Peg Leg
• Parrot on Shoulder
• Pirate Shirt / Loose white shirt
• Knickers
• Leather Belt
• Silver and gold necklaces and earrings
• Pirate Hook
• Pointy black boots or ragged brown sandals
Offer good for one free doughnut per customer who talks like a pirate to a Krispy Kreme team member at a participating shop. One free dozen Original Glazed doughnuts per customer who wears a full pirate costume into a participating Krispy Kreme location. Redeemable on September 19, 2014 only at participating Krispy Kreme US locations. Non-participating locations include: All CT shops, Anderson, SC and Spartanburg, SC."
If you really get into it, you can check out the English to Pirate translator here or you can always change your facebook language setting to English (Pirate).
Enjoy!

"The Destination
Far from the cacti-dotted deserts of southern Arizona, the White Mountains in the state's northern region are known for their blushing sandstone cliffs, ponderosa pines, and abundance of year-round outdoor activities. In Pinetop, less than 200 miles east of Phoenix, hiking and mountain biking trails are plentiful among the rolling hills and quiet groves: The White Mountain Trail System offers 200 miles of protected pathways, and the Apache-Sitgreaves National Forest beckons to adventurers with more than 2.76 million acres of unspoiled wilds.
The Digs
In a cozy, all-seasons hideaway at an elevation of 7,200 feet, there's no better spot than PVC at the Roundhouse Resort to frolic in the fresh air. Situated between the Apache and Sitgreaves National Forests and the unspoiled lands of the White Mountain Apache Reservation, you'll have access to the neighboring resort's recreation center and its heated indoor pool, exercise equipment, ping-pong table, and pool tables—not to mention the on-site playground with mini golf course. Your cheery cabin features bright décor and warm woods, plus two full bathrooms, air conditioning, a washer and dryer, fully equipped kitchen, and Internet access. Kick back in front of the electric fireplace, zone out in the private whirlpool-jet tub, and watch the sun set from the covered porch—when nature is this close, you won't want to miss a minute of it."

"Challenger Space Center and Museum is on a mission: to excite and educate its visitors about science and the vast wonders of outer space. That excitement starts as soon as guests walk onto the entrance's elevated gantry bridge to see a four-story, space-themed mural painted by Robert McCall. Then it's on to the museum, where the center's affiliation with the Smithsonian Institution enables it to offer top-notch exhibits, which range from a model of an Iridium satellite to three separate meteorite exhibits. Beneath theplanetarium’s night sky, stargazers can learn about the stars or test their wishes out on different constellations. Regular Family Star Nights encourage families to bond over stargazing presentations, a simulated shuttle launch, and other activities.
To immerse themselves in the space experience, groups can also sign up for two-hour simulated space missions that unfold in three spaces: a mission control room designed after the Johnson Space Center; the Spacecraft, which simulates a room onboard the International Space Station; and the Earth Space Transit Module, which helps crew members dock there."

Check out some of my favorite places on the pass:
Sunsplash: Each pass holder can attend Golfland Sunsplash one (1) time. Your pass is good for one (1) SunSplash General admission ticket. Sea Life Aquarium: Each Pass holder can attend Arizona Sea life Aquarium two (2) times. Simply present your Pogo Pass at the front desk to gain admission to the Aquarium. We did this last week and had a blast!
Phoenix Zoo: Each Pogo Pass holder receives general admission to the Phoenix Zoo two (2) times. To gain admission to the Zoo, simply present your Pogo Pass at the admission window. Stratum Laser Tag: Pass holders can attend stratum two (2) times. Each pass holder receives one (1) complimentary game of laser tag each time they attend. Pass is good Monday, Tuesday, or Wednesday from 4:30-9.
Arizona Diamondbacks: One (1) ticket per game per pass holder for two (2) home games at Chase Field for the MLB Regular Season. Check out the select dates here.
Phoenix Jump Street: Each Pass holder can attend Phoenix Jump Street two (2) times. Pass is good for a one (1) hour jump session each attendance. Pass is valid for twelve (12) months. Simply present your Pogo Pass at the front counter to gain admission to Phoenix Jump Street on Monday and Wednesday. Limited capacity, first come first serve.
And LOTS LOTS more! Rattlers games, Brunswick bowling, Phoenix Rock Gym, Enchanted Island, Comedy Theater, Skateland, and Tempe Paintball are all included! Head over here to see everywhere the pass is taken. Don’t forget to use promo code ALICIA to get your passes for $39.98 each (everyone over two will need their own pass).
