posts.title: Save Big With Your Smart Phone or Computer!
posts.excerpt: Embedded from youtube.com
posts.text:
Embedded from youtube.com
For my KTAR video this week I decided to focus on ways your smart phone and computer can save you money...no coupons required! You can watch it above, if you're new to the site, this is a great place to start!
I’ve been saying forever that you can get all of the deals at all of the stores at Walmart and you don’t have to have the ad. Well their brand new Savings Catcher is changing the game completely. Head over here to watch a quick video about it. Even if you never, ever look at the grocery ads (or the weekly post I do with all of my favorite deals) you can STILL get the best deals from everywhere at Walmart. What you do is scan your receipt on the Walmart app or enter your receipt number on Walmart’s website. If they find another price from an ad that’s lower than what you paid they’ll give you the difference in a Walmart e gift card. It’s all automatic and you can use it in store or online. If you really don’t want to tell the cashier about lower prices you found at different stores, this is a great bet for you.
Target has a great app called Cartwheel...head over here to check it out. Even if you don't have a phone you can still get an account on your computer. You'll enjoy big savings on all kinds of things already on your list. The savings are good on top of any Target coupons or manufacturers coupons you have.
If you haven’t gotten the Ibotta app yet, click here. They will pay you for learning about and shopping for selected items (in addition to any sales or coupons you have). It makes going to the grocery store way more fun. They have extra offers at Target, Whole Foods, Walmart, Costco, and Sams Club too! Ibotta-supported stores nearby include Fry’s, Safeway, Walmart, Whole Foods, CVS Pharmacy, Walgreens, Target, 7-eleven, Sam’s Club, Costco, and a few others (NOT Bashas’, Albertsons, or Trader Joe’s). I have gotten literally hundreds of dollars back!
Your grocery store has probably caught up with the digital age too! Head over here to get the Just for U app. You can save up to 30% off your grocery purchases! The savings are on many things you usually buy (where it gets the Just for U name).
Head over here to check out the Fry's mobile app. It makes it easier to download digital coupons (they'll come right off with your card...no clipping involved)! Also don't forget to download their weekly facebook coupon (and please "like" Alicia's Deals while you're at it)!
Enjoy the deals and be sure to save every day, even if you hate coupons (which I hope by now you don't)!

posts.title: Tips and Tricks to Save You Money Every Single Day!
posts.excerpt: Video
posts.text:
Video
If you missed Your Life A to Z today, you can watch it above!
Looking for deals is exciting! If you keep these tips and tricks in mind, you'll save even more every single day! Did you have any idea that it's possible to stack FOUR promo codes together sometimes?!
I hope you'll "like" Alicia's Deals on facebook, follow me on Twitter, and join the Alicia’s Deals e-mail list here. I'll do my very best to help you "live life better for less" every single day!
If you take a few moments each week checking out the ads (or reading my weekly best deals at the grocery stores post), you can save HUGE at Walmart. You can ad match and you don't have to physically have the ad with you!
Head over here to check out their ad match guarantee.
Here are a few highlights:
“We will match any local competitor’s advertised price.
We do not require customers to have the ad with them to honor a competitor’s ad. (this is HUGE…people think it’s really hard and they have to actually have the ads with them)
Items purchased must be identical to the ad (size, quantity, brand, flavor, color, etc.), for fresh produce and meat items, the price is offered in the same unit type (lb. for lb; each for each)”
If you’ve been reading Alicia’s Deals in AZ for awhile, you know how much I love Ibotta. This app allows you to save even more on things you’re already buying (on top of any sales or coupons). I have saved $643 total with this app…I just got $.25 back from milk! You can get money back from purchases like sunscreen, milk, soap, pork ribs, wine, and more at grocery stores including Sprouts, Fry’s, Safeway, Whole Foods, and more(think milk, sunscreen, Blue Bunny ice cream, soap,and lots more), CVS Pharmacy, Target, Walmart, Walgreens, Costco, Sam’s Club, restaurants like Quizno’s and Chili’s, Home Depot and Lowe’s, PetSmart and Petco, Babies r Us, AMC Theatres, and more. It’s super easy to use once you get the hang of it and makes shopping way more fun. The cash back is in addition to any sales or coupons you have, and it goes right into your Paypal account (or you can get gift cards). You just redeem the offer and upload a picture of your receipt…super easy. They are always adding new products that qualify for cash back.
Don't forget to use promo codes! I am always finding promo codes for all kinds of stores, even Groupon, Living Social, and Deal Chicken. In fact at Deal Chicken, you can always get $15 off your $75 purchase with promo code ALICIA15. Savings on top of savings are the BEST KIND! Keep in mind that you can often STACK promo codes.
At Kohl's, I just put FOUR promo codes TOGETHER, click here to find out EXACTLY how I did it. When you're able to stack codes, you'll do so much better!
You don't have to pay a ton to keep the kiddos entertained! My kids have done Apple Camp for two years in a row now. You can head over here to find out more about this FREE program. They got great instruction along with free ear buds and a free t shirt! Spots go quickly so you'll definitely want to sign up early next year!
Lowe's offers a fun and FREE kids clinic twice a month. Head over here to sign up for the next one.
Home Depot offers free kids workshops the first Saturday of each month. Head over here for more information!
Enjoy the deals and "live life better for less" every single day!

posts.title: Seven Things to Buy in July!
posts.excerpt: Thanks so much for tuning into Good Morning Arizona today! I hope you'll "like" Alicia's Deals on facebook and follow me to twitter where I'll help you "live…
posts.text:
Thanks so much for tuning into Good Morning Arizona today! I hope you'll "like" Alicia's Deals on facebook and follow me to twitter where I'll help you "live life better for less" every single day!
I saw this article about the seven best things to buy in July and thought it would be great to find real examples of deals!
Here we go...
1. Furniture. There are lots of summer clearance events going on. Right now you can save huge at the Living Spaces summer clearance event. They have sectionals, bedroom sets, and 5-piece counter sets all under $500. Stick to what's on sale and you'll do really well. It never hurts to ask a manager for extra discounts.
2. Computers and Tablets. It's a great time to buy a computer and tablet, especially as you get closer to back to school. At Staples right now you can pick up an HP all-in-one desktop PC for $329.90, usually $499.99. They marked it down AGAIN to $231.90 and it sold out almost right away. Keep looking for great deals as computer discounts should be plentiful!
At Best Buy and Apple stores, you can get an even bigger discount on certain computers and tablets if you're headed to college.
3. Bottled Water. At Fry's you can get a 24-pack of bottled water for $1.99. Definitely a stock up price.
4. Grills. Now that the 4th of July is over, you can get a smoking price on lots of models. Keep an eye out for clearance stickers when you're shopping! You can get this gorgeous 5-burner grill for just $258 right now at Walmart.
5. Condiments. It's grilling time and a great time to stock up on condiments. Right now at Fry's you can get Hunt's ketchup or Kroger BBQ sauce for just a buck. SWEET!
6. Jeans: Stores are gearing up for back to school and getting rid of some of the summer styles and older styles. It's a great time to save! Check out Gap, they have an up to 75% off sale going on right now. You can get a pair of jeans that usually goes for almost $70 down to under $30. I saw a few pairs of women's jeans at Old Navy for under $10.
7. Suits. Jos a Banks has some hot deals going on right now. Check out this 3-button wool herringbone sportcoat for $22.40, regular price $450!
Enjoy and let me know if you find a really hot deal!

posts.excerpt: If you have some pounds to lose (whether 5 or 100), you may want to check out this new program by Nutrisystem. Click here to get a free one-week trial. If you…
posts.text:
If you have some pounds to lose (whether 5 or 100), you may want to check out this new program by Nutrisystem. Click here to get a free one-week trial. If you don't like it, cancel anytime in that week and you're not out anything. If you love it the price starts at $2.69/week (very do-able for most of us).
I lost 30 pounds a couple of years ago and have kept it off so far but it's always hard (and I know the weight could come back very easily). I love programs that make it easy. Watch the video to get more of a sense of how NuMi works. They have loads of recipes that fit your calorie plan (based on what you have at home). The program offers unlimited tips, advice, and support every single day. There are lots of fitness options you can do wherever you are. I love that it gives you tools to succeed. Losing the excess weight helped me feel so much better, I really want to keep it off for life.
Another alternative that worked well for me is My Fitness Pal. Head over here to check it out, it's a free calorie counter that you can take anywhere. You make what you eat public (which does make eating that cookie a little bit less tempting).
If you want to get moving, you can head over here to get a free 3-day pass to any 24 hour Fitness. I'm all for working out for free, but sometimes it's really nice to take a class (especially when it's as hot as it is right now)!
If you have a weight loss tip that has worked for you, I'd love to share it! Dumping Diet Coke and drinking unsweetened green tea instead has done a world of good for me.

posts.title: Reminder: Don't Forget to Get Your FREE Night at the Westin Kierland!
posts.excerpt: UPDATE: I just spoke with the marketing manager at Scottsdale Quarter and I just want to reiterate that you must have at least one additional receipt from a…
posts.text:
UPDATE: I just spoke with the marketing manager at Scottsdale Quarter and I just want to reiterate that you must have at least one additional receipt from a Scottsdale Quarter store to get the deal (you can't just buy a gift card and that's it). Stop into a restaurant, buy that Mac you've been wanting, get a new swimsuit, even grab a cup of coffee and enjoy the beautiful shopping experience! I LOVE Scottsdale Quarter and shop and have lunch there all the time! The American Girl store is coming soon and they have H&M, the Apple Store, Bath and Body Works, Gap, and tons of other great places! You can use the gift card to make up the difference to $450.
This is SUPER HOT! Head over here for more information about an AMAZING promotion at Scottsdale Quarter! You can get a FREE night at the Westin Kierland (worth $149) when you spend $450 at two or more shops and/or restaurants at Scottsdale Quarter. They have all kinds of stores like Sephora, Lululemon, H&M, and tons of others. The promotion goes from June 2nd-June 15th.
Here’s what I did (I called to confirm that were eligible as part of the promotion and got the deal this afternoon):
I went to C3 and bought an iced tea (they have really delicious tea). I have lunch there all the time! I would have shopped more but I was running short on time that day!
Then I went to the Scottsdale Quarter management office with my tea receipt and bought a $450 Visa gift card. There was a $2 fee but I figured since I used my credit card, I’m getting more than that in cash back. I’ll use the gift card everywhere they accept Visa until it’s gone (I hate carrying cash and always use my card and pay it off at the end of the month, so it won’t change how I do things except for using another card until it’s gone). The tea and the gift card counted as buying things in two separate shops or restaurants, so I got the voucher for the FREE night at the Westin Kierland.
We made our reservation and are so excited! Using my Visa gift card has been working out great, I just recommend that you read the information that comes with it so you know how it works!
The Scottsdale Quarter management office is open Monday-Friday from 9-5 and is located next to Urban Outfitters.
Here are the terms and conditions of the free night:
Advance reservations are required. Offer does not include resort service charge (I called and found out the resort fee is $28.07). You don’t have to pay the room tax!
Offer is valid for one-night stay from June 2nd, 2014-August 29th, 2014. Offer is based on availability.
Black out dates: 6/14, 6/21, 6/28, 7/5, 7/12, and 8/2
Voucher must be received and stay booked and redeemed by same individual. Identification will be required at check-in.
Voucher has no cash value
Guests must cancel 48 hours prior to stay
Not valid with other offers or promotions.
Enjoy!

posts.title: HOT! FREE Night at the Westin Kierland Resort When You Spend $450 at Two Stores in Scottsdale Quarter! Check Out What I Got!
posts.excerpt: This is SUPER HOT! Head over here for more information about an AMAZING promotion at Scottsdale Quarter! You can get a FREE night at the Westin Kierland (worth…
posts.text:
This is SUPER HOT! Head over here for more information about an AMAZING promotion at Scottsdale Quarter! You can get a FREE night at the Westin Kierland (worth $149) when you spend $450 at two or more shops and/or restaurants at Scottsdale Quarter. They have all kinds of stores like Sephora, Lululemon, H&M, and tons of others. The promotion goes from June 2nd-June 15th.
Here's what I did (I called to confirm that were eligible as part of the promotion and got the deal this afternoon):
I went to C3 and bought an iced tea for $2 (they have really delicious tea).
Then I went to the Scottsdale Quarter management office with my tea receipt and bought a $450 Visa gift card. There was a $2 fee but I figured since I used my credit card, I'm getting more than that in cash back. I'll use the gift card everywhere they accept Visa until it's gone (I hate carrying cash and always use my card and pay it off at the end of the month, so it won't change how I do things except for using another card until it's gone). The tea and the gift card counted as buying things in two separate shops or restaurants, so I got the voucher for the FREE night at the Westin Kierland.
The Scottsdale Quarter management office is open Monday-Friday from 9-5 and is located next to Urban Outfitters.
Here are the terms and conditions of the free night:
Advance reservations are required. Offer does not include resort service charge (I called and found out the resort fee is $28.07). You don't have to pay the room tax!
Offer is valid for one-night stay from June 2nd, 2014-August 29th, 2014. Offer is based on availability.
Black out dates: 6/14, 6/21, 6/28, 7/5, 7/12, and 8/2
Voucher must be received and stay booked and redeemed by same individual. Identification will be required at check-in.
Voucher has no cash value
Guests must cancel 48 hours prior to stay
Not valid with other offers or promotions.
Enjoy!

If you haven't yet, you can still head over here to get POGO Passes for just $39.98 each (usually $99.95) with promo code ALICIA. We got three and the kids and I are having "Camp Markham" for at least a week this summer! We can't wait to visit all of the places! Here's a sampling of where you'll get to visit:
Sunsplash: Each pass holder can attend Golfland Sunsplash one (1) time. Your pass is good for one (1) SunSplash General admission ticket. Simply present your Pogo pass at Sunsplash Guest Service window to be scanned to obtain waterpark wristband. Regular price to get into Sunsplash is $29.99 so this almost pays for your pass! Stratum Laser Tag: Pass holders can attend stratum two (2) times. Each pass holder receives one (1) complimentary game of laser tag each time they attend. Pass is valid for 12 months.
Arizona Diamondbacks: One (1) ticket per game per pass holder for two (2) home games at Chase Field for the MLB Regular Season. Check out theselect dates here.
Phoenix Jump Street: Each Pass holder can attend Phoenix Jump Street two (2) times. Pass is good for a one (1) hour jump session each attendance. Pass is valid for twelve (12) months. Simply present your Pogo Pass at the front counter to gain admission to Phoenix Jump Street. Limited capacity, first come first serve.
And LOTS LOTS more! Rattlers games, Brunswick bowling, Phoenix Rock Gym, Enchanted Island, Comedy Theater, Skateland, and Tempe Paintball are all included! 2000 E. Rio Salado Parkway, #1211

posts.title: Summer Boredom Buster Deals! As Seen on Good Morning Arizona!
posts.excerpt: Video
posts.text:
Video
Thanks for tuning into Good Morning Arizona today! I hope you'll "like" Alicia's Deals on facebook where I'll help you "live life better for less" every single day.
Summer is here and we're sure to hear lots of choruses of "I'm bored" from the kids! I'm all for a little boredom, but here are some deals to keep summer FUN!
The McDowell Mountain Ranch Aquatic Center is a great place for the kids. There's a water slide, a lazy river, a fitness center, and lifeguards everywhere! Right now you can head over here to get a pass that will get your entire family from Memorial Day to Labor Day for $140 if you're a Scottsdale resident, $210 if you're not. That sale goes through the end of May, in June prices go up to $400 for residents, $600 for non residents. Head over here for more information. A day pass is $6 for Scottsdale residents, $9 for non-residents.
Big Surf is always tons of fun. Head over here to save HALF OFF passes. You’ll pay $13.95 instead of $27.95. It gets even better if you have a group (or want to go more than once). Buy six and use promo code ALICIA15 to save an EXTRA $15 off. That means 6 tickets will be $68.70 (or $11.45 each) instead of the normal price of $167.70! ALICIA15 will save you $15 off any Deal Chicken purchase over $75! This deal ENDS tomorrow (or when they sell out)! Hurry!
You can pick up Culture Passes at local libraries. Enjoy two free admissions to the Children's Museum of Phoenix, the Arizona Science Center, the Phoenix Zoo, and lots of other fun places around town. The passes can be hard to get (they go fast), but some libraries (like Scottsdale) let you check availability online. The ASU libraries have culture passes now too! Head over here for more information. There are even select performances available for free at some libraries.
Dbacks games are cool and comfortable (love that roof) and a great summer activity! Children should definitely join the Dbacks Kids Club. Kids get prizes for the first 20 games they attend (there are some great prizes).
Kids can head over here to join the No Chew Crew. Kids promise to say no to chewing tobacco (which is a fabulous idea) and get a free toothbrush and ticket to a Dbacks game in return.
Also, another great reason to stay after games for kids run the bases on Sundays, the Dbacks will donate $1 to PCH for every runner to cross home plate. Head over here for more information.
Enjoy the deals and GO DBACKS!!!

posts.title: Save at CVS! My Favorite Shopping Tips as Shown on Good Morning Arizona!
posts.excerpt: Video
posts.text:
Video
We've been talking all week long about how to save the most at YOUR STORE even when there isn't a sale. You hard earned bucks are valuable (and worth more than you think when you use my easy tips). I hope you'll "like" Alicia's Deals on facebook where I'll help you "live life better for less" every single day. My goal is to get up to 10,000 people saving together and we're getting there! I am so thrilled you're here! You can check out my other segments on Walmart, Safeway, and Fry's. Tomorrow we're headed to Target (so you'll want to tune into 3TV at 9:15)!
The first thing everyone should do when they get to CVS is go to the Coupon Center. Each store has one and you can either scan your CVS card or use your phone number (so nice since I never have my card with me) to get lots of coupons printed just for you. Grab an ad too to check out the sales and ExtraBucks deals.
I went straight to the Gillete Venus razor. I had this printable manufacturers' coupon for $2 offand a CVS coupon for $4 off any razor purchase of $10+ that printed off at the coupon machine (may not print for everyone). I also earned $5 ExtraBucks.
One thing that's very important to remember about ExtraBucks is that you can use them right away (I ALWAYS do). You'll have to check out a couple of times but you won't forget them in the car or let them expire.
Then I bought three Neutrogena wipes packs. I had a manufacturers coupon (from the free Wall Street Journal I get each day), and a CVS coupon that printed off when I got to the store. I used the $5 Extrabucks I earned on the razor and earned another $10 in Extrabucks.
Then I bought two Revlon eye shadows. They were on sale buy one get one half off and I had two of these printable coupons for $2 off your Revlon eye product (you can print off two). Matching the sale to the coupons that meant eye shadow for way less than $1 each. I also bought deodorant, cereal, and a few other things that were on sale and used the $10 ExtraBucks I earned on the Neutrogena products. My total bill was just over the cost of tax.
Another fun CVS perk that very few people actually take advantage of is the ExtraCare Beauty Club. You can sign up here for freeand you'll earn $5 in Extrabucks for every $50 in beauty products you spend. You'll also get $3 in Extrabucks for your birthday, a 10% off pass after you enroll, and more.
Know the rules and how to maximize your savings with these key tips and you'll be amazed at how much you save.

posts.text:
Video
We've been revealing savings tips everyone should be taking advantage of this week on Good Morning Arizona. You can check out my Walmart savings tips here and my Safeway savings tips here if you missed them earlier in the week. I hope you'll "like" Alicia's Deals on facebook where I'll help you "live life better for less" every single day. My goal have 10,000 people saving money together! Today we're talking savings tips at Fry's. Here are some tips that will DEFINITELY save you money if Fry's is your store.
1. Download the Wednesday facebook coupon. This week you can score $3 off your $50 purchase.. The dollars add up fast. Two or three bucks a week is way over $100 a year just for clicking a button. The fuel savings can add up fast, especially when you think about all of the road trips you have coming up. posts.title: As Seen on Good Morning Arizona...Shopping Tips at Safeway!
posts.excerpt: Thanks so much for tuning into Good Morning Arizona today where I'm sharing my shopping tips at all of the stores all week long. I hope you'll "like" Alicia's…
posts.text:
Thanks so much for tuning into Good Morning Arizona today where I'm sharing my shopping tips at all of the stores all week long. I hope you'll "like" Alicia's Deals on facebook where I'll help you "live life better for less" every single day. In case you missed Monday's Walmart segment you can check it out here.
Video
Today we're talking Safeway. Be sure to download the Just for U app to your phone via iTunes or Google Play (or log-in on your computer). The app ties directly to your Safeway Club Card and gives you discounts based on what you buy on a regular basis. So even if an item isn't on sale, it very well may be on sale for you. The savings are significant! On my app I had free Pillsbury cookies to add to my card, a gallon of milk for $1.99, a veggie tray for $4.50, and lots of other great deals that tie in with my shopping habits. You'll save around 20% (I've saved more than that at times) and you can add the deals while you're shopping (no planning ahead). It actually makes grocery shopping more fun.
Another app you won't want to miss is ibotta. Head over here to download it to your phone. This app allows you to save even more on things you’re already buying (on top of any sales or coupons or Just for U deals). It works at Safeway, Costco,Walmart, Target, Fry's, Walgreens, CVS, Dollar General, Sam's Club, Whole Foods, Sprouts, PetSmart, even AMC movie theaters. You add products to your app and learn about them. When you buy them, you take a picture of your receipt, and you'll get the rebate amount directly into your ibotta account. You can cash out once you hit at least $5 and send the money directly to your Paypal account or get Starbucks or iTunes gift cards. Examples of ibotta rebates at Safeway (each store has a list):
Earn $.50 when you buy a gallon of white milk (any brand) and take a poll and take a survey (takes seconds).
Earn $1.00 when you buy O Organics salad, learn a face, how to, and post on facebook
Earn $1.25 when you buy Banana Boat sunscreen, play trivia, and post on facebook
There are 88 possible rebates at Safeway and if there are items on your list, you can get back a bunch every shopping trip wherever you shop! Be sure to download the app!
Another tip to keep in mind when you shop is that ALL MANUFACTURERS' COUPONS are worth at least $1 at Safeway. You don't need to get the paper to enjoy the savings, you can head over here to find a huge assortment of printable coupons. You only print the coupons you'll use!
When you match coupons to sales, you'll do well. For example, Honey Nut Cheerios are on sale for $1.88 a box through Tuesday, May 13th. Use this coupon for $.50 off a box of Honey Nut Cheerios, it'll be worth $1. That means an $.88 box of Honey Nut Cheerios! It's pretty hard to beat that price.
Safeway also has fuel points. You can earn up to $1 off per gallon at Safeway, Chevron, and Texaco stations. Head over here for more details.
If you keep these tips in mind when you shop Safeway, you'll save a bunch! Enjoy!

posts.title: As Seen on Good Morning Arizona...Ad Match at Walmart and Save HUGE!
posts.excerpt: Video
posts.text:
Video
Thanks so much for tuning into Good Morning Arizona today! I hope you'll "like" Alicia's Deals on facebook where I'll help you "live life better for less" every single day. You can also click here to join the Alicia's Deals e-mail list, I'll send an e-mail each day with all of the best deals in town. You can unsubscribe at any time and I promise never to share your e-mail with anyone!
If you take a few moments each week checking out the ads (or reading my weekly best deals at the grocery stores post), you can save HUGE at Walmart.
Head over here to check out their ad match guarantee.
Here are a few highlights:
"We will match any local competitor's advertised price.
We do not require customers to have the ad with them to honor a competitor's ad. (this is HUGE...people think it's really hard and they have to actually have the ads with them)
Items purchased must be identical to the ad (size, quantity, brand, flavor, color, etc.), for fresh produce and meat items, the price is offered in the same unit type (lb. for lb; each for each)"
On Sunday my family came along with me to ad match at Walmart.
I picked up a watermelon for a buck (the weekend sale price at Sprouts, unfortunately no longer on sale).
I got a large cantaloupe for $.98 (the sale price at Sprouts through Wednesday)
I picked up a 16 oz. package of Strawberries for $.87 (the sale price at Albertsons through Tuesday)
I got a box of Frosted Flakes for $1.99 (the sale price at Bashas' through Tuesday)
I had none of the ads with me and saved almost $7 on just these four items. Imagine if you do this with everything in your cart!
No driving around town, you'll get all of the specials in one spot.
This works on other competitors ads too!
Be sure to check out all of the specifics of the policy. You may want to print it off and bring it with you in case you're questioned (which I know is so annoying)!
Enjoy and SAVE!
